cards.name: Spider-Man
cards.text: Spider-Sense — Interrupt: When the villain initiates an attack against you, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "Just your friendly neighborhood Spider-Man!"

cards.name: Peter Parker
cards.text: Scientist — Resource: Generate a [mental] resource. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "Right now, I'd trade the whole Spider-Man bit for a rocking chair and a good book."

cards.name: Black Cat
cards.text: Forced Response: After you play Black Cat, discard the top 2 cards of your deck. Add each card with a printed [mental] resource discarded this way to your hand.
cards.flavor: "I'm not a hero, I'm a thief."

cards.name: Backflip
cards.text: Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage from an attack, prevent all of that damage.
cards.flavor: "Have you been training? 'Cause that almost hit me." —Spider-Man

cards.name: Enhanced Spider-Sense
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When a treachery card is revealed from the encounter deck, cancel its "When Revealed" effects.
cards.flavor: "My spider-sense is tingling!" —Spider-Man

cards.name: Swinging Web Kick
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 8 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Tally-ho!" —Spider-Man

cards.name: Aunt May
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Aunt May → heal 4 damage from Peter Parker.
cards.flavor: "Goodness, Peter! You've been so clumsy lately."

cards.name: Spider-Tracer
cards.text: Attach to a minion. Forced Interrupt: When attached minion is defeated, remove 3 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Web-Shooter
cards.text: Uses (3 web counters). (Enters play with 3 counters. When those are gone, discard this card) Hero Resource: Exhaust Web-Shooter and remove 1 web counter from it → generate a [wild] resource.

cards.name: Webbed Up
cards.text: Hero form only. Attach to an enemy. Max 1 per enemy. Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy would attack, discard Webbed Up instead. Then, stun that enemy.

cards.name: Captain Marvel
cards.text: Rechannel — Action: Spend a [energy] resource and heal 1 damage from Captain Marvel → draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I never quit."

cards.name: Carol Danvers
cards.text: Commander — Action: Choose a player to draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "It's my job to protect the Earth and everyone on it."

cards.name: Spider-Woman
cards.text: Response: After Spider-Woman enters play, confuse the villain.
cards.flavor: "This is what I wanted: helping the innocents by hospitalizing the guilty."

cards.name: Crisis Interdiction
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. Then, if you have the [[Aerial]] trait, remove 2 threat from a different scheme.
cards.flavor: "This is one of the more impressive messes I've ever seen." —Carol Danvers

cards.name: Photonic Blast
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using a [energy] resource, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Energy Absorption
cards.flavor: "That's enough!" —Carol Danvers

cards.name: Alpha Flight Station
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Alpha Flight Station, choose and discard 1 card from your hand → draw 1 card (draw 2 cards instead if you are Carol Danvers).
cards.flavor: This low-orbit space station can beam cargo and crew to and from the Triskelion

cards.name: Captain Marvel's Helmet
cards.text: Captain Marvel gets +1 DEF (+2 DEF instead if you have the [[Aerial]] trait).
cards.flavor: "This is so cool!" —Jessica Drew

cards.name: Cosmic Flight
cards.text: Captain Marvel gains the [[Aerial]] trait. Hero Interrupt (defense): When Captain Marvel would take damage, discard Cosmic Flight → prevent 3 of that damage.

cards.name: Energy Channel
cards.text: Max 1 per player. Action: Spend X [energy] resources → put X energy counters here. Hero Action (attack): Discard Energy Channel → deal 2 damage to an enemy (to a maximum of 10) for each energy counter here.

cards.name: She-Hulk
cards.text: "Do You Even Lift?" — Response: After you change to this form, deal 2 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "I'm six foot seven and bright green! People are gonna stare no matter how I dress."

cards.name: Jennifer Walters
cards.text: "I Object!" — Interrupt: When threat would be placed on a scheme, prevent 1 of that threat. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I can turn into a Hulk anytime I want. But just because you can do something doesn't always mean you should.

cards.name: Hellcat
cards.text: Action: Return Hellcat to your hand.
cards.flavor: "Turn around gentlemen, and meet —the Hellcat!"

cards.name: Gamma Slam
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal X damage to an enemy (to a maximum of 15). X is the amount of damage you have sustained.
cards.flavor: "You messed with the wrong woman!" —She-Hulk

cards.name: Ground Stomp
cards.text: Hero Action: Deal 1 damage to each enemy.
cards.flavor: "These boots were made for stompin'." —She-Hulk

cards.name: Legal Practice
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action (thwart): Choose and discard up to 5 cards from your hand → remove 1 threat from a scheme for each card discarded this way.
cards.flavor: "That's the first time I've ever seen someone argue their way out of a fight." —Spider-Man

cards.name: One-Two Punch
cards.text: Response: After you make a basic attack (using your ATK), ready She-Hulk.
cards.flavor: "I just don't care for men with fresh mouths." —Jennifer Walters

cards.name: Split Personality
cards.text: Action: Change your form (flip your identity card). Then, draw up to your printed hand size.
cards.flavor: "I know a thing or two about rage. And that kind of fury... it's not going to pass without taking someone with it." —Jennifer Walters

cards.flavor: "I'll be sending you a bill. My time is valuable these days." —Jennifer Walters

cards.name: Focused Rage

cards.name: Superhuman Strength

cards.name: Iron Man

cards.flavor: "I am Iron Man."

cards.name: Tony Stark
cards.text: Futurist — Action: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 to your hand and discard the others. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I'm obviously not doing this for the money..."

cards.name: War Machine
cards.text: Action: Exhaust War Machine and deal 2 damage to him → deal 1 damage to each enemy.
cards.flavor: "Is this a private war —or can anyone join?"

cards.name: Repulsor Blast

cards.name: Supersonic Punch
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy (8 damage instead if you have the [[Aerial]] trait).
cards.flavor: "Nice technique. But if you do it like this... it hurts more." —Tony Stark

cards.name: Pepper Potts

cards.flavor: "Do your thing. I've got this."

cards.name: Stark Tower
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Stark Tower → choose a player. That player returns the topmost [[Tech]] upgrade in their discard pile to their hand.
cards.flavor: "I was hoping for something a little bigger. But this will do." —Tony Stark

cards.name: Arc Reactor

cards.flavor: "When I put on this armor, I took on more power than any human was ever intended to have... and maybe more responsibility than my heart can truly bear." —Tony Stark

cards.name: Mark V Armor
cards.text: You get +6 hit points.
cards.flavor: "Is that all you've got!" —Tony Stark

cards.name: Mark V Helmet
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Exhaust Mark V Helmet → remove 1 threat from a scheme (from each scheme instead if you have the [[Aerial]] trait).
cards.flavor: "Tony, are you sure you want to do that!" —P.E.P.P.E.R.

cards.name: Powered Gauntlets
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Powered Gauntlets → deal 1 damage to an enemy (2 damage instead if you have the [[Aerial]] trait).
cards.flavor: "Please, let me give you... a hand." —Tony Stark

cards.name: Rocket Boots

cards.name: Black Panther

cards.flavor: "To attack me is to attack Wakanda."

cards.name: T'Challa

cards.name: Shuri

cards.flavor: "You would be lost without me, brother!"

cards.name: Uppercut
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to an enemy.

Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.

cards.flavor: "I'd ask your to surrender... but I'm really hoping you'll put up a fight."

cards.flavor: "Smashing is what Hulk does best!" —Hulk

cards.flavor: "How about a taste of your own medicine?" —Captain Marvel

cards.flavor: "A flying aircraft carrier? You're kidding, right?" —Jennifer Walters

cards.flavor: "Foolish rabble! Your pitiful display is nothing to my newfound power!"

cards.text: When Revealed: The enemy with the highest ATK attacks the hero or ally with the highest ATK (first player decides ties.) If no attack was made this way, this card gains surge.
cards.flavor: "You are all beneath me!" —Abomination

cards.text: Action: Exhaust Beat Cop → move 1 threat from a scheme to here. Action: Exhaust and discard Beat Cop → deal 1 damage to a minion for each threat here.

cards.name: Inspiring Presence
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait. Hero Action: Heal 1 damage from an ally and ready it.

cards.name: Electrostatic Armor
cards.text: Player under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Response: After you defend against an attack, deal 1 damage to the attacking character.

cards.name: Resourceful
cards.text: Resource: Discard Resourceful → generate a [wild] resource.
cards.flavor: "Innovation is the ultimate weapon." —Vision

cards.name: Hawkeye
cards.text: "Quick Draw" — Action: Exhaust Hawkeye → ready Hawkeye's bow.
cards.flavor: "I may not be the mightiest Avenger, but I'm definitely the coolest."

cards.name: Hawkeye's Bow
cards.text:
Restricted.
Your hero gets +1 ATK and each of your [[Arrow]] attacks gain ranged.

cards.name: Hawkeye's Quiver
cards.text: You may play [[Arrow]] events attached to this card as if they were in your hand. Hero Action: Exhaust Hawkeye's Quiver → search the top 5 cards of your deck for an [[Arrow]] event and attach it faceup to this card.

cards.name: Mockingbird
cards.text: Interrupt: When the villain initiates an attack against you, spend 1 resource of any type and return Mockingbird to your hand → prevent all damage from this attack.
cards.flavor: "Is that all you got?"

cards.name: Sonic Arrow
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Hawkeye's Bow → confuse an enemy and deal 3 damage to it (5 damage instead if it is already confused)
cards.flavor: EEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!!!

cards.name: Explosive Arrow

cards.flavor: "Anyone ever tell you how your eyes sparkle when you're angry?" —Clint Barton

cards.name: Electric Arrow
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Hawkeye's Bow → stun an enemy and deal 3 damage to it (5 damage instead if it is already stunned).
cards.flavor: "Hail Hawkeye!" —Clint Barton

cards.name: Cable Arrow
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Exhaust Hawkeye's Bow → remove 3 threat from a scheme, ignoring any crisis icons in play.
cards.flavor: "It's a great way to get around." —Clint Barton

cards.name: Vibranium Arrow
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Hawkeye's Bow → deal 6 damage to an enemy. This attack gains piercing.

cards.name: Expert Marksman
cards.text: Resource: Exhaust Expert Marksman → generate a [wild] resource for an [[Arrow]] event.
cards.flavor: "When you fight alongside gods and monsters, it's not enough to be great; you have to the best." —Clint Barton

cards.name: Hawkeye
cards.text: Action: Exhaust this ally and discard 1 card from your hand → deal X damage to an enemy, where X is the number of printed resources on that card.
cards.flavor: "You see I', literally pointing arrows at your, right?."

cards.name: Black Knight
cards.text: [star] Black Knight's basic attack gains piercing.
cards.flavor: "As long as the Black Blade blazes darkly in my hand, I must fight on."

cards.name: Goliath
cards.text: Action: Goliath gets +4 ATK until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase, discard Goliath. (Max once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "Sometimes being a gentleman means holding the door, and the rest of the building."

cards.name: U.S. Agent
cards.text: Retaliate 1.
cards.flavor: "Cap isn't the only soldier who loves his country."

cards.name: Team Training

Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Each ally you control gets +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: "We mostly just wait for Cap to yell 'Avengers Assemble' and attack in the same direction as him" —Clint Barton

cards.name: Ready for Action
cards.text: Hero Action: Give an ally you control a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "Try that again. I dare you." —Jessica Drew

cards.name: Lead from the Front

cards.name: Captain Marvel
cards.text: Response: After Captain Marvel uses a basic power, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "I gotta hand it to you, kid. This is one of the more impressive messes I've ever seen."

cards.text: Hero Action: Stun and confuse an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Warn me before you use that power again, okay?" —Peter Parker

cards.flavor: You used your enemy's technology to reunite in the present day, just in time to counter Kang's assault on Earth.

cards.name: Kang's Wrath
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck, discard pile, and set-aside area for their nemesis minion and puts it into play engaged with them. Shuffle the encounter deck. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Temporal Shield
cards.text: Attach to Kang. Forced Interrupt: When Kang is attacked, discard Temporal Shield → prevent all damage from this attack and deal 1 damage to the attacker. (Max 1 per attack.)
cards.flavor: "Put away your childish weapons! They are no more than toys to me!" —Kang
cards.illustrator: Frank D'Armata, Karl Kezel, & Jorge Molina

cards.name: Future Weapon
cards.text: Attach to Kang. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Kang attacks, the attack gains overkill. If this attack damages a hero, that hero is stunned. After this attack, discard Future Weapon.
cards.flavor: "Like myself, you know that combat means something, and honor more~" —Kang

cards.name: Frozen in Time
cards.text:
Attach to your identity. Forced Interrupt: When attached character would ready, discard this card instead.
[star] Boost: Attach to your identity.
cards.illustrator: Frank D'Armata, Karl Kezel, & Jorge Molina

cards.name: Macrobots
cards.text:
Guard. Retaliate 1.
[star] Boost: Give Kang a tough status card.

cards.name: Weakened
cards.text: Forced Response: After you use a basic hero power, take 1 damage. Alter-Ego Action: Discard a [physical] resource from your hand → discard this obligation.
cards.flavor: "History is made! Made by the deeds of the strong! The brave! And destiny is forged!" —Kang
cards.illustrator: Alvin Lee, Terry Pallott, & Val Staples

cards.name: Stolen Memories
cards.text: When Revealed: Place the top 8 cards of your deck facedown under this card. Alter-Ego Action: Discard a [mental] resource from your hand → discard this obligation. (Discard each facedown card under this obligation.)
cards.illustrator: K Janson, T. Palmer, J Romita Jr., & S.D. White

cards.name: Depowered
cards.text: You cannot play hero-specific cards. Alter-Ego Action: Discard a hero-specific card from your hand → discard this obligation.
cards.flavor: "Greater men than you have trembled at my name. Lesser men have fainted at its mention!" —Kang
cards.illustrator: Jim Cheung, John Dell, & Justin Ponsor

cards.name: Time-Travel Hijinks
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard the highest-cost card you control, then place it facedown under this card. Alter-Ego Action: Discard a [energy] resource from your hand → discard this obligation.(Discard each facedown card under this obligation.)
cards.illustrator: Alvin Lee, Terry Pallott, & Val Staples

cards.name: Corrupted Timestream
cards.text: Players cannot trigger "Alter-Ego Action" abilities on obligations. When Revealed: Each player must either discard 1 random card from hand, or place 2 threat here.
cards.illustrator: Jim Cheung, John Dell, & Justin Ponsor

cards.name: Kang's Dominion
cards.text: Kang cannot take damage. When Defeated: Deal the player who defeated this scheme an encounter card.
cards.flavor: "The future belongs to Kang! To Kang!" —Kang

cards.name: Pinned Down
cards.text: When Revealed: Place 2 threat here for each obligation in play.

cards.name: Rampage
cards.text: When Defeated: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a minion is discarded. Put that minion into play engaged with the player who defeated this scheme.

cards.name: Energy Blast
cards.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Discard an ally or support you control. If you cannot, this card gains surge. When Revealed (Hero): Kang attacks you.
cards.illustrator: Frank D'Armata, Karl Kezel, & Jorge Molina

cards.name: Manipulated Timestream
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard each event from your hand. If no events are discarded this way, this card gains surge.
cards.flavor: "It is the conquerors who change the world." —Kang

cards.name: Time-Travel Tactics
cards.text:
Surge. When Revealed: Each player takes 1 indirect damage for each obligation in their play area.
[star] Boost: This card gains [boost] for each obligation in your play area.

cards.name: Past Machinations
cards.text: Incite 1. (Place 1 threat on the main scheme when this card is revealed.) When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a different obligation and reveals it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.illustrator: Sunny Gho, Jay Leisten,& Steve McNiven

cards.name: Ancient Warrior
cards.text:
Quickstrike.
[star] Boost: You are stunned.

cards.name: Chitauri Soldier
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Chitauri Soldier attacks you, discard the top card of the encounter deck → take indirect damage equal to the number of boost icons on that card.

cards.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
cards.text:
Toughness.
[star] Tyrannosaurus Rex's attacks gain piercing.

cards.name: Time Portal
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When this scheme is defeated, shuffle it into the encounter deck instead of discarding it.

cards.name: Kang (The Conqueror)
cards.text: Toughness. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Kang attacks you, either place 1 threat on the main scheme, or he gets +2 ATK for this attack. When Defeated: Advance the main scheme to stage 2 at the end of the phase.

cards.text: Retaliate 1. Toughness. When Defeated: Remove Inexorable Fate from the game. At the end of the phase, join another game area.

cards.text: Toughness. [star] This villain's attacks gain piercing. When Defeated: Remove The Present Future War from the game. At the end of the phase, join another game area.

cards.text:
When Revealed: Discard an ally or support you control.
[star] Boost: Exhaust a character you control. Give this enemy another boost card.

Toughness. Villainous. (When this minion activates, give it a boost card.)
[star] Boost: Give this enemy a tough status card and another boost card.

cards.name: Sir Raston
cards.text:
Guard. Retaliate 1.
[star] Boost: Take 1 damage. Give this enemy another boost card.

cards.name: Terminatrix
cards.text:
Quickstrike. [star] Terminatrix's attacks gain piercing.
[star] Boost: Give this enemy 2 more boost cards.

cards.name: Wildrun
cards.text:
When Revealed: Discard 1 random card from your hand.
[star] Boost: Discard 1 random card from your hand. Give this enemy another boost card.

cards.text: When Defeated: Shuffle each [[Temporal]] card in the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.

cards.name: Kang's Chosen
cards.text: Incite 1. (When revealed, place 1 threat on the main scheme.) When Revealed: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Temporal]] minion is discarded. Reveal that minion.

cards.name: Kang (Master of Time)
cards.text: Toughness. Villainous. (When this minion activates, give it a boost card.) Kang (Master of Time) gets +1 SCH and +1 ATK for each obligation in your play area.

cards.name: Time-Displaced Soldier
cards.text:
Incite 1. Surge.
[star] Boost: Deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card.

cards.name: Fear of Kang
cards.text: You cannot attack Kang. Alter-Ego Action: Discard a random card from your hand → discard this obligation.

cards.name: Light of Centuries Sphere
cards.text: When Defeated: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a minion is discarded. Put that minion into play engaged with the player who defeated this scheme.

cards.name: Ancient Grudge
cards.text: When Revealed: Kang (Master of Time) activates against you. If Kang (Master of Time) is not in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for Kang (Master of Time) and put him into play engaged with you. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.illustrator: Kieron Daye, Rick Remender, & Tom Smith

cards.name: Ant-Man
cards.text: Puny Pest — Response: After you change to this form, remove 1 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "Why don't you pick on somebody your own size?"

cards.name: Scott Lang
cards.text: Time to Unwind — Response: After you change to this form, heal 1 damage from Scott Lang.
cards.flavor: "Being Cassie's hero is all I've ever wanted."

cards.name: Ant-Man
cards.text: Giant Nuisance — Response: After you change to this form, deal 1 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Oh Yeah, tiny dude is big now!"

cards.name: Wasp
cards.text: Hero Response: After Wasp enters play, deal 2 damage to an enemy if you are in [[Giant]] hero form or remove 2 threat from a scheme if you are in [[Tiny]] hero form.

cards.name: Giant Stomp
cards.text: Play only if you are in [[Giant]] hero form. Hero Action (attack): Deal 1 damage to each minion. Deal 8 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "I'd run if I were you." —Scott Lang

cards.name: Hive Mind
cards.text: Play only if you are in [[Tiny]] hero form. Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. Remove 1 additional threat from that scheme for each Army of Ants support you control.

cards.name: Resize
cards.text: Hero Action: Change to your other hero form. Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "This is awesome!" —Scott Lang

cards.name: Pym Particles
cards.text: Hero Response: After you spend this card, heal 2 damage from your hero if you are in [[Giant]] hero form or draw 1 card if you are in [[Tiny]] hero form.

cards.name: Army of Ants
cards.text: Hero Action: If you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, exhaust Army of Ants → deal 1 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Antvengers Assemble!" —Scott Lang

cards.name: Ant-Man's Helmet
cards.text: Hero Response: After you change to [[Giant]] hero form, heal 2 damage from your hero. Hero Response: After you change to [[Tiny]] hero form, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Giant Strength
cards.text: Hero Response: After you change to [[Giant]] hero form, you get +1 ATK until the end of this turn.
cards.flavor: "My daughter lost her phone. I thought I'd look under these buildings." —Scott Lang

cards.name: Wrist Gauntlets
cards.text: Hero Action: If you are in [[Giant]] hero form, exhaust Wrist Gauntlets and spend [physical][physical] resources → stun an enemy. Hero Action: If you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, exhaust Wrist Gauntlets and spend [energy][energy] resources → confuse an enemy.

cards.name: Ant-Man
cards.text: Ant-Man gets +1 hit point for each pym counter on him. Interrupt: When Ant-Man enters play, place 1 pym counter on him (to a maximum of 4) for each resource you overpaid for Ant-Man's cost.

cards.name: Giant-Man
cards.text: Giant-Man gets +2 ATK while he has 3 or more remaining hit points.
cards.flavor: "Size isn't everything. Unless you're stepping over a bridge."

cards.name: Ronin
cards.text: Ronin gets +1 THW and +1 ATK while an upgrade is attached to them.
cards.flavor: "Dunno who's wearing the suit this time, but they can definitely handle themself in a fight." —Spectrum

cards.name: Stinger
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait.
Stinger does not count against your ally limit.

cards.name: Call for Aid
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard an [[Avenger]] ally, then add that ally to your hand.
cards.flavor: "You rang?" —Tony Stark

cards.name: Moxie
cards.text: Hero Response: After you change form, your hero gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, +1 DEF until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "If you mess with one of us, you mess with all of us!" Even if I'm the last one." —Nova

cards.name: Power Gloves
cards.text: Attach to an [[Avenger]] ally. Max 1 per ally. Response: After attached ally attacks or thwarts, deal 1 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Reinforced Suit
cards.text:
Attach to an ally. Max 1 per ally.
Attached ally gets +2 hit points.
cards.flavor: "Remember, it's not just the suit that gives you power, it's how you use it." —Hank Pym
cards.illustrator: Christopher Allen, Guru FX, & Roberto Poggi

cards.name: First Aid
cards.text: Action: Heal 2 damage from any character.
cards.flavor: "Does it still qualify as first aid if it's your second day in the hospital?" —Clint Barton

cards.name: Swarm Tactics
cards.text: Team-Up (Ant-Man and Wasp). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Change to your other hero form. Ready your hero.

cards.text: Give to the Scott Lang player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Exhaust Scott Lang → remove Care for Cassie from the game. • Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. You cannot change form until your next turn ends. Discard this obligation.

cards.name: Tech Theft
cards.text: Treat the printed text box of each [[Tech]] player card as if it were blank.
cards.flavor: Yellowjacket has stolen priceless Pym Particle technology.

cards.name: Yellowjacket
cards.text:
While you are in [[Giant]] hero form, Yellowjacket gains the [[Giant]] trait and retaliate 1.
While you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, Yellowjacket gains the [[Tiny]] trait and gets +1 ATK.
(Ant-Man's nemesis minion.)

cards.name: Size Increase
cards.text: Attach to Yellowjacket, if able. If you cannot, attach to the villain. Uses (3 counters). [star] Forced Response: After attached enemy activates, remove 1 size counter from here.

cards.name: Yellowjacket's Plan
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until a card from the Ant-Man Nemesis set is discarded this way. Reveal that card.
cards.flavor: "You think you can stop the future?!" —Yellowjacket

cards.name: Moment of Triumph
cards.text: Hero Response: After you attack and defeat an enemy, heal 1 damage from your hero for each point of excess damage dealt to that enemy by that attack.

cards.name: Lay Down the Law
cards.text: Hero Response (thwart): After you change form, remove 3 threat from a scheme (4 threat instead if you paid for this card using a [mental] resource).
cards.flavor: "Maybe this will teach you!" —Captain America

cards.name: Muster Courage
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait. Hero Action: Give up to X friendly characters a tough status card (to a maximum of 3 characters), where X is equal to the villain's stage number.

cards.name: Assess the Situation
cards.text: Action: You get +1 hand size until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: "Well, if I run, that's not cool. And if I stay and get tasered, that's not cool either. I'm in a bit of a pickle." —Tony Stark

cards.name: Wasp
cards.text: Small but Mighty — Response: After Wasp (or an event you play) defeats a minion or side scheme, deal 1 damage to the villain.
cards.flavor: "You should learn to play nice!"

cards.name: Nadia Van Dyne
cards.text: G.I.R.L. — Action: Shuffle up to 2 cards with a printed [mental] resource from your discard pile into your deck. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "G.I.R.L. is dedicated to finding brilliant women who will not only save the world, but change it."

cards.name: Wasp
cards.text:
[star] Threat you remove using your basic thwart power (THW) can be divided among schemes as you choose.
[star] Damage you deal using your basic attack power (ATK) can be divided among enemies as you choose.
cards.flavor: "Aww, you're all so tiny and cute."

cards.name: Ant-Man
cards.text:
While you are in [[Giant]] hero form, Ant-Man gains the [[Giant]] trait and gets +1 ATK.
While you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, Ant-Man gains the [[Tiny]] trait and gets +1 THW.

cards.name: Giant Help
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme (remove a total of 4 threat divided among schemes as you choose instead if you are in [[Giant]] hero form).
cards.flavor: "Glad to be of service!" —Wasp

cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 7 damage to an enemy. If you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, this attack deals 1 additional damage to that enemy and gains overkill.
cards.flavor: "You're going to want to ice that in the morning." —Wasp

cards.name: Rapid Growth
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When you use one of your hero's basic powers (THW, ATK, or DEF), change to your [[Giant]] hero form and get +2 to that power for this use.
cards.flavor: "Bet you didn't expect to see that." —Wasp

cards.text: Hero Action (attack): If you are in [[Giant]] hero form, deal a total of 4 damage divided among enemies you choose. Hero Action (attack): If you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, deal 5 damage to an enemy.

cards.text: While you are in [[Giant]] hero form, you gain retaliate 1. While you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, your basic attacks gain piercing. (Discard any tough status cards from the target before dealing damage.)

cards.name: Bio-Synthetic Wings
cards.text: Wasp gains the [[Aerial]] trait. Interrupt: When you would take any amount of damage, if you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, exhaust Bio-Synthetic Wings → prevent 1 of that damage.

cards.name: Wasp's Helmet
cards.text:
While you are in [[Giant]] hero form, you get +1 THW.
While you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, you get +1 ATK.

cards.name: Thor
cards.text: Response: After you play Thor from your hand, deal 2 damage to the villain (3 damage instead if you paid for this card using a [physical] resource).
cards.flavor: "You wanna eat my hammer? Then by all means, take a big bite!"

cards.name: Wasp
cards.text: Wasp gets +1 hit point for each pym counter on her. Interrupt: When Wasp enters play, place 1 pym counter on her (to a maximum of 3) for each [energy] resource you overpaid for Wasp's cost.

Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Each ally you control gets +1 ATK.
cards.flavor: "YOU CALL THAT A PUSHUP! MY GRANDMOTHER DOES BETTER PUSHUPS!"

cards.name: Lie in Wait
cards.text: Max 1 per player. Hero Response (attack): After a minion engages you, discard Lie in Wait → deal 3 damage to that minion.

cards.name: Ironheart
cards.text: Response: After you play Ironheart from your hand, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "I'm totally going to be like Tony Stark! Except for that weird facial hair."

cards.name: Spider-Man
cards.text: Response: After you play Spider-Man from your hand, choose THW or ATK. Spider-Man gets +2 to the chosen power until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: "I'm needed. And just like that, none of the rest of it matters."

cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait. Resource: Exhaust Quincarrier → generate a [wild] resource.
cards.flavor: "Too bad we could only get one of these." —Hawkeye

cards.text: Give to the Nadia Van Dyne player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Exhaust Nadia Van Dyne → remove Red Dreams from the game. • Discard each card with a printed [mental] resource from your hand and take 1 damage. Discard this obligation.

cards.name: Mother's Orders
cards.text: As an additional cost for each hero to make a basic attack, that hero must spend 1 of any resource.
cards.flavor: Mother has sent one of her most devious henchmen after Wasp, hoping to recapture the Red Room escapee.

cards.name: Beetle
cards.text: Guard. Forced Interrupt: When Beetle is defeated, choose to either spend a [physical] resource or shuffle Beetle into the encounter deck. (Wasp's nemesis minion.)

cards.name: Beetle Armor MK IV
cards.text:
Attach to Beetle, if able. If you cannot, attach to the villain.
Attached Character gets +4 hit points.
cards.flavor: "Ugh, why can't I ever find anything around here?" —Janice Lincoln

cards.name: Beetle Mania
cards.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): This card gains surge. When Revealed (Hero): Beetle attacks you with +1 ATK. If no attack was made this way, this card gains surge.
cards.flavor: "I was waiting for this moment to arise." —Beetle

cards.name: Running Interference
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait. Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from the main scheme. Remove X additional threat from the main scheme (to a maximum of 3), where X is equal to the villain's stage number.

cards.name: Perseverance
cards.text: Hero Response: After you change form, give your hero a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "You do know the front door is unlocked, right?" —Spider-Man

cards.name: Athletic Conditioning
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard 1 stun or confuse status card from your hero.
cards.flavor: "Don't worry, the ringing in your ears will go away... eventually." —Nadia Van Dyne

cards.name: Quicksilver

cards.flavor: "Super speed. Look it up."

cards.name: Always Be Running

cards.flavor: "I'm the fastest man on Earth." —Quicksilver

cards.name: Double Time
cards.text: Hero Action: Choose two of the following (you may choose the same option twice): - Deal 2 damage to an enemy. - Remove 2 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Maximum Velocity
cards.text: Max 1 per phase. Hero Action: You get +2 THW, +2 ATK, and +2 DEF until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "Ever been punched at supersonic speed?" —Quicksilver

cards.name: Speed Cyclone
cards.text: Hero Action: Stun X Enemies.
cards.flavor: "Eat my dust." —Quicksilver

cards.name: Serval Industries
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Serval Industries → shuffle 2 Quicksilver cards from your discard pile into your deck.
cards.flavor: Corporate sponsors of the superhero team known as X-Factor.

cards.name: Accelerated Reflex
cards.text: Quicksilver gets +1 DEF.
cards.flavor: "Is that all you got?" —Quicksilver

cards.name: Friction Resistance
cards.text: Hero Response: After you ready Quicksilver, ready this card. Resource: Exhaust Friction Resistance → generate a [physical] resource.

cards.name: Hyper Perception
cards.text: Quicksilver gets +1 THW.
cards.flavor: "Surely you can do better than that." —Quicksilver

cards.name: Reinforced Sinew

cards.flavor: "The future is written by the winners." —Quicksilver

cards.flavor: "Who wants a sandwich?!"

cards.name: Warlock
cards.text: Action: Spend a [mental] resource → heal up to 2 damage from Warlock.
cards.flavor: "Self thinks this is a mistake. But then, self is very young and knows very little."

cards.name: Never Back Down
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you defend against an attack, you get +2 DEF for this attack. If you take no damage from this attack, stun the attacking enemy.
cards.flavor: "Champions, charge!" —Ms. Marvel

cards.name: Side Step
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage, prevent 3 of that damage. If you paid for this card using [energy] resource, deal 1 damage to that enemy.
cards.flavor: "Missed me!" —Wasp

cards.name: Armored Vest
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Your hero gets +1 DEF.
cards.flavor: Life-saving and stylish.

cards.name: Nerves of Steel
cards.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Resource: Exhaust Nerves of Steel → generate a [energy] resource for a [[Defense]] event.

cards.name: Order and Chaos

cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.flavor: "Wow, lady! And I thought Gamora was intense." —Rocket Raccoon

cards.name: Gjallerbru
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. Victory 3. When Defeated: The first player reveals Hall of Nastrond and Nidhogg, and puts them into play. Deal each other player 1 facedown encounter card.

cards.name: Garm
cards.text: Toughness. Victory 2. Garm engages the first player. Threat cannot be removed from Gnipahellir.

cards.name: Skurge
cards.text: Toughness. Victory 3. Skurge engages the first player. [star] Skurge's attacks gain piercing. Threat cannot be removed from Gjallerbru.

cards.name: Nidhogg
cards.text: Toughness. Victory 4. Nidhogg engages the first player. [star] Nidhogg's attacks gain overkill. Threat cannot be removed from Hall of Nastrond.

cards.name: Nightsword
cards.text:
Attach to Hela. [star] Hela's attacks gain piercing.
[star] Boost: Attach Nightsword to Hela.

cards.name: Hela's Crown
cards.text:
Attach to Hela. [star] Forced Response: After Hela schemes, give her a facedown boost card.
[star] Boost: Attach Hela's Crown to Hela.

cards.name: Hela's Cloak
cards.text:
Attach to Hela. Hela gains stalwart.
[star] Boost: Attach Hela's Cloak to Hela.

cards.name: Hela's Domain
cards.text:
When Revealed: Place 1 threat on the main scheme. Place 1 additional threat on the main scheme for each side scheme in the victory display.
[star] Boost: If damage from this attach defeats an ally, place 2 threat on the main scheme.

cards.name: The Queen of Hel
cards.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Hela schemes. Place 1 threat on each side scheme. When Revealed (Hero): Hela attacks you. Place 1 threat on each side scheme.

cards.name: The Wastes of Niffleheim
cards.text:
When Revealed: Take 1 indirect damage. Take 1 additional indirect damage for each side scheme in the victory display.
[star] Boost: This card gains boost icons ([boost]) equal to the number of side schemes in the victory display.

cards.name: Draugr
cards.text: Guard. When Revealed: Choose to either take 1 damage or place 1 threat on the main scheme.

cards.name: Fallen Warrior
cards.text: Treat attached ally as an [[Undead]] minion with a blank text box. Attached minions SCH is equal to its printed THW and it does not take consequential damage. When Revealed: Discard cards from top of your deck until you discard an ally. Put that ally into play engaged with you with Fallen Warrior attached to it

cards.name: No Place for the Living
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must choose to either discard the upgrade or support they control with the highest cost, or take damage equal to the total number of upgrades and supports they control.

cards.name: Legions of Hel
cards.text: When Revealed: Place 2 additional threat here for each [[undead]] minion in play. If there are no [[undead]] minions in play, this card gains surge.

cards.name: Laufey
cards.text: Toughness. [star] Forced Response: After Laufey attacks and damages a character, stun that character.

cards.name: Frost Giant
cards.text:
Toughness. (This character enters play with a tough status card.)
[star] Boost: If the villain is attacking and this attack deals damage to a character, stun that character.

cards.name: Frozen
cards.text: Attack to your identity Attached identity cannot ready. Alter-Ego Action: Spend [energy] [physical] resources → discard this card.

cards.name: Unnatural Storm
cards.text: Heroes and allies cannot be readied by player card effects. When Revealed: Exhaust each ally in play.

cards.name: Loki
cards.text: Victory 1. Loki cannot take damage while a side scheme is in play. When Defeated: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side scheme is discarded. Reveal that side scheme.

cards.name: Loki
cards.text: Retaliate 1. Victory 1. When Defeated: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side scheme is discarded. Reveal that side scheme.

cards.name: Loki
cards.text: Stalwart. Victory 1. When Defeated: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side scheme is discarded. Reveal that side scheme.

cards.name: Loki
cards.text: Stalwart. Victory 1. When Defeated: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side scheme is discarded. Reveal that side scheme.

cards.name: Loki
cards.text: Victory 1. [star] Loki's attacks gain piercing. When Defeated: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side scheme is discarded. Reveal that side scheme.

cards.name: All Hail King Loki
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When Loki is defeated, advance to a random set-aside Loki villain. If the number of Lokis in the victory display is equal to the victory condition, the players win the game. (See rule insert.) If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.
cards.backText: Contents: Loki, Infinity Gauntlet, and Standard encounter sets. Two modular encounter sets. (Enchantress and Frost Giants). Setup: Set each copy of the Loki villain aside, out of play. Put the War in Asgard side scheme into play. Shuffle the encounter deck. Reveal 1 set-aside Loki villain at random. Reveal the top card of the [[infinity stone]] deck.

cards.name: All Hail King Loki
cards.text: Contents: Loki, Infinity Gauntlet, and Standard encounter sets. Two modular encounter sets. (Enchantress and Frost Giants). Setup: Set each copy of the Loki villain aside, out of play. Put the War in Asgard side scheme into play. Shuffle the encounter deck. Reveal 1 set-aside Loki villain at random. Reveal the top card of the [[infinity stone]] deck.

cards.name: All Hail King Loki
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When Loki is defeated, advance to a random set-aside Loki villain. If the number of Lokis in the victory display is equal to the victory condition, the players win the game. (See rule insert.) If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Casket of Ancient Winters
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero] When Defeated: Reveal the top card of the [[infinity stone]] deck. Swap Loki with a random set-aside Loki villain.

cards.name: War in Asgard
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero] When Defeated: Reveal the top card of the [[infinity stone]] deck. Swap Loki with a random set-aside Loki villain.

cards.name: Madness on Midgard
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero] When Defeated: Reveal the top card of the [[infinity stone]] deck. Swap Loki with a random set-aside Loki villain.

cards.name: Open the Bifrost
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero] When Defeated: Reveal the top card of the [[infinity stone]] deck. Swap Loki with a random set-aside Loki villain.

cards.name: Loki's Staff
cards.text:
Attach to Loki. Hero Response: After you make a basic attack against Loki, spend [energy] [physical] resources → discard this card.
[star] Boost: Attack this card to Loki.

cards.name: Loki's Crown
cards.text:
Attach to Loki. Hero Response: After you make a basic attack against Loki, spend [mental] [physical] resources → discard this card.
[star] Boost: Attach this card to Loki.

cards.name: Loki's Cape
cards.text: Attach to Loki. Forced Response: After Loki is swapped with a set-aside Loki villain, give him a tough status card. Hero Response: After you make a basic attack against Loki, spend [energy] [mental] resources → discard this card.

cards.name: Master of Illusions
cards.text: Attach to Loki. Forced Interrupt: When Loki would take damage from an attack, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is a treachery, prevent all damage from this attack and discard this card.

cards.name: Devious Sorcery
cards.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): You are stunned. If you were already stunned, place 2 threat on the main scheme. When Revealed (Hero): You are stunned. If you were already stunned, take 2 damage.

cards.name: Infinite Mischief
cards.text:
When Revealed: Shuffle the [[infinity stone]] deck discard pile into the [[infinity stone]] deck and reveal the top card.
[star] Boost: Discard the top card of the [[infinity stone]] deck. Apply it's boost icons [boost] for this activation as if it were a boost card.

cards.name: The Trickster
cards.text:
When Revealed: Swap Loki with a random set-aside Loki villain. Loki activates against you.
[star] Boost: Give Loki an additional boost card and a tough status card.

cards.name: Enchantress
cards.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and set-aside area for a copy of Seduced and attach it to your identity. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Beguiled
cards.text: Treat attached ally as an [[Enthralled]] minion with a blank text box. Attached minion's SCH is equal to its printed THW and it does not take consequential damage. When Revealed: Attach to the ally with the highest cost without Beguiled attached. Attached ally engages its controller. Otherwise, this card gains surge.

cards.name: Seduced
cards.text: Attach to your identity. You cannot make basic attacks or play [[Attack]] events. Alter-Ego Action: Spend [energy] [mental] resources → discard this card.

cards.name: Secure the Landing Pad
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: Flip this card over.
cards.flavor: Cosmo and the Knowhere Corps do their best to prevent more Black Order forces from landing on the station, but they need help!

cards.name: Cosmo
cards.text: The first player gains control of Cosmo. Cosmo does not count against the ally limit. Forced Interrupt: When Cosmo leaves play, remove him from the game.

cards.name: Security Breach
cards.text: Hinder 2[per_hero]. Victory 2. When Revealed: Each player places a random card from their hand facedown here. When Defeated: Return each facedown card here to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Save the Shawarma Place
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: Each player shuffles 1 copy of Shawarma into their deck. Flip this card over.
cards.flavor: Black Order soldiers run rampant through the city around Avengers Tower, threatening the heroes' favorite restaurant.

cards.name: Black Swan
cards.text: Toughness. Victory 2. Black Swan engages the first player. Forced Response: After Black Swan engages you, discard 1 card from your hand.
cards.flavor: "Everything dies."

cards.name: Shawarma
cards.flavor: "Have any of you ever tried shawarma?" —Tony Stark

cards.name: Hack Sanctuary's Computer
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: Each player searches their deck and discard pile for 1 card, adds it to their hand, and shuffles their deck. Flip this card over.
cards.flavor: In order to defeat Thanos, you must deactivate his ship's many defenses.

cards.name: Defensive Protocols
cards.text: Hinder 2[per_hero]. Victory 2. Forced Interrupt: When the player phase ends, place 1 crash counter here. If there are 2 crash counters here, each player adds 1 copy of the System Shock obligation card to their hand. Remove this card from the game.
cards.flavor: You've accidentally tripped Sanctuary's failsafe program!

cards.name: System Shock
cards.text: You cannot choose to discard this card from your hand. While this card is in your hand, it gains: "Alter-Ego Action: Spend a [mental] resource → remove this card from the game."

cards.name: Find the Norn Stones
cards.text: Threat cannot be removed from this scheme unless Hela has the [[Wounded]] trait. When Defeated: Each player puts a copy of the Norn Stone upgrade into play under their control on its setup side. Flip this card over.

cards.name: Retrieve Odin's Armor
cards.text: Hinder 2[per_hero]. Victory 1. Threat cannot be removed from this scheme unless the first player controls Odin. When Defeated: Heal all damage from Odin and flip him to his King side.
cards.flavor: You've rescued Odin, but Hela still holds his armor in a secure vault.

cards.name: Norn Stone
cards.text: Permanent. Setup. Your hero gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, and +1 DEF. Hero Action: Ready your hero. Flip this card over.

cards.name: Norn Stone
cards.text: Permanent. Your hero gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, and +1 DEF. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Norn Stone to heal 1 damage from your identity.

cards.name: Summoned Back
cards.text: Peril. Surge. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and set-aside area for your nemesis minion and put it into play engaged with you. Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Open the Dungeons
cards.text: When Defeated: Each player chooses 1 [[Captive]] ally from the campaign set and puts it into play under their control. Flip this card over.
cards.flavor: Sif and the Warriors Three have been imprisoned by the usurper, Loki. They would be valuable allies if rescued!

cards.name: Jormungand
cards.text: Attach to Loki. Loki gets +4[per_hero] hit points. Forced Interrupt: When Loki is defeated, remove this card from the game.

cards.name: Lady Sif
cards.text: Action: Spend a [physical] resource → ready Lady Sif.
cards.flavor: "Was ever a maiden faced with a problem such as this?"

cards.name: Fandral
cards.text: [star] When Fandral uses his basic THW, ignore any crisis icons ([crisis]) in play.
cards.flavor: "Though I hold life most dear, I will answer Loki for what he has done."

cards.name: Hogun
cards.text: [star] Hogun's attacks gain piercing.
cards.flavor: "Loki has gone too far this time. He must be ended."

cards.name: Volstagg
cards.text: Retaliate 1. (After this character is attacked, deal 1 damage to the attacking character.) Toughness. (This character enters play with a tough status card.)
cards.flavor: "The mighty Volstagg will right these wrongs!"

cards.name: Nebula
cards.text: Combat Protocols - Forced Response: After your turn begins, resolve the "Special" ability on each [[technique]] upgrade you control, then discard each [[technique]] upgrade resolved this way.

cards.name: Nebula
cards.text: Cybernetic Upgrades - Response: After you play a technique upgrade, draw 2 cards. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "Thanos built me for one purpose: To kill. In time, he will regret that."

cards.name: Gamora
cards.text: Response: After you play Gamora, choose a [[technique]] upgrade you control, then resolve its "Special" ability.
cards.flavor: "Thanos trained us both for the same purpose."

cards.name: Nebula's Ship
cards.text: Resource: Exhaust Nebula's Ship → generate a [wild] resource.
cards.flavor: "I liked it better when I was the one targeting your ship." —Gamora

cards.name: Cutthroat Ambition
cards.text: While Nebula is in hero form, her attacks gain piercing and overkill. Special (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "I am every bit the warrior you are!" —Nebula

cards.name: Evasive Maneuvering
cards.text: While in hero form, Nebula ignores the guard keyword, the patrol keyword, and the crisis icon. Special : Choose to either stun or confuse an enemy.

cards.name: Unyielding Persistence
cards.text: While in hero form, Nebula gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, and gains stalwart. Special : Give Nebula a tough status card.

cards.name: Weapons Master
cards.text: While in hero form, Nebula gains retaliate 1. Special (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Wide Stance
cards.text: While Nebula is in hero form, reduce the amount of damage she takes from each attack by 1. Special : Look at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Discard 1 and put the others back in any order.

cards.name: Combat Ready
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Choose one: Shuffle up to 2 [[technique]] upgrades from your discard pile into your deck. Discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard a [[technique]] upgrade. Put that upgrade into play, then resolve its "Special" ability.

cards.name: Lethal Intent
cards.text: Hero Action: Choose up to X [[technique]] upgrades you control. Resolve each of their "Special" abilities (in the order of your choice).
cards.flavor: "The Guardians were wise to fear me, and even smarter to hire me on." —Nebula

cards.name: Eros
cards.text: Response: After you play Eros from your hand, confuse a minion for each [mental] resource you used to pay for him.
cards.flavor: "This will not be easy, but we will save this universe...we will guard this galaxy."

cards.name: Wraith
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When a boost card is turned faceup, exhaust Wraith and deal 1 damage to him → cancel that card's "Boost" effect.
cards.flavor: "Do not despair: Destiny makes slaves of us all."

cards.name: Venom
cards.text: While there is no threat on the main scheme, reduce all consequential damage Venom takes by 1.
cards.flavor: "So much for doing this the easy way."

cards.name: Justice Served
cards.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Hero Response: After you thwart and remove the last threat from a scheme, discard Justice Served → ready your hero.

cards.name: One Way or Another
cards.text: Max 1 per round. Hero Action: Search the encounter deck for a side scheme. Reveal that side scheme → draw 3 cards (shuffle the encounter deck).

cards.name: Determination
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Response: After you spend this card, remove 1 threat from the main scheme.

cards.name: The Power of Justice
cards.text: Max 2 per deck. Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Justice (yellow) card.

cards.name: Brains Over Brawn
cards.text: Hero Response (attack): After your hero makes a basic thwart, deal damage to an enemy equal to your hero's THW.
cards.flavor: Despite his incredible strength, Spider-Man often triumphs by outwitting his foes.

cards.name: Heroic Intuition
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Your hero gets +1 THW.

cards.name: Cosmo
cards.text: Interrupt: When Cosmo attacks or thwarts, name a card type, then discard the top card of a player deck or the encounter deck. If that card is of the named type, Cosmo does not take consequential damage for this use.

cards.name: Knowhere
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[guardian]] trait. Increase your ally limit by 1. Response: After a player plays a [[guardian]] ally, exhaust Knowhere → that player draws 1 card.

cards.name: Daughters of Thanos
cards.text: Team-Up (Gamora and Nebula). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: "Thanos pitted us against each other as children, but now we are sisters. United at last." —Gamora

cards.name: First Aid
cards.text: Action: Heal 2 damage from any character.
cards.flavor: "Does it still qualify as first aid if it's your second day in the hospital?" —Clint Barton

cards.name: Energy
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Genius
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Strength
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Inferiority Complex
cards.text: Give to Nebula player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Exhaust your alter-ego → remove Inferiority Complex from the game. • Choose and discard 2 [[Technique]] upgrades you control. If no upgrade was discarded this way, this card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

cards.name: Gamora
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When this minion would enter play, discard the Gamora ally from play. [star] Forced Response: After Gamora attacks and damages you, choose and discard an upgrade you control. (Nebula's nemesis minion.)

cards.name: Self-Preservation
cards.text:
Nebula gets -1 THW, -1 ATK, and -1 DEF.
Gamora gets +1 ATK and her attacks gain piercing.
cards.flavor: "We both did what we had to in order to survive. Why won't you let it go?" —Gamora

cards.name: Lethal Weapon
cards.text: Attach to Gamora. If you cannot, attach to the villain. Hero Action: Discard an upgrade you control → discard this attachment.
cards.flavor: "There's only one 'Most Dangerous Woman in the Galaxy', and that's me!" —Gamora

cards.name: Old Rivals
cards.text: When Revealed: Gamora attacks you. If the Gamora hero or ally is in play, she attacks you (resolve her ATK against you without exhausting her). If no attack was made this way, this card gains surge.
cards.flavor: "This was a mistake." —Gamora

cards.name: Energy Spear
cards.text:
Attach to a [[guardian]] ally. Max 1 per ally.
Attached ally gets +2 ATK and gains piercing.

cards.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
cards.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 [[team]] card per player. If each of your characters has the [[guardian]] trait, this card gains: "Response: After you play an upgrade on an ally, draw 1 card."

cards.name: Defensive Training
cards.text: Max 2 per deck. Uses (2 training counters). Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 training counter from this → choose a Protection (green) event in your discard pile and shuffle it into your deck.

cards.name: Honorary Guardian
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[guardian]] trait.
Attach to a friendly character. Max 1 per character.
Attached character gets +1 hit point and gains the [[guardian]] trait.

cards.name: War Machine
cards.text: Locked and Loaded - Response: After you change to this form, place 5 ammo counters on War Machine.
cards.flavor: "Boom! Looking for this?" —James Rhodes

cards.name: James Rhodes
cards.text: Action: Choose a War Machine card in your discard pile and shuffle it into your deck. (Limit once per phase.) Forced Response: After you change to this form, discard each ammo counter from your identity.

cards.name: Iron Man
cards.text: Response: After Iron Man enters play, search your deck and discard pile for a [[tech]] upgrade and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "What did you do to my suit, Rhodey?"

cards.name: Munitions Bunker
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Munitions Bunker → Place 2 ammo counters here. Hero Action: Exhaust Munitions Bunker → move each ammo counter here to War Machine.

cards.name: Upgraded Chassis
cards.text: War Machine gains the [[aerial]] trait. Hero Response: After you change to hero form, exhaust Upgraded Chassis → give War Machine a tough status card.

cards.name: Gauntlet Gun
cards.text: Resource: Exhaust Gauntlet Gun → generate a [wild] resource for a War Machine event and place 1 ammo counter on War Machine.
cards.flavor: "Time to see what these babies can do." —James Rhodes

cards.name: Missile Launcher
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Missile Launcher and remove 1 ammo counter from War Machine → deal 2 damage to an enemy. This attack gains ranged.

cards.name: Shoulder Cannon
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Shoulder Cannon → deal 1 damage to an enemy. You may remove 1 ammo from War Machine to ready shoulder cannon.
cards.flavor: RATATATATAT!

cards.name: Repulsor Beam
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Remove 1 ammo counter from War Machine → deal 4 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Oh, you want some too?" —James Rhodes

cards.name: Targeted Strike
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 1 ammo counter from War Machine → remove 3 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "This is the part where you surrender!" —James Rhodes

cards.name: Scorched Earth
cards.text: Hero Action: Remove 3 ammo counters from War Machine → deal 3 damage to each enemy in play.
cards.flavor: "I say we lift off and strafe the site from the air. It's the only way to be sure." —James Rhodes

cards.name: Full Auto
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Remove 4 ammo counters from War Machine and choose an enemy → deal 8 damage to that enemy. This attack gains overkill.
cards.flavor: "Hey, Tony! Let me see your Mark V do this!" —James Rhodes

cards.name: Black Panther
cards.text: You may play the event attached to Black Panther as if it were in your hand. Response: After Black Panther enters play, choose a leadership (blue) event in your discard pile and attach it to him facedown.

cards.name: Captain Marvel
cards.text: Response: After Captain Marvel enters play, discard the top 4 cards of your deck. If you discard a printed [energy] resource, deal 3 damage to an enemy. If you discard more than one printed [energy] resource, also stun that enemy.

cards.name: Falcon
cards.text: Response: After Falcon enters play, look at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. For each treachery looked at this way, remove 1 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Goliath
cards.text: Action: Goliath gets +4 ATK until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase, discard Goliath. (Max once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "Sometimes being a gentleman means holding the door, and the rest of the building."

cards.name: Command Team
cards.text: Uses (3 command counters). Action: Exhaust Command Team and remove 1 command counter from it → ready an ally.

cards.name: Sneak Attack
cards.text: Action: Choose an ally in your hand that shares a [[trait]] with your identity → put that ally into play. If that ally is still in play at the end of the phase, discard it.
cards.flavor: "Surprise!" —Star-Lord

cards.name: Save the Day
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard an ally your control → remove threat from a scheme equal to that ally's printed cost.
cards.flavor: "There are days, and boy, is this ever one of those days!" —Spider-Man

cards.name: Go Down Swinging
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard an ally your control → deal damage to an enemy equal to that ally's printed cost.
cards.flavor: "Spider-Man's banter can get on your nerves, but I tell you what - that kid never quits." —Captain America

cards.name: Make the Call
cards.text: Action: Pay the printed cost of an ally in any player's discard pile → put that ally into play under your control.
cards.flavor: "This is a code red! All hands on deck!" —Maria Hill

cards.name: Innovation
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Response: After you spend this card, heal 1 damage from an ally you control.

cards.name: Mockingbird
cards.text: Response: After Mockingbird enters play, stun an enemy.

cards.name: Quincarrier
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait. Resource: Exhaust Quincarrier → generate a [wild] resource.
cards.flavor: "Too bad we could only get one of these." —Hawkeye

cards.name: Two Against the World
cards.text: Team-Up (Iron Man and War Machine). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Search your deck for a [[tech]] upgrade and put it into play. Shuffle your deck. Ready Iron Man and War Machine.

cards.name: Energy
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Genius
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Strength
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Equipment Malfunction
cards.text: Give to the James Rhodes player. You may flip to your alter-ego form. Choose: • Exhaust James Rhodes → remove Equipment Malfunction from the game. • Remove all ammo counters from your identity. If 2 or fewer ammo counters were removed this way, this card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

cards.name: Living Laser
cards.text: Quickstrike. [star] Living Laser's attacks gain piercing. (War Machine's nemesis minion.)
cards.flavor: "You and Stark - you both have it coming!"

cards.name: Deadly Light Show
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero] When Defeated: Deal 1 damage to each identity.
cards.flavor: Living Laser is attacking a government office. The employees inside need help!

cards.name: Laser Strike
cards.text:
When Revealed: Discard an upgrade you control. If you cannot, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: If this resolves during an undefended attack, discard an upgrade you control.

cards.name: As One!
cards.text: Alliance. Hero Action (attack): Exhaust an [[avenger]] character and a [[guardian]] character → deal X damage to an enemy, where X is the combined ATK of those characters. This attack gains overkill.

cards.name: Vigilante Training
cards.text: Max 2 per deck. Uses (2 training counters). Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 training counter from it → choose a justice (yellow) event in your discard pile and shuffle it into your deck.

cards.name: Stand Together
cards.text: Alliance. Hero Interrupt: When a friendly character would take any amount of damage from an attack, exhaust an [[avenger]] character and a [[guardian]] character → prevent all of that damage. Deal that much damage to the attacking enemy.

cards.name: Sidearm
cards.text:
Attach to an ally. Max 1 per ally.
Attached ally gets +1 ATK and its attacks gain ranged.
cards.flavor: "Wow! Cool costume, mister!" —Kid

cards.name: The Hood
cards.text: Foul Play - Special: Discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card does not belong to The Hood encounter set, deal it to yourself as a facedown encounter card.
cards.flavor: "If you're not with me, you're on your own"

cards.name: The Hood
cards.text: When Revealed: Choose 1 set-aside modular encounter set at random, then shuffle it into the encounter deck. Foul Play - Special: Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. Deal the first card discarded this way that does not belong to The Hood encounter set to yourself as a facedown encounter card.

cards.name: The Hood
cards.text: When Revealed: Choose 1 set-aside modular encounter set at random, then shuffle it into the encounter deck. Foul Play - Special: Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. Deal each card discarded this way that does not belong to The Hood encounter set to yourself as a facedown encounter card.

cards.name: Making Connections
