cards.flavor: "Amazing. It's everything dad talked about. The speed. The power. It's like being a human rocket!" —Nova

cards.name: Pot Shot
cards.text: Double the number of [wild] resources generated while paying for this card. Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "That never gets old." —Nova

cards.name: Unleash Nova Force
cards.text: Max 1 per round. Hero Action: Until the end of the round, each time Nova defeats an enemy or removes the last threat from a scheme, ready Nova and draw 1 card.

cards.name: Connection to the Worldmind
cards.text: Connection to the Worldmind does not count toward your hand size.

cards.name: Jesse Alexander
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Jesse Alexander → shuffle 1 copy of Connection to the Worldmind from your discard pile into your deck. Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "I wasn't always there, but I always believed in you."

cards.name: Supernova Helmet
cards.text: Nova gains the [[Aerial]] trait. Hero Resource: Exhaust Supernova Helmet → generate a [wild] resource.
cards.flavor: "The helmet can hear what I'm thinking and that makes it do... stuff." —Sam Alexander

cards.name: The Locust
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[champion]] trait. Hero Response: After The Locust enters play, add 1 Aggression (red) event from your discard pile to your hand.

cards.name: Chase Them Down
cards.text: Response (thwart): After your hero attacks and defeats an enemy, remove 2 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "Kamala, we don't have a theme song. Please stop humming one..." —Captain Marvel

cards.name: Pitchback
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Aerial]] trait. Hero Response (attack): After your hero attacks, deal 4 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: No Quarter
cards.text: Requirement ([physical]). Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. For each point of excess damage dealt to that enemy by this attack, discard the top card of your deck and add each Aggression (red) card discarded this way to your hand.

cards.name: One by One
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. If this attack defeats that enemy, deal 2 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Lots of tricks up these sleeves, ladies and gentlemen." —Moon Girl

cards.name: The Power of Aggression
cards.text: Max 2 per deck. Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Aggression (red) card.

cards.name: Fluid Motion
cards.text: Hero Response: After you play an [[Attack]] event, exhaust this card → your hero gets +1 ATK until the end of the phase. (Max 1 per [[Attack]] event.)

cards.name: Honed Technique
cards.text: Requirement ([mental][mental]). Max 1 per player. Interrupt: When you play an Aggression [[Attack]] event, if you paid for that event using a [mental] resource, increase the amount of damage that event deals by its printed cost.

cards.name: Moon Girl
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[champion]] or [[genius]] trait. Response: After you play Moon Girl from your hand, draw 1 card for each [mental] resource used to pay for her.

cards.name: Everyday Hero
cards.text: While your identity has the [[Civilian]] trait, this card can be spent for any player and gains the text: "Response: After you spend this card for a player, heal 1 damage from that player's identity."

cards.name: Champions Mobile Bunker
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Champions Mobile Bunker → choose an identity with the [[champion]] trait. The player who controls that identity may draw 2 cards, then discard 2 cards from their hand.

cards.name: Weight of the World
cards.text: Give to the Sam Alexander player. While this card is in play, Supernova Helmet cannot ready. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Sam Alexander → remove this obligation from the game.

cards.name: Warbringer
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Warbringer attacks you, he gets +1 ATK for that attack for each card with a printed [wild] resource in your hand. That attack gains overkill. (Nova's nemesis minion.)

cards.name: War Delivery
cards.text:
When Revealed: You may spend a [wild] resource. If you do not, the villain and Warbringer each attack you (even if you are in alter-ego form).
[star] Boost: Place 1 threat on the main scheme for each card with a printed [wild] resource in your hand.

cards.name: "The War's Been Brought"
cards.text: Surge. When Revealed: Discard X cards from the top of the encounter deck, where X is equal to the total number of printed [wild] resources on cards in your hand, cards under your control, and cards in your discard pile.

cards.name: Yaw and Roll
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Aerial]] trait. Hero Response (thwart): After your hero thwarts, remove 3 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Height Advantage
cards.text: While your identity has the [[Aerial]] trait, reduce the amount of damage you take from each enemy attack by 1. Forced Interrupt: When your turn begins, discard this card.

cards.name: Armored Assault
cards.text: Each enemy with a tough status card gets +3 ATK.
cards.flavor: Armadillo is barreling through the city, steamrolling everything in his path.

cards.name: Armadillo
cards.text: Toughness. Armadillo can have any number of tough status cards. [star] Forced Response: After Armadillo activates against you, give him a tough status card.

cards.name: Rollin', Rollin'
cards.text: Attach to Armadillo. If Armadillo is not in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for Armadillo, put him into play, engaged with you, and attach this card to him. (Shuffle.) [star] While Armadillo has a tough status card, characters cannot defend against his attacks.

cards.name: Tough and Tumble
cards.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Each enemy with a tough status card schemes. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge. When Revealed (Hero): Each enemy with a tough status card attacks you. If no enemy activated this way, this card gains surge.

cards.name: Tough It Out
cards.text: When Revealed: Give Armadillo and the villain each a tough status card. If 1 or fewer tough status cards were given this way, this card gains surge.
cards.flavor: "Don't hit too hard. Might break your hand." —Armadillo

cards.name: Ironheart
cards.text: Level Up! — Action: Remove 6 progress counters from Ironheart → ready her and swap her with [[Version 2]] Ironheart.
cards.flavor: "Time to try this untested bit of business..."

cards.name: Riri Williams
cards.text: Begin the game with this card. Set your other identities aside. (See insert.) Child Prodigy — Action: Spend a [mental] resource → place 1 progress counter on Riri Williams. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Ironheart
cards.text: Level Up! — Action: Remove 6 progress counters from Ironheart → ready her, give her a tough status card, and swap her with [[Version 3]] Ironheart.
cards.flavor: "It's Ironheart, bro."

cards.name: Riri Williams
cards.text: Child Prodigy — Action: Spend a [mental] resource or 2 resources of any type → place 1 progress counter on Riri Williams. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "Just let me finish this up, then I'll eat and frolic and do whatever."

cards.name: Ironheart
cards.text: Maximum Efficiency — Hero Action: Remove 1 progress counter from Ironheart → deal 2 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Oh, you wanna play, villain person? Let's play."

cards.name: Riri Williams
cards.text: Child Prodigy — Action: Spend 1 resource of any type → place 1 progress counter on Riri Williams. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I can build something lighter, faster, stronger."

cards.name: Brawn
cards.text: While Brawn is exhausted, he gains: "Resource: Generate a [mental] resource. (Limit once per phase.)"
cards.flavor: "No, I'm not Banner. I'm better."

cards.name: Fly Over
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme and place 1 progress counter on Ironheart (2 progress counters instead if this thwart removes the last threat from that scheme).
cards.flavor: VRROOOSSHH!

cards.name: Photon Beam
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy and place 1 progress counter on Ironheart (2 progress counters instead if this attack defeats that enemy).
cards.flavor: FSHHAAMMM!

cards.name: New and Improved
cards.text: Hero Action: Choose X different options, where X is equal to Ironheart's [[version]] number: • Search your deck for an Ironheart card and add it to your hand. (Shuffle.) • Give Ironheart a tough status card. • Ready Ironheart.

cards.name: Sector Scan
cards.text: Reduce the cost to play Sector Scan by X, where X is equal to Ironheart's [[version]] number. Hero Action: Until the end of the round, you may look at the top card of the encounter deck at any time.

cards.name: Stroke of Genius
cards.text: Response: After you spend this card, place 1 progress counter on your identity and draw 1 card.

cards.name: Ronnie Williams
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Ronnie Williams → choose: • Heal 2 damage from Riri Williams. • Place 1 progress counter on Riri Williams.

cards.name: Tony Stark A.I.
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Tony Stark A.I. → look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 to your hand and discard the other.
cards.flavor: "I downloaded my fabulous self into a digital frame in case my body was ever... you know, not working anymore."

cards.name: Photon Blasters
cards.text: You get +2 hit points. Hero Action: Exhaust Photon Blasters → deal damage to an enemy equal to Ironheart's [[Version]] number.

cards.name: Propulsion Jets
cards.text: You get +2 hit points. Hero Action: Exhaust Propulsion Jets → remove threat from a scheme equal to Ironheart's [[Version]] number.

cards.name: Cloud 9
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Cloud 9 → choose a player. Until the end of the phase, each [[Aerial]] character that player controls gets +1 THW.
cards.flavor: "I'm only here 'cause I wanna fly!"

cards.name: Falcon
cards.text: Hero Response: After Falcon attacks or thwarts, spend a [energy] resource → ready another [[champion]] character you control.
cards.flavor: "Hey, uh, it's Joaquín. I'm here to rescue you. And, uh, good thing, right?"

cards.name: Patriot
cards.text: Hero Response: After Patriot enters play, choose a [[champion]] character → that character gets +1 to each of its basic powers until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "I'm surrounded by those who risk their lives for principles most people take for granted."

cards.name: Go All Out
cards.text: Requirement ([energy]). (While paying for this card, spend the listed resources.) Hero Action (attack): Exhaust your hero → deal damage to an enemy equal to the total of your hero's THW, ATK, and DEF values.

cards.name: Push Ahead
cards.text: Requirement ([mental]). (While paying for this card, spend the listed resources.) Hero Action (thwart): Exhaust your hero → remove threat from a scheme equal to the total of your hero's THW, ATK, and DEF values.

cards.name: Morale Boost
cards.text: Hero Action: Choose a hero. Until the end of the round, that hero gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, and +1 DEF
cards.flavor: "This is a stand I need to take. This time, no compromises." —Sam Wilson

cards.name: R&D Facility
cards.text: Requirement ([mental][mental]). Uses (3 research counters). Hero Action: Exhaust R&D Facility and remove 1 research counter from it → choose a friendly character in play. That character gets +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the phase.

cards.name: The Power of Leadership
cards.text: Max 2 per deck. Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Leadership (blue) card.

cards.name: Agent 13
cards.text: [star] Response: After Agent 13 attacks or thwarts, choose a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] support → ready that support.
cards.flavor: "I bear the scars of the past all over me. But there's more to me than that. I'm better now. Stronger. Wiser."

cards.name: Snowguard
cards.text: Response: After Snowguard enters play, place up to 3 shift counters here. While the shift counters here are equal to (X), she gets: (1) +3 ATK and her attacks gain overkill. (2) +3 THW and gains the [[Aerial]] trait. (3) +5 hit points and gains retaliate 1.

cards.name: Vivian
cards.text: Hero Response: After Vivian enters play, choose an attachment, non-[[Elite]] minion, or non-permanent side scheme. Until the end of the round, treat that card's printed text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]).

cards.name: "Go for Champions!"
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Play only if your identity has the [[Champion]] trait. Hero Action: Remove "Go for Champions!" from the game → Each [[champion]] character in play cannot take damage until the end of the round.

cards.name: Helicarrier
cards.text: Max 1 per player. Action: Exhaust Helicarrier → choose a player. Reduce the resource cost of the next card that player plays this phase by 1.
cards.flavor: "A flying aircraft carrier? You're kidding, right?" —Jennifer Walters

cards.name: Ingenuity
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Genius]] trait. Max 1 per player. Resource: Exhaust Ingenuity → generate a [mental] resource.

cards.name: A Minor Setback
cards.text: Give to the Riri Williams player. Remove 1 progress counter from your identity, then discard this card. If no progress counter was removed this way, deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card, then shuffle this card into the encounter deck.

cards.name: Rule by Force
cards.text: While Lucia von Bardas is in play, this card gains a hazard icon ([hazard]). While Lucia von Bardas is not in play, this card gains an acceleration icon ([acceleration]).
cards.flavor: Lucia von Bardas has taken control of Latveria and will stop at nothing to prove the country's might once and for all.

cards.name: Lucia von Bardas
cards.text: While Lucia von Bardas has tough status card, she gets +1 SCH and +1 ATK. Forced Response: After the villain phase ends, give Lucia von Bardas a tough status card.

cards.name: Cyborg Tech
cards.text:
Attach to the minion with the most traits. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Attached minion gets +3 hit points and gains retaliate 1.
[star] Boost: Deal this card to yourself as a facedown encounter card.

cards.name: Political Retribution
cards.text: When Revealed: If Lucia von Bardas is in play, she schemes. If Rule by Force is in play, place 3 threat on it. If neither is in play, this card gains surge.

cards.name: Bombshell
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[Champion]] trait.
[star] Divide damage from Bombshell's attack among each enemy as evenly as possible.

cards.name: Wasp
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[Champion]] trait.
Wasp ignores the guard keyword, patrol keyword, and crisis icon ([crisis]).
cards.flavor: "Gotta find me first!"

cards.name: Pinpoint
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Champion]] trait. Hero Interrupt: When a player card would be placed into a discard pile from play, exhaust Pinpoint → shuffle that card into its owner's deck instead.

cards.name: Feedback Loop
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must place threat here equal to the total number [energy] resources in their hand and on cards they control
cards.flavor: Zzzax controls the city's power supply and is causing havoc within the system!

cards.name: Zzzax
cards.text:
[star] Zzzax gets +X ATK and +X hit points, where X is equal to the total number of [energy] resources on cards the engaged player controls.
[star] Boost: If you have at least [energy] [energy] resources in your hand, put Zzzax into play engaged with you.

cards.name: Haywire
cards.text: Attach to your identity. Treat the printed resource of each card in your hand as if it were [energy]. Hero Action: Choose to either discard a card you control with a printed [energy] resource or take 2 indirect damage → discard this card.

cards.name: Air Static
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase begins, deal 2 indirect damage to each player with a [energy] resource in their hand and/or on a card they control. Hero Action: Choose to either discard a card you control with a printed [energy] resource or take 2 indirect damage → discard this card.

cards.name: Zzzap!
cards.text: When Revealed: Take indirect damage equal to the total number of [energy] resources in your hand. If your identity was dealt 1 or fewer damage this way, this card gains surge.
cards.flavor: "Me Zzzax! You zzzap!"

cards.name: Spider-Ham
cards.text: Each toon counter on Spider-Ham can be spent as if it were a [wild] resource. Spider-Nonsense — Response: After Spider-Ham takes any amount of damage, place 1 toon counter on him.

cards.name: Peter Porker
cards.text: Cartoon Power — Response: After you make a basic recovery, place 1 toon counter on Peter Porker.
cards.flavor: "You ever feel as if someone else is in control, like you're just a character in a game?"

cards.name: Captain Americat
cards.text: Response: After Captain Americat enters play, give someone a high five. Place 1 toon counter on your identity and shuffle 1 Spider-Ham card from your discard pile into your deck.
cards.flavor: "I fight in purr-suit of justice and freedom!"

cards.name: Ham It Up
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 1 threat from a scheme for each toon counter on Spider-Ham.
cards.flavor: "Looks like pigs CAN fly!" —Spider-Ham

cards.name: Hogwashed
cards.text: Hero Action: Remove 1 toon counter from Spider-Ham → loudly read this card's flavor text. Choose to either deal 5 damage to a minion or remove 5 threat from a side scheme.
cards.flavor: POW! BAM! WHACK! SMACK! BOINK!

cards.name: "I Don't Think So!"
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When you reveal a card from the encounter deck, remove 1 toon counter from Spider-Ham → say "I don't think so!" in your best Spider-Ham voice. Cancel the effects of that card and discard it.

cards.name: Petulant Pig
cards.text: Hero Action: Stick your tongue out at the villain. The villain attacks you. Draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: "THBBPTHBPT!" —Spider-Ham

cards.name: Swinging Web Pig
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy. Confuse that enemy.
cards.flavor: "Am I a pig with the proportionate strength and agility of a spider? Or a spider with the physical limitations of a pig?" —Peter Porker

cards.name: The Daily Beagle
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust The Daily Beagle → place 1 toon counter on Peter Porker.
cards.flavor: "J. Jonah Jackal here with today's trusted, trademarked televised tirade—a tantrum tinged by a towering 'told you!'" —J. Jonah Jackal

cards.name: Cartoon Physics
cards.text: Interrupt: When your identity would take any amount of damage, discard this card → wiggle your body and prevent all but 1 of that damage.
cards.flavor: "Barely felt a thing…" —Spider-Ham

cards.name: Huge Wooden Hammer
cards.text: Spider-Ham gets +1 ATK. Hero Interrupt: When Spider-Ham makes a basic attack, exhaust Huge Wooden Hammer and remove 1 toon counter from Spider-Ham → Spider-Ham gets +2 ATK for that attack. That attack gains overkill.

cards.name: Organic Webbing
cards.text: Spider-Ham gets +1 THW. Hero Action: Exhaust Organic Webbing and remove 1 toon counter from Spider-Ham → ready Spider-Ham. He gains the [[Aerial]] trait until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Lady Spider
cards.text: [star] Response: After Lady Spider thwarts and removes threat from a scheme, if you control another [[Web-Warrior]] card, remove an equal amount of threat from a different scheme.
cards.flavor: "Let no one cage you."

cards.name: Spider-Man
cards.text: Response: After Spider-Man enters play, remove 1 threat from a scheme for each [[Web-Warrior]] card you control (including Spider-Man).
cards.flavor: "Villains from Ham's future. Gigantic robots now. Worlds in the Web are becoming entangled."

cards.name: Even the Odds
cards.text: Requirement ([energy]). Hero Action (thwart): Remove 1[per_hero] threat from each side scheme. Deal 1 damage to the villain for each side scheme defeated this way.

cards.name: Great Responsibility
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When any amount of threat would be placed on a scheme, you take it as damage instead.

cards.name: Making an Entrance
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When your hero makes a basic thwart, it gets +2 THW for that thwart. After that thwart ends, if your hero removed all threat from a scheme that way, heal 2 damage from your hero.

cards.name: One Way or Another
cards.text: Max 1 per round. Hero Action: Search the encounter deck for a side scheme. Reveal that side scheme → draw 3 cards (shuffle the encounter deck).

cards.name: Followed
cards.text: Attach to a side scheme. Max 1 per scheme. Interrupt: When attached scheme is defeated, deal 4 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Overwatch
cards.text: Attach to a scheme. Max 1 per scheme. Hero Interrupt: When any amount of threat is removed from attached scheme by a thwart, discard this card → remove an equal amount of threat from a different scheme.

cards.name: Scarlet Spider
cards.text: Play only if you control a [[Web-Warrior]] card. Interrupt: When you would reveal an encounter card, name a card type, then look at that card. If that card is of the named type, deal 1 damage to Scarlet Spider and draw 1 card.

cards.name: SP//dr
cards.text: Play only if you control a [[Web-Warrior]] card. When Defeated: Add SP//dr to your hand if she was defeated by taking excess consequential damage.

cards.name: Team-Building Exercise
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Team-Building Exercise → play a card from your hand that shares a trait with your hero, reducing its resource cost by 1.

cards.name: Web of Life and Destiny
cards.text: Ignore this card's resource cost if your identity has the [[Web-Warrior]] trait. Response: After a [[Web-Warrior]] ally leaves play, choose a player → that player draws 1 card.

cards.name: "I Really Want a Hot Dog!"
cards.text: Give to the Peter Porker player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Exhaust Peter Porker and remove 1 toon counter from him → remove "I Really Want a Hot Dog!" from the game. • You are stunned. If you are already stunned, this card gains surge. Discard this obligation.

cards.name: Nefarious Trap
cards.text: When Defeated: The Green Gobbler attacks the player who defeated this scheme. If The Green Gobbler is not in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for him and put him into play engaged with the player who defeated this scheme.

cards.name: The Green Gobbler
cards.text: Forced Response: After The Green Gobbler engages you, discard all counters from each card you control. (Spider-Ham's nemesis minion.)
cards.flavor: "I'll succeed by any means necessary, even if I must resort to fowl play!" —The Green Gobbler

cards.name: Gobbler Glider
cards.text:
Surge.
Attach to The Green Gobbler. If you cannot, attach to a minion.
Attached minion gains the [[Aerial]] trait.
cards.flavor: "Once I'm finished, I'll be at the top of the pecking order." —The Green Gobbler

cards.name: "Feast on This!"
cards.text: When Revealed: Take 2 damage. You are confused. If you already confused, this card gains surge.
cards.flavor: "I hope you left room for some pumpkin DIE!" —The Green Gobbler

cards.name: Warrior of the Great Web
cards.text: Attach to a character with "Spider" in its title. Max 1 per character. Attached character gains the [[Web-Warrior]] trait. Response: After a [[Web-Warrior]] ally leaves play, attached character gets +1 ATK until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Hunting the Spider-Totems
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase begins, discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Put each [[Inheritor]] minion discarded this way into play engaged with a player who controls a [[Web-Warrior]] character, if able. Otherwise, put each [[Inheritor]] minion discarded this way into play engaged with the first player.
cards.flavor: "there is no 'mission'. This is what we do—we hunt the spiders. It's our way." —Karn

cards.name: Bora
cards.text: Each [[Inheritor]] minion gains 1 acceleration icon ([acceleration]). When Revealed: If a [[Web-Warrior]] character is in play, place 1 threat on each scheme.
cards.flavor: "My dear brothers, let us devour them together!"

cards.name: Brix
cards.text: Each [[Inheritor]] minion gains patrol. When Revealed: If a [[Web-Warrior]] character is in play, place 2 threat on the main scheme.
cards.flavor: "In a twist of irony, the Web of Life and Destiny has brought us to this very moment. Your last moment."

cards.name: Daemos
cards.text: Each [[Inheritor]] minion gains stalwart. When Revealed: If a [[Web-Warrior]] character is in play, stun a character you control.
cards.flavor: "I am Daemos, son of Solus. One of the Inheritors of All Creation. And you… are a mote. A speck. A bit of dust in the wind."

cards.name: Jennix
cards.text: Each [[Inheritor]] minion gains guard. When Revealed: If a [[Web-Warrior]] character is in play, give Jennix a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "I prefer to make them struggle. I love the taste of adrenaline."

cards.name: Karn
cards.text: Each [[Inheritor]] minion's attacks gain overkill and piercing. When Revealed: If a [[Web-Warrior]] character is in play, discard an upgrade or support you control.
cards.flavor: "You'll make a filling meal."

cards.name: Morlun
cards.text: Each [[Inheritor]] minion gets +1 ATK. When Revealed: If a [[Web-Warrior]] character is in play, take 2 damage.
cards.flavor: "Mm. Never savored a life force so sweet."

cards.name: Solus
cards.text: Each [[Inheritor]] minion gains villainous. When Revealed: If a [[Web-Warrior]] character is in play, give Solus 1 facedown boost card.
cards.flavor: "I am Solus. I herald the death of you all."

cards.name: Verna
cards.text: Each [[Inheritor]] minion gains retaliate 1. When Revealed: If a [[Web-Warrior]] character is in play, deal 1 damage to each character you control.
cards.flavor: "I will feast on your bones!"

cards.name: SP//dr Suit
cards.text: Sync Ratio — Resource: Exhaust an [[Interface]] upgrade you control → generate that upgrade's resources.
cards.flavor: "We're called SP//dr, and we protect the city."

cards.name: SP//dr Suit
cards.text: Permanent. This card's printed text box cannot be treated as if it were blank. Return to Base — Forced Interrupt: When you flip to this side, flip SP//dr to Peni Parker. Detach Peni Parker from here, moving all counters on this card and cards attached to this card to her.

cards.name: Peni Parker
cards.text: Psychogenetic Compatibility — Setup: Put SP//dr Suit into play, [[Inactive]] side faceup. Maintenance — Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust SP//dr Suit → draw 2 cards.

cards.name: SP//dr
cards.text: Permanent. This card's printed text box cannot be treated as if it were blank. Suit Up! — Forced Interrupt: When you flip to this side, flip SP//dr Suit to its Active side. Attach this card to SP//dr Suit, moving all counters on this cards or cards attached to this card to SP//dr Suit.

cards.name: VEN#m
cards.text: [star] VEN#m gets +1 THW and +1 ATK for each sym counter on her. Hero Response: After VEN#m enters play, place 1 sym counter on her for each resource generated by SP//dr Suit's "Sync Ratio" ability to pay for her.

cards.name: All Systems Go!
cards.text: Hero Action: Choose: • Ready each [[Interface]] upgrade you control. • Search your deck and discard pile for an [[Interface]] upgrade and add it to your hand. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Rapid Deployment
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If you paid for this card using a resource generated by SP//dr Suit's "Sync Ratio" ability, remove 3 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "We'll protect this city, no matter what." —SP//dr

cards.name: Web-Trap
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using a resource generated by SP//dr Suit's "Sync Ratio" ability, stun that enemy.
cards.flavor: "May wanted SP//dr to be better, to be the best we could. That's why she developed these web-traps!"

cards.name: Aunt May & Uncle Ben
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Aunt May & Uncle Ben and discard the top 2 cards of your deck (top 3 cards instead if you are in alter-ego form) → add each SP//dr card discarded this way to your hand.

cards.name: Ejection Protocol
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard Ejection Protocol → exhaust each [[Interface]] upgrade you control, set your hit point dial to 6, give your identity a tough status card, and flip to alter-ego form.
cards.flavor: "Warning! Incoming threat!"

cards.name: SP//dr Command
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust SP//dr Command and an [[Interface]] upgrade → draw 1 card. Hero Action: Exhaust SP//dr Command, choose and discard 1 card from your hand → ready an [[Interface]] upgrade.
cards.flavor: "Peni, listen to our orders very carefully."

cards.name: Host Spider
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Host Spider → ready SP//dr Suit.
cards.flavor: "He trusts you… so will I." —Peni Parker

cards.name: Psychic Link
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When SP//dr Suit makes a basic thwart, exhaust Psychic Link → it gets +2 THW for that thwart.
cards.flavor: "Can we listen to music? It helps us focus." —Peni Parker

cards.name: Speed-Metal Alloy

cards.text: Contents: MaGog (A) (MaGog (B) instead for expert mode). MaGog and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (1 random modular set from the MojoMania scenario pack). Setup: Put The Champion environment card and The Challengers environment card into play, each with its [[BOOING CROWD]] side faceup.

cards.name: Melee in the Mojo-seum
cards.text: The players cannot win the game unless they wow the crowd as The Challengers. [star] Forced Interrupt: When this scheme would be completed, place 2[per_hero] ratings counters on The Champion and remove all threat from here instead.
cards.flavor: Teleported into a bizarre arena, you must fight for the audience's entertainment...and your lives!

cards.name: The Champion
cards.text: If there are at least 5[per_hero] ratings counters here, flip this environment (without removing ratings counters).
cards.flavor: "In this corner, we have your ninety-nine time defending Mojoverse champion, the mighty MaGog!"

cards.name: The Champion
cards.text: Underdogs — Forced Response: After The Champion flips to this side, each player draws 1 card. If there are at least 10[per_hero] ratings counters here, MaGog wins again and the players lose the game.

cards.name: The Challengers
cards.text: If there are at least 5[per_hero] ratings counters here, flip this environment (without removing ratings counters). (The players wow the crowd by placing ratings counters here.)
cards.flavor: "And in this corner, hailing from the tiny, insignificant planet of Earth, we have our challengers!" —Mojo

cards.name: The Challengers
cards.text: Tag Team — Forced Response: After The Challengers flips to this side, search the encounter deck and discard pile for Surprise Contender and put it into play engaged with the first player. If it is already in play, give it a tough status card. If there are at least 10[per_hero] ratings counters here, you wow the crowd and the players win the game.

cards.name: Jolt of Adrenaline
cards.text:
Attach to MaGog. MaGog gains retaliate 1 and stalwart. Forced Response: After MaGog's hit points are reset, place 1[per_hero] ratings counters on The Challengers and discard this card.
[star] Boost: Reveal this card.

cards.name: Surge of Aggression
cards.text:
Attach to MaGog. Forced Response: After MaGog's hit points are reset, place 1[per_hero] ratings counters on The Challengers and discard this card.
[star] Boost: Reveal this card.

cards.name: Surprise Contender
cards.text: Villainous. [star] Forced Response: After Surprise Contender attacks and damages a character, place 1 ratings counters on The Champion. When Defeated: Place 2[per_hero] ratings counters on The Challengers.

cards.name: Pump Up the Crowd
cards.text: When Revealed: If The Champion is on its [[Cheering Crowd]] side, place an additional 1[per_hero] threat here. When Defeated: Place 1[per_hero] ratings counters on The Challengers.
cards.flavor: "Do you smell what MaGog is cooking?" —MaGog

cards.text: When Revealed: You are stunned. Take 2 damage (4 damage instead there are more ratings counters on The Challengers than on The Champion). You may place any number of ratings counters on The Champion to reduce this damage by 1 for each counter placed this way.

cards.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Place 2 ratings counters on The Champion. When Revealed (Hero): MaGog attacks you. If a hero defends against this attacks and takes no damage, place 2 ratings counters on The Challengers.
cards.flavor: "Are you not entertained?" —MaGog

cards.text: If there are at least 3[per_hero] teleport counters here, remove all of them and flip Spiral. [star] Forced Response: After Spiral activates, place 1 teleport counter here.

cards.text: If there are at least 3[per_hero] teleport counters here, remove all of them and flip Spiral. When Revealed: Spiral attacks each player in player order (even in alter-ego form). [star] Forced Response: After Spiral activates, place 1 teleport counter here.

cards.name: Across the Mojoverse
cards.text: Contents: Spiral (I) and Spiral (II) (Spiral (II) and Spiral (III) instead for expert mode). Spiral and Standard encounter sets. Three modular encounter sets from the MojoMania scenario pack. Setup: Put The Search for Spiral side scheme and 1 random [[SHOW]] environment into play. Shuffle each other [[SHOW]] environment together with the Cornered! treachery to create the show deck. (See rulebook p. 11). Flip Spiral to her [[ESCAPED]] side.

cards.name: Across the Mojoverse
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When a SHOW environment would be discarded, place it on the bottom of the show deck instead. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.
cards.flavor: If you want to return home, you'll need the help of the teleporting sorceress, Spiral. But she will need some convincing.

cards.name: The Search for Spiral
cards.text: Permanent. Forced Interrupt: After the last threat is removed from here, the player who removed that threat reveals the top card of the show deck and places 3[per_hero] threat here. Hero Action: Take 2 damage → remove 3 threat from here.
cards.flavor: Spiral is hiding in one of the numerous television programs Mojo is producing.

cards.name: Cornered!
cards.text: When Revealed: Flip Spiral to her [[Cornered]] side. (This will cause her "When Revealed" text, if any, to resolve.) Reveal the top card of the show deck. Shuffle this card into the show deck. This effect cannot be canceled.)
cards.flavor: "Why won't you just leave me alone?!?" —Spiral

cards.name: Spiral's Swords
cards.text: Attach to Spiral. Uses (3 sword counters). [star] Spiral gets +1 ATK for each sword counter on this card. Hero Action: If Spiral is on her [[Cornered]] side, spend [physical] [physical] resources → remove 1 sword counter from this card.
cards.flavor: "Don't know how she keep from losin' an arm." —Gambit

cards.name: Erratic Teleportation
cards.text: Surge. When Revealed: If Spiral is on her [[Cornered]] side, place 1 teleport counter on her. If Spiral is on her [[Escaped]] side, you may spend a [mental] resource to look at the top card of the show deck and put it on the top or bottom of that deck.

cards.name: The Show Must Go On
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a card from the same encounter set as the current [[Show]] environment and deals that card to themself as a facedown encounter card. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Mojo
cards.text: Forced Response (Hero): After your turn ends, discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Place 1 threat on your hero for each card discarded this way that does not belong to the Mojo encounter set.

cards.text: When Revealed: Place 2 threat on each friendly character. Forced Response (Hero): After your turn ends, discard the top 4 cards of the encounter deck. Place 1 threat on your hero for each card discarded this way that does not belong to the Mojo encounter set.

cards.name: Mojo
cards.text: When Revealed: Place 3 threat on each friendly character. Forced Response (Hero): After your turn ends, discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. Place 1 threat on your hero for each card discarded this way that does not belong to the Mojo encounter set.

cards.text: When Revealed: Choose 1 set-aside encounter set at random, reveal its SHOW environment and shuffle its remaining cards into the encounter deck. Forced Interrupt: When a character flips or leaves play, move all threat from that character to this scheme. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Wheel of Genres
cards.text: Forced Response: After the encounter deck resets, if there are no set-aside modular encounter sets remaining, the players lose the game. Otherwise, flip this card.
cards.flavor: "The ratings are stagnating. Time to shake things up with a crossover episode!" —Mojo

cards.name: Wheel of Genres
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: At the start of step three of the villain phase (deal encounter cards), randomly choose 1 set-aside modular set and reveal its SHOW environment. Shuffle the rest of that modular set and place it on top of the encounter deck. Deal the first player 2 facedown encounter cards and flip this card.

cards.name: Major Domo
cards.text: Attach to Mojo. [star] Forced Response: After Mojo attacks, discard cards from the encounter deck equal to the amount of damage dealt by that attack. Hero Action: Spend [energy] [mental] [physical] resources → discard this card.
cards.flavor: "I live to serve, Your Supreme Spinelessness."

cards.name: Stinger Tail
cards.text:
Attach to Mojo. Mojo gains retaliate 2. Forced Interrupt: When any amount of damage would be dealt to Mojo, place it here instead. Then, if there is at least 5 damage here, discard Stinger Tail.
[star] Boost: Attach this card to Mojo.

cards.name: Supporting Actor
cards.text:
[star] Forced Response: After Supporting Actor activates against you, place 2 threat here.
Boost: Place 1 threat on each character you control.
cards.flavor: "They're cheaper than real actors." —Mojo

cards.name: Paparazzi
cards.text: Hinder 10. Action: Choose to either exhaust a character you control or discard 1 card from your hand → remove 2 threat from here (3 threat instead if you are in alter-ego form). Forced Interrupt: When your turn ends, move all threat from here to the main scheme and discard this card.

cards.name: Undercover Mojo
cards.text: Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Interrupt: When Mojo would take any amount of damage, remove an equal amount of threat from here instead.
cards.flavor: "They'll never recognize me." —Mojo

cards.name: Curtain Call
cards.text:
When Revealed: Move all threat from the character with the most threat on it to the main scheme. If no threat was moved this way, place 1 threat on each character you control.
[star] Boost: Reveal this card.

cards.name: Director's Directions
cards.text: When Revealed: Choose one: • Spend 2 different resources. • Mojo schemes. • Take 1 damage for each threat on your identity. If you take less than 2 damage this way, this card gains surge.

cards.name: Top Billing
cards.text:
When Revealed: Heal 1 damage from each character you control. Place 2 threat on each character you control.
[star] Boost: Place 1 threat on each character you control.

cards.name: Dial M for Mojo
cards.text: Each other encounter card gains incite 1. Each friendly character gets +1 THW. When Revealed: Discard each other [[Setting]] environment in play. If this card was revealed from the encounter deck, it gains surge.

cards.name: Build the Case
cards.text: Forced Response: After a side scheme is defeated, place 1 clue counter here. Then, if there are at least 3 clue counters here, discard this card.

cards.name: Crime Scene Investigation
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. (When revealed, place 1[per_hero] threat here.) Threat cannot be removed from other schemes. Hero Action: Spend X [mental] resources → remove X threat from this scheme.
cards.flavor:
"It seems the victim's luck ran out."
"I guess you could say he...lost his mojo." —Detectives Domo and Mojo

cards.name: Law & Order
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. (When revealed, place 1[per_hero] threat here.) Each friendly character gets -2 ATK. Hero Action: Spend X [energy] resources → remove X threat from this scheme.
cards.flavor: "I hold both of me in contempt!" —Judge Mojo

cards.name: Dragnet
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. (When revealed, place 1[per_hero] threat here.) The villain cannot take damage. Hero Action: Spend X [physical] resources → remove X threat from this scheme.
cards.flavor: "I was never here." —Boss Mojo

cards.name: Elementary, My Dear Mojo
cards.text: When Revealed: Choose one: • Move all threat from a side scheme to the main scheme.(That side scheme is defeated.) • Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side scheme is discarded. Reveal that card.

cards.name: A Game of Mojo's
cards.text: Each player gets +1 hand size. When Revealed: Discard each other [[Setting]] environment in play. If this card was revealed from the encounter deck, it gains surge.

cards.name: Dragon
cards.text: Retaliate 1. Toughness. Double the amount of damage this minion takes from cards with a printed [energy] resource. When Defeated: Each player draws 4 cards.

cards.name: Goblin
cards.text: Surge. This minion can only take damage from cards with a printed [physical] resource. When Defeated: Remove 2 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Troll
cards.text: Toughness. This minion takes 1 additional damage from each card with a printed [mental] resource. When Defeated: The player who defeated this minion may put 1 ally from their discard pile into play.

cards.name: Fetch Quest
cards.text:
Surge. When Defeated: In player order, each player may search their deck for a card and play that card, ignoring its resource cost. (Shuffle.)
[star] Boost: Put this card into play.
cards.flavor: "Bring me a shrubbery!" —Sir Mojo

cards.name: Mana Drain
cards.text:
When Revealed: Choose a non-wild (non-[wild]) resource type, then each player draws 2 cards. Each player must discard each card from their hand with the chosen resource type.
[star] Boost: Discard 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: The Mojo Files
cards.text: Each minion gains quickstrike. Each ally takes -1 consequential damage ([cost]) after attacking a minion. When Revealed: Discard each other [[Setting]] environment in play. If this card was revealed from the encounter deck, it gains surge.

cards.name: Bandolier of Stakes
cards.text: Surge. Uses (3 stake counters).When Revealed: You may spend 1 resource of any type to attach this card to your identity. Otherwise, discard this card. Hero Interrupt: When your hero makes a basic attack, remove 1 stake counter from here → your hero gets +1 ATK for that attack and that attack gains piercing.

cards.name: Cultist
cards.text: [star] Forced Response: After Cultist activates against you, search the encounter deck and discard pile for The Kraken and put it into play engaged with you. (Shuffle.) Then, discard Cultist.
cards.flavor: "Release the kraken!"

cards.name: The Kraken
cards.text: [star] Forced Response: After The Kraken activates, each other character takes 1 damage. When Defeated: Each friendly character heals 1 damage.
cards.flavor: "Rraaarhh!"

cards.name: Vampire
cards.text: Attacks with piercing deal double damage to Vampire. [star] Forced Response: After Vampire attacks and damages a character, heal all damage from Vampire. If no damage was healed this way, give Vampire a tough status card.

cards.name: Werewolf Pack
cards.text: When Revealed: Defeat an ally you control and place it facedown under Werewolf Pack. Forced Interrupt: When Werewolf Pack would be defeated, discard an ally from under it instead. Then, heal all damage from Werewolf Pack.

cards.name: Mojo Runner
cards.text: Each minion and ally gains toughness. When Revealed: Discard each other [[Setting]] environment in play. If this card was revealed from the encounter deck, it gains surge.
cards.flavor:
">Password accepted. Logging you into the server now.
>Welcome to MojoCorp! Your activities will be monitored."

cards.name: Avalanche 9.0
cards.text:
Forced Response: After Avalanche 9.0 engages you, exhaust a character you control and deal 1 damage to this character.
[star] Boost: Exhaust a character you control.
cards.flavor: ">Deallocatting CPU cycles from unidentified process."

cards.name: Blob 3.14
cards.text:
Blob 3.14 cannot take more than 2 damage from each attack.
[star] Boost: You are stunned.
cards.flavor:
">Buffering...
>Buffering...
>Buffering..."

cards.name: Magneto 2.6
cards.text: Villainous. [star] Forced Response: After Magneto 2.6 activates against you, place 1 magnetic counter on him. Then, choose and discard 1 card from your hand for each magnetic counter on Magneto 2.6.
cards.flavor: ">Reformating infected hard drive."

cards.name: Pyro 4.0
cards.text:
[star] Forced Interrupt: When Pyro 4.0 attacks you, take 2 indirect damage.
[star] Boost: Take 2 indirect damage.
cards.flavor: ">Purging unknown program."

cards.name: Toad 2.0
cards.text: Forced Response: After Toad 2.0 engages you, place 1 upgrade you control facedown under Toad 2.0. When Defeated: Return each card under Toad 2.0 to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: ">Quarantining dangerous subroutine."

cards.name: ICE-Teroid M
cards.text: Each minion gains guard and patrol. Forced Interrupt: At the end of the round (after the first player token is passed), the first player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a minion and puts it into play engaged with them. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor:
">Invasive programs detected.
>Intrusion Counter Electronics deployed."

cards.name: Mojo in the Middle
cards.text: Each obligation gains 1 acceleration icon ([acceleration]). Response: After a player discards an obligation, that player draws 1 card. When Revealed: Discard each other [[Setting]] environment in play. If this card was revealed from the encounter deck, it gains surge.

cards.name: Family Matters
cards.text: Treat the printed text box of each support you control as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]). Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust your identity and each support you control → discard this obligation.
cards.flavor:
"I'll never be like you!"
"You're my clone!" —X-23 and Wolverine

cards.name: Growing Pains
cards.text: Increase the cost to play each of your upgrades by 2. Alter-Ego Action: Discard an upgrade you control or discard an upgrade from your hand. If you have more upgrades in your discard pile than in play, discard this obligation.
cards.flavor: "It's not my fault!" —Hope Summers

cards.name: The Odd Couple
cards.text: Reduce your ally limit by 2. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust 2 characters you control → shuffle an ally from your discard pile into your deck and discard this obligation.
cards.flavor: "I'll clean it up later." —Jubilee

cards.name: The One with the Breakup
cards.text: Each encounter card gains peril. Alter-Ego Action: Discard 3 cards from your hand and choose a player → the chosen player draws 1 card and you discard this obligation.

cards.name: Watch Me Play
cards.text: Incite 3. Peril. Forced Interrupt: When you look up a rule, you are confused. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust your identity and discard a confused status card from it → discard this obligation.
cards.flavor: "What does 'you' mean again?!" —Deadpool

cards.name: Wild Wild Mojo
cards.text: Each enemy attack gains overkill. Forced Interrupt: When a character takes damage, increase that damage by 1. When Revealed: Discard each other [[Setting]] environment in play. If this card was revealed from the encounter deck, it gains surge.

cards.name: Dead or Alive
cards.text: Attach to the minion with the highest printed hit points. If you cannot, this card gains surge. Attached minion gets +3[per_hero] hit points. Forced Interrupt: When attached minion is defeated, each player adds 1 card from their discard pile to their hand.

cards.name: Card Shark
cards.text: [star] Forced Response: After Card Shark attacks you, discard the top 3 cards of your deck. Take indirect damage equal to the number of different printed resources types ([energy], [mental], [physical], or [wild]) discarded this way.
cards.flavor: All he does is swim and eat and win at cards.

cards.name: Gunslinger
cards.text: Quickstrike. Forced Interrupt: When this minion engages you (before resolving quickstrike), you may spend [energy][energy] resources. If you do, deal damage to this minion equal to your hero's ATK.
cards.flavor: "Draw!"

cards.name: A Game of Cards
cards.text: When Revealed: Draw 5 cards. Choose and discard 5 cards from your hand. For each different printed resource type ([energy], [mental], [physical], or [wild]) discarded this way, discard an upgrade or support you control.
cards.flavor: When you play a game of cards, you win or lose...

cards.name: Longshot
cards.text: [star] Longshot's attacks gain piercing. Longshot does not count against your ally limit. When Revealed: Put Longshot into play under your control. This card gains surge. This effect cannot be canceled.

cards.name: Cable
cards.text: Response: After Cable defeats a side scheme, ready him. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "The battle may be won, but the war is far from over."

cards.name: Nathan Summers
cards.text: You may include player side schemes from any aspect in your deck. Soldier X — Setup: Search your deck and discard pile for a player side scheme and put it into play. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Bodyslide
cards.text: Action: Change form. Each other player may change to the form you are in.

cards.name: Mind Scan
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Remove 1 additional threat from that scheme for each side scheme in the victory display.

cards.name: Precognition
cards.text: Hero Action: Look at the top X cards of the encounter deck, where X is the number of side schemes in the victory display. You may discard 1 of those cards. Put the rest back in any order.

cards.name: Telekinetic Blast
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 additional damage to that enemy for each side scheme in the victory display.

cards.name: Technovirus Purge
cards.text:
Victory 0.
Characters other than Cable cannot remove threat from Technovirus Purge.
While Technovirus Purge is in the victory display, Nathan Summers and Cable gain the [[PSIONIC]] trait and Cable gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, and +1 DEF.

cards.name: Graymalkin
cards.text: Response: After a side scheme is defeated, ready Graymalkin. Resource: Exhaust Graymalkin → generate a [energy] resource.
cards.flavor: Cable's orbital base is operated by the sentient A.I. known as Professor.

cards.name: Professor
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Professor → choose to either draw 1 card or search your deck and discard pile for a player side scheme and add it to your hand. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: "I'm sorry, Wade. I'm afraid I can't do that."

cards.name: Askani'son
cards.text: Hero Response (thwart): After you defend against an enemy attack, exhaust Askani'son and spend a [energy] resource → remove threat from a scheme equal to your hero's THW.

cards.name: Forced Amnesia
cards.text: Hero Response: After a (non-permanent) side scheme is defeated, add Forced Amnesia and that side scheme to the victory display.

cards.name: Plasma Rifle
cards.text: Restricted. Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Plasma Rifle and spend a [energy] resource → deal 1 damage to an enemy for each side scheme in the victory display (to a maximum of 4). This attack gains ranged.

cards.name: Telekinetic Force Field
cards.text: Hero form only Hero Interrupt: When a friendly character would take any amount of damage, discard Telekinetic Force Field → prevent all of that damage.

cards.name: Temporal Leap
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When the main scheme would be completed, remove this card from the game and put a side scheme from the victory display into play → move 4 threat from the main scheme to that side scheme.

cards.name: Caliban
cards.text: Response: After Caliban enters play, discard cards from the top of your deck until an [[X-FACTOR]], [[X-FORCE]], or [[X-MEN]] ally is discarded. Add that ally to your hand.

cards.name: Fantomex
cards.text: Response: After Fantomex enters play, search your deck and discard pile for E.V.A. and put it into play. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: "E.V.A. is more than a vehicle. She's my partner. She's my mutation."

cards.name: Sunspot
cards.text: Response: After you play Sunspot from your hand, choose a player → deal 1 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with the chosen player for each [energy] resource used to pay for Sunspot.

cards.name: Mission Planning
cards.text: Play only if there is a side scheme in the victory display. Hero Action: Until the end of the phase, allies you control do not take consequential damage.

cards.name: Call for Backup
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for an ally and put it into play. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: "Blue team, rendezvous at my location!" —Bishop

cards.name: Lock and Load
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for a [[WEAPON]] upgrade with a cost of 3 or less and put it into play. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: "We'll need guns. Lots of guns." —Cable

cards.name: Establish Perimeter
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Give each identity a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "Don't worry, kids. They won't get through me!" —Armor

cards.name: E.V.A.
cards.text: If Fantomex is not in play, discard E.V.A. Action: Exhaust E.V.A. → choose: • Remove 1 threat from a scheme. • Deal 1 damage to an enemy. • Heal 1 damage from Fantomex.

cards.name: Uncanny X-Force
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 [[TEAM]] card per player.
If each of your characters has the [[X-FORCE]] trait, each ally you control gets +1 THW and takes -1 consequential damage ([cost]) after thwarting a side scheme.

cards.name: Mission Leader
cards.text: Reduce the cost to play Mission Leader by 1 if your identity has the [[SOLDIER]] trait. Hero Response: After a side scheme is defeated, exhaust Mission Leader → each player draws 1 card.

cards.name: Deadpool
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When Deadpool would be defeated by consequential damage, heal 3 damage from him instead. Add an acceleration token to the main scheme.
cards.flavor: "...Cable? Not interested. I stream everything."

cards.name: Deathlok
cards.text: Hero Response: After Deathlok enters play, choose an upgrade in any player's discard pile with a cost of 1 or less that can be attached to Deathlok. Attach that upgrade to Deathlok.

cards.name: Frenemies
cards.text: Team-Up (Cable and Deadpool). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (thwart): Deal 1 damage each to Cable and Deadpool. Remove 3 threat from a scheme and 3 threat from a different scheme.

cards.name: Build Support
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for a support with a cost of 3 or less and put it into play. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: "I've got just the thing." —Forge

cards.name: The Power of the Mind
cards.text: Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a [[PSIONIC]] card.

cards.name: Psimitar
cards.text: Restricted. Hero Response (attack): After you play another [[PSIONIC]] card, exhaust Psimitar → deal 2 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Sidearm
cards.text:
Attach to an ally. Max 1 per ally.
Attached ally gets +1 ATK and its attacks gain ranged.
cards.flavor: "That gun is not nearly as dangerous as the man who wields it." —Cable

cards.name: Technovirus Resurgence
cards.text: Give to the Nathan Summers player. When Revealed: Search your deck, discard pile, hand, and victory display for Technovirus Purge and put it into play. (Shuffle.) Attach this card to Technovirus Purge. If you cannot, discard this card and deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card.

cards.name: Stryfe
cards.text: Villainous. Forced Interrupt: When a player plays a [[PSIONIC]] event, cancel the effects of that event and deal 1 damage to Stryfe.
cards.flavor: "Regardless of who is the clone, Cable, it is my power that is superior!"

cards.name: Back to the Future
cards.text:
The Cable player cannot remove threat from schemes other than Back to the Future. Other players cannot remove threat from Back to the Future.
The Cable player cannot damage enemies not engaged with them. Other players cannot damage minions engaged with the Cable player.

cards.name: Telekinetic Force Field
cards.text:
Attach to Stryfe. Otherwise, attach to the villain. Forced Interrupt: When attached character would take any amount of damage, prevent that damage. If 2 or more damage was prevented this way, discard this card.
[star] Boost: Attach this card to the activating enemy.

cards.name: Mind Scan
cards.text:
When Revealed: Place 2 threat on the main scheme. Place 1 additional threat on the main scheme for each side scheme in the victory display.
[star] Boost: You are confused.

cards.name: Telekinetic Blast
cards.text:
When Revealed: Take 2 damage. Take 1 additional damage for each side scheme in the victory display.
[star] Boost: You are stunned.

cards.name: Domino
cards.text: When counting resources on cards discarded from the top of the deck, count each printed [wild] icon twice. Action: Choose a card in your hand. Swap that card with the top card of your deck. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Neena Thurman
cards.text: Action: Choose a card in your hand. Swap that card with the top card of your discard pile. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Diamondback
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Diamondback, deal 1 damage to her, and discard the top card of your deck → deal 1 damage to each enemy for each resource icon discarded this way.

cards.name: Outlaw
cards.text: Toughness. [star] Interrupt: When Outlaw attacks, discard the top card of your deck → Outlaw gets +1 ATK for this attack for each resource icon discarded this way.

cards.name: A Good Workout
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy and discard the top card of your deck. For each resource icon discarded this way, deal 1 additional damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Luck Be a Lady
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard the top card of your deck and count the resources on it. For each resource counted this way, if it is a: [energy] - Heal 2 damage from a character. [mental] - Remove 2 threat from a scheme. [physical] - Deal 3 damage to an enemy. [wild] - Choose 1 of the above.

cards.name: Right Place, Right Time
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme and discard the top card of your deck. For each resource icon discarded this way, remove 1 additional threat from that scheme.

cards.name: Jackpot!
cards.text: Response: After this card is discarded from the top of your deck, shuffle it back into your deck.

cards.name: Pip the Pug
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Pip the Pug → put 1 Domino or [[POSSE]] card from your discard pile on top of your deck.
cards.flavor: "Did you just piddle on me, you nasty little sausage!" —Domino

cards.name: The Painted Lady
cards.text: Response: After you discard a card from the top of the deck, attach that card facedown here (to a maximum of 3). Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust The Painted Lady → add 1 card attached here to your hand.

cards.name: Domino's Pistol
cards.text: Restricted. Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Domino's Pistol, choose an enemy, and discard the top card of your deck → deal 1 damage to that enemy for each resource icon discarded this way. This attack gains ranged.

cards.name: Lucky and Good
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When a boost card is turned faceup during an attack against you, exhaust Lucky and Good → cancel that card's boost icons and "Boost" ability. Give the attacking enemy another boost card for this attack.

cards.name: Lucky Break
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When you reveal an encounter card, discard Lucky Break → cancel the effects of that card and discard it. Reveal another card from the encounter deck.

cards.name: Probability Field
cards.text: Interrupt: When you use a basic power, discard the top card of your deck → you get +1 to that power for this use for each resource icon discarded this way.

cards.name: Feral
cards.text: [star] Response: After Feral thwarts, discard the top card of your deck. For each resource icon discarded this way, deal 1 damage to the villain.
cards.flavor: "I have caught the prey's scent."

cards.name: Wolfsbane
cards.text: [star] Response: After Wolfsbane thwarts, name a card type, then discard the top card of your deck. If that card is of the named type, you may add it to your hand.

cards.name: Even the Odds
cards.text: Requirement ([energy]). Hero Action (thwart): Remove 1[per_hero] threat from each side scheme. Deal 1 damage to the villain for each side scheme defeated this way.

cards.name: Team Investigation
cards.text: Alliance. (The players can pay this card's costs as a group.) Hero Action: Remove 3[per_hero] threat from a side scheme.
cards.flavor: "If I may coin a phrase, many minds make light work." —Beast

cards.name: Take Out the Guards
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may discard 1 non-[[ELITE]] minion from play.
cards.flavor: "Nighty night, bub." —Wolverine

cards.name: Overwatch
cards.text: Attach to a scheme. Max 1 per scheme. Hero Interrupt: When any amount of threat is removed from attached scheme by a thwart, discard this card → remove an equal amount of threat from a different scheme.

cards.name: Atlas Bear
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Atlas Bear → look at the top card of a player deck. If that card is an event, you may deal 1 damage to Atlas Bear to add that card to its owner's hand.

cards.name: White Fox
cards.text: Response: After White Fox is discarded from the top of your deck, put her into play under your control.
cards.flavor: "I am the last of my kind. I am the last kumiho!"

cards.name: The Posse
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Play only if you control at least 3 characters with the [[POSSE]] trait. Hero Action: Heal 1 damage from each [[POSSE]] character and ready them.

cards.name: Superpower Training
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for an identity-specific upgrade and put it into play. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: "Class is in session." —Charles Xavier

cards.name: Digging Deep
cards.text: Response: After this card is discarded from the top of your deck, add it to your hand.

cards.name: Energy
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Genius
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Strength
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Sharpshooter
cards.text: Max 1 per player. Hero Interrupt: When you make a ranged attack, discard the top card of your deck → this attack deals 1 additional damage for each resource icon discarded this way.

cards.name: Memories of Armageddon
cards.text: Give to the Neena Thurman player. Treat your identity's printed text box as if it were blank (except for [[TRAITS]]). Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust your identity → discard Memories of Armageddon.
cards.flavor: As a child, Neena was used as a lab rat in the super-soldier program known as Project Armageddon.

cards.name: Topaz
cards.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and set aside area for 1 copy of Superpower Feedback and attach it to your identity. (Shuffle.) (Domino's nemesis minion.)
cards.flavor: Topaz is able to affect other mutants' abilities, either amplifying them or nullifying them.

cards.name: Not My Lucky Day
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must either take 1 damage or place 2 threat here.
cards.flavor: Domino is having a terrible, horrible, no good, very bad day.

cards.name: Prototype
cards.text: [star] Prototype gets +1 hit points for each luck counter on him. When Revealed: Place luck counters on Prototype equal to the amount of damage your identity has sustained.
cards.flavor: Domino's good luck is Prototype's misfortune, and her suffering strengthens him.

cards.name: Superpower Feedback
cards.text: Attach to your identity. Forced Response: After you resolve an ability on your identity or an identity-specific card, take 1 damage. Alter-Ego Action: Discard 1 identity-specific card from your hand → discard this card.

cards.name: Arclight
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Arclight attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Confuse a character you control. • Arclight gets +2 ATK for this attack.

cards.name: Arclight
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Arclight attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Confuse the character you control with the highest THW. • Arclight gets +2 ATK for this attack.

cards.name: Blockbuster
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Blockbuster attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Give Blockbuster a tough status card. • Blockbuster gets +2 ATK for this attack.

cards.name: Blockbuster
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Blockbuster attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Give Blockbuster a tough status card. • Blockbuster gets +2 ATK for this attack and this attack gains overkill.

cards.name: Chimera
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Chimera attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Spend a [mental] resource. • Chimera gets +2 ATK for this attack.

cards.name: Chimera
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Chimera attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Spend [mental][mental] resources. • Chimera gets +2 ATK for this attack.

cards.name: Greycrow
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Greycrow attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Discard the highest-cost card you control. • Greycrow gets +X ATK for this attack, where X is the printed cost of the highest-cost card you control.

cards.name: Greycrow
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Greycrow attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Discard each card you control with the highest cost. • Greycrow gets +X ATK for this attack, where X is the printed cost of the highest-cost card you control.

cards.name: Harpoon
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Harpoon attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Take 2 indirect damage. • Give Harpoon 1 additional facedown boost card for this attack.

cards.name: Harpoon
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Harpoon attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Take 3 indirect damage. • Give Harpoon 1 additional facedown boost card for this attack. This attack gains overkill.

cards.name: Riptide
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Riptide attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Place 2 threat on the main scheme and 1 threat on each side scheme. • Riptide gets +2 ATK for this attack.

cards.name: Riptide
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Riptide attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Place 3 threat on the main scheme and 1 threat on each side scheme. • Riptide gets +2 ATK for this attack and this attack gains ranged and piercing.

cards.name: Vertigo
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Vertigo attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Stun a character you control. • Vertigo gets +2 ATK for this attack.

cards.name: Vertigo
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Vertigo attacks you or an ally you control, choose: • Stun the character you control with the highest ATK. • Vertigo gets +2 ATK for this attack.
