cards.text: Living Weapon — Response: After X-23 takes any amount of damage, ready X-23. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "The Facility created me to kill, but I choose to fight to protect life."

cards.name: Laura Kinney
cards.text: Shhnk! — Setup: Put X-23's Claws into play. Action: Shuffle either the Honey Badger ally or the Sisterly Bond event from your discard pile into your deck → draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: X-23's Claws
cards.text: Permanent. Hero Action: Exhaust X-23's Claws and take 2 damage → X-23 gets +2 ATK until the end of the round.

cards.name: Honey Badger
cards.text: Hero Response: After Honey Badger takes any amount of damage, ready X-23.
cards.flavor: "You don't scare me. And I won't let you mess with my friends anymore!"

cards.name: Animal Instinct
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When X-23 makes a basic thwart, she gets +X THW for this thwart, where X is equal to her ATK.
cards.flavor: X-23 inherited Wolverine's superhuman senses...as well as his charming personality.

cards.name: Claw Mastery
cards.text: Max 1 per round. Hero Action: Until the end of the round, X-23 gets +2 ATK (and her attacks gain overkill while Honey Badger is in play).

cards.name: Regenerative Longevity
cards.text: Action: Heal a total of 4 damage from your identity and Honey Badger.
cards.flavor: "If what doesn't kill you makes you stronger, I should have Colossus-level strength by now." —X-23

cards.name: Sisterly Bond
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When Honey Badger thwarts or attacks, add X-23's matching power to Honey Badger's power for this use.
cards.flavor: "High five!" —Honey Badger

cards.name: Sisterhood
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Sisterhood and discard an X-23 card from your hand → search your deck and discard pile for Honey Badger and add her to your hand. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: Laura and Gabby's bond is stronger than genetics.

cards.name: Adamantium Lacing
cards.text:
You get +2 hit points.
X-23 gains retaliate 1 and her basic attacks gain piercing.
cards.flavor: X-23's claws are coated with the metal adamantium, making them incredibly sharp and nearly indestructible.

cards.name: Grim Resolve
cards.text: Resource: Exhaust this card and take 1 damage → generate a [wild] resource.
cards.flavor: "Is that all you got?" —X-23

cards.name: Pain Tolerance
cards.text: Response: After you play an X-23 card (including this one), heal 1 damage from your identity.
cards.flavor: "Barely felt a thing." —X-23

cards.name: Puncture Wound
cards.text: Attach to an enemy that X-23 or Honey Badger attacked this turn. Attached enemy gets -1 ATK. Forced Response: After the player phase begins, discard this card and deal 3 damage to attached enemy.

cards.name: Boom Boom
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Boom Boom → add 1 boom counter to her. Then, you may discard Boom Boom to deal 1 damage to each enemy for each boom counter on her.
cards.flavor: "Tick...tick...tick..."

cards.name: Rictor
cards.text: [star] Response: After Rictor attacks, discard the top card of your deck. Deal 1 damage to each minion engaged with you for each resource on the discarded card.

cards.name: Shatterstar
cards.text: [star] Interrupt: When Shatterstar attacks a minion, engage that minion. If you are already engaged with that minion, Shatterstar gets +1 ATK for this attack.
cards.flavor: A skilled swordfighter, Shatterstar can even cut openings in space to teleport vast distances.

cards.name: Critical Hit
cards.text: Play only if there is a side scheme in the victory display. Hero Response: After you attack an enemy, stun it.

cards.name: Moment of Triumph
cards.text: Hero Response: After you attack and defeat an enemy, heal 1 damage from your hero for each point of excess damage dealt to that enemy by that attack.

cards.name: Keep Them Busy
cards.text: Victory 0. Assault. (Basic thwarts against this scheme use ATK instead of THW.) When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme removes 5[per_hero] threat from the main scheme.

cards.name: "Now I'm Mad"
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
While your hero's remaining hit points are less than half your hero's starting hit points, your hero gets +1 ATK and -1 THW.

cards.name: The Direct Approach
cards.text: Attach to a non-permanent side scheme. Limit 1 per side scheme. Attached scheme gains assault. (Basic thwarts against this scheme use ATK instead of THW.)

cards.name: Specialized Training
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player who does not control a [[SPECIALIZATION]] upgrade chooses 1 set-aside [[SPECIALIZATION]] upgrade and puts it into play under their control.

cards.name: Energy
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Genius
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Strength
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: IPAC
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[X-FORCE]] trait. Hero Action: Exhaust IPAC and deal 1 facedown encounter card to a player → that player draws 2 cards.

cards.name: X-Bunker
cards.text: Action: Exhaust X-Bunker and choose a player whose identity has the [[MUTANT]] trait → that player searches the top X cards of their deck for any card, where X is the number of side schemes in the victory display, and adds that card to their hand. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Endurance
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
You get +3 hit points.

cards.name: Self-Isolation
cards.text: Give to the Laura Kinney player. Search your hand, deck, discard pile, and play area for Honey Badger and place her facedown under this obligation. If you cannot, discard this card and deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card. Response: After you make a basic recovery, discard this obligation and Honey Badger.

cards.name: Lady Deathstrike
cards.text: When Defeated: The player who defeated this minion discards the top card of the encounter deck and takes 1 indirect damage for each boost icon ([boost]) on that card.

cards.name: In the Name of Vengeance
cards.text: Each enemy gains retaliate 1.
cards.flavor: "Cute kid. Be a shame if something was to happen to her." —Lady Deathstrike

cards.name: Cybermods
cards.text: Attach to Lady Deathstrike. If you cannot, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a minion is discarded. Put that minion into play engaged with you and attach this card to it. Forced Interrupt: When attached minion would be discarded, shuffle it into the encounter deck instead.

cards.name: Critical Wound
cards.text: Attach to your identity. Forced Interrupt: When your turn ends, discard this card and take 4 damage.

cards.name: Hack 'n' Slash
cards.text:
When Revealed: Discard 1 random card from your hand and take damage equal to the number of printed resources on it.
[star] Boost: Discard 1 random card from your hand and take damage equal to the number of printed resources on it.

cards.name: Combat Specialist
cards.text: Linked (Specialized Training). Your hero gets +1 ATK. Hero Response: After your hero performs a basic attack, exhaust this card → draw 1 card.

cards.name: Defense Specialist
cards.text: Linked (Specialized Training). Your hero gets +1 DEF. Hero Response: After your hero performs a basic defense, exhaust this card → draw 1 card.

cards.name: Front Line Specialist
cards.text: Linked (Specialized Training). Your identity gets +4 hit points. Response: After your identity takes damage from an enemy attack, exhaust this card → draw 1 card.

cards.name: Surveillance Specialist
cards.text: Linked (Specialized Training). Your hero gets +1 THW. Hero Response: After your hero performs a basic thwart, exhaust this card → draw 1 card.

cards.name: Predictable Ploy
cards.text: Play only if there is a side scheme in the victory display. Hero Interrupt: When a treachery card is revealed from the encounter deck, cancel its "When Revealed" effects.

cards.name: Rally the Troops
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Heal 2 damage from each ally.
cards.flavor: "Press on, team! Victory is in sight!" —Cyclops

cards.name: Anticipated Attack
cards.text: Play only if there is a side scheme in the victory display. Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy initiates an attack, give your hero a tough status card.

cards.name: Deadpool
cards.text: The Regeneratin' Degenerate — Forced Interrupt: When you would be defeated, instead set your hit point dial to 1, change to alter-ego form, and add 1 acceleration token to the main scheme.

cards.name: Wade Wilson
cards.text: Break the Fourth Wall — Action: Discard a card from your hand → search your deck for a Deadpool event and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "Sometimes I'm a mutant, sometimes I'm not. Depends on who you ask."

cards.name: Cable
cards.text: [star] Cable gets +1 THW and +1 ATK for each acceleration token on the main scheme (to a maximum of +3 THW and +3 ATK.)
cards.flavor: "Wade, you are my best bud!"

cards.name: Exhausting Personality
cards.text: Hero Action: Choose: • Place 1 acceleration token on the main scheme → stun and confuse the villain. • Exhaust a player's identity → that player draws 1 card for each acceleration token on the main scheme.

cards.name: Maximum Effort
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Take any amount of damage up to your remaining hit points → deal an equal amount of damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "This is gonna hurt me as much as it hurts you." —Deadpool

cards.name: Metaknowledge
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When an encounter card is revealed, cancel all of its effects and discard it. Take 1 damage for each icon ([star] and [boost]) in that card's boost area.
cards.flavor: "It says here I defeat you with a wedgie." —Deadpool

cards.name: "Yoo-Hoo!"
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Take any amount of damage up to your remaining hit points → remove an equal amount of threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "You boys mind me dropping in?" —Deadpool

cards.name: Montage
cards.text: This card generates 1 additional [wild] resource for each acceleration token on the main scheme (to a maximum of 3 additional resources).

cards.name: Chimichanga Truck
cards.text: Response: After an identity makes a basic recovery, exhaust Chimichanga Truck → ready that identity.
cards.flavor: "Did someone say, 'Chimichanga'? Nevermind. That was just the sound of my skull and brains healing." —Deadpool

cards.name: Armed to the Teeth
cards.text: Response: After you play Armed to the Teeth, search your collection for 1 [[WEAPON]] upgrade from any aspect and attach it facedown here. Action: Exhaust Armed to the Teeth → swap the card attached here with a [[WEAPON]] upgrade you control.

cards.name: Deadpool's Katana
cards.text: Restricted. Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Deadpool's Katana and take 1 damage → deal 2 damage to an enemy. This attack gains piercing.

cards.name: It Ain't Over...
cards.text:
Attach to the main scheme.
Increase the target threat value of attached scheme by 2 for each acceleration token on it.
cards.flavor: "I've got you right where I want you." —Deadpool

cards.name: This Card is Fire
cards.text: Forced Response: After your turn ends, if this card is in your hand, take 1 damage. Hero Action (attack): Deal X damage to an enemy. X is the amount of damage you have sustained.

cards.name: Dogpool
cards.text: Retaliate 1. Toughness. When Defeated: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Headpool
cards.text: [star] Response: After Headpool attacks and damages a minion, that minion attacks another enemy of your choice.

cards.name: Kidpool
cards.text: [star] Kidpool's attacks gain piercing.
cards.flavor: "Congratulations on having me in your deck."

cards.name: Lady Deadpool
cards.text: When Defeated: Defeat a non-[[ELITE]] minion.

cards.name: Barely a Scratch
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage from an attack, prevent 1 of that damage for each [crisis], [acceleration], [amplify], and [hazard] in play.

cards.name: Cutupper
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to an enemy. Stun that enemy.
cards.flavor: SQUEAK!

cards.name: Da Bomb
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Deal 10 damage to the villain. Deal 1 damage to each enemy and hero for each [crisis], [acceleration], [amplify], and [hazard] in play.

cards.name: Get Rage-y
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Action: Ready an ally. That ally gets +1 ATK until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: "You call that a pull-up?" —Sergeant Deadpool

cards.name: "I Got This"
cards.text: Hero Action: If the following icons are on 1 or more cards in play: [crisis] — Deal 3 damage to an enemy. [acceleration] — Remove 2 threat from a scheme. [amplify] — Ready an ally you control. [hazard] — Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Not my Responsibility
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Interrupt: When any amount of threat would be placed on a scheme, you or your ally takes it as damage instead.

cards.name: 'Pool Inspection
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (thwart): Remove 5 threat from the main scheme, ignoring the crisis icon ([crisis]). Remove 1 threat from each scheme for each [crisis], [acceleration], [amplify], and [hazard] in play.
cards.flavor: "This pool is a disaster!" —Deadpool

cards.name: Live Dangerously
cards.text:
Victory 0.
Each identity gets +2 hand size.
cards.flavor: "♫ Nothing can cause me pain! Not even an oncoming tr...♪" —Deadpool

cards.name: Self Confidence
cards.text:
Max 1 per deck.
Double the number of resources this card generates if your identity has sustained less than 5 damage (triple the resources instead if you have sustained no damage).

cards.name: Self Control
cards.text:
Max 1 per deck.
Double the number of resources this card generates if your identity has sustained less than 5 damage (triple the resources instead if you have sustained no damage).

cards.name: Self Preservation
cards.text:
Max 1 per deck.
Double the number of resources this card generates if your identity has sustained less than 5 damage (triple the resources instead if you have sustained no damage).

cards.name: Git Gud
cards.text: Reduce the cost to play Git Gud by 2 if you did not win your previous game of Marvel Champions. Forced Interrupt: When a player would be defeated, they set their hit point dial to 1 and change to alter-ego form instead. Remove this card from the game.

cards.name: Healing Factor
cards.text: Max 1 per player. Response: After the player phase begins, exhaust Healing Factor → heal 2 damage from your identity.
cards.flavor: "Now I'm the best at whatever it is Wolverine does." —Deadpool

cards.name: Stick-To-Itiveness
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Spend a [physical] resource and exhaust this card → ready your hero.
cards.flavor: "Acquiesce? I don't know the meaning of the word." —Deadpool

cards.name: Frenemies
cards.text: Team-Up (Cable and Deadpool). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (thwart): Deal 1 damage each to Cable and Deadpool. Remove 3 threat from a scheme and 3 threat from a different scheme.

cards.name: The Merc with the Mouth
cards.text: Give to the Wade Wilson player. Exhaust each ally you control. Allies you control cannot ready. Other players cannot resolve player card abilities during your turn. Forced Response: After the player phase ends, if you have not talked this phase, discard this card.
cards.flavor: "Was it something I said?" —Deadpool

cards.name: Butler
cards.text:
[star] Forced Interrupt: When Butler schemes, place that threat on Involuntary Procedures, if able. (Deadpool's nemesis minion.)
[star] Boost: You are confused.

cards.name: Involuntary Procedures
cards.text: Forced Response: After Deadpool takes any amount of damage, place 1 threat here. Then, if there is 10 or more threat here, remove this card from the game.
cards.flavor: Butler seeks to cure his sister's cancer using Deadpool's regenerative abilities.

cards.name: Tabula Rasa 16
cards.text:
Attach to your identity. Treat your identity's printed text box as blank (except for [[TRAITS]]). Alter-Ego Action: Spend [mental][mental] resources → discard this card.
[star] Boost: Attach Tabula Rasa 16 to your identity.
cards.flavor: Butler used this drug to erase Deadpool's memory of Butler's medical experiments.

cards.name: Mutated Soldier
cards.text: Toughness. [star] Forced Response: After Mutated Soldier activates, heal all damage from it.
cards.flavor: Butler funded his research by developing super soldiers for foreign governments.

cards.name: Crisis of Infinite Deadpools
cards.text: When Revealed: Reveal the set-aside Dreadpool minion and Dreadful Deeds side scheme. Shuffle the rest of the set-aside Dreadpool encounter set into the encounter deck. Remove this card from the game.

cards.name: Dreadpool
cards.text: Dreadpool engages the first player. When Defeated: Deal Dreadpool to the player who defeated him as a facedown encounter card.
cards.flavor: "What I do...I do for the cause. But I still feel bad about it...usually."

cards.name: Dreadful Deeds
cards.text: When Revealed: Place 2 threat here for each player who controls 1 or more 'Pool (pink) cards.
cards.flavor: Dreadpool believes the only way to end his suffering is to kill every being in all of the multiverse.

cards.name: Anti-Regeneration Ray
cards.text: Attach to Dreadpool. Otherwise, attach to the villain. Forced Interrupt: When attached character attacks a non-villain character, treat the attacked character's text box as if it were blank (except for [[TRAITS]]) until the end of the attack. Hero Action: Spend [energy][mental][physical] resources → attach this card to your identity.

cards.name: 'Pool-ized
cards.text: Treat attached ally as a [['POOL]] minion with a blank text box. Attached minion's SCH is equal to its printed THW and it does not take consequential damage. When Revealed: Attach to the ally with the highest cost without 'Pool-ized attached. Attached ally engages its controller. Otherwise, this card gains surge.

cards.name: Metacidal Tendencies
cards.text: When Revealed: Deal 2 damage to each [[DEADPOOL CORPS]] character (3 damage instead if Dreadpool is in play). If no damage was dealt this way, place 1 acceleration token on the main scheme.

cards.name: Bob, Agent of Hydra
cards.text: Response: After Bob, Agent of Hydra enters play, deal 2 damage to an enemy or remove 1 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Negasonic Teenage Warhead
cards.text: Interrupt: When a treachery is revealed, deal 2 damage to Negasonic Teenage Warhead → cancel that treachery's "When Revealed" effects.

cards.name: Pandapool
cards.text: Toughness.
cards.flavor: What's black and white and red all over?

cards.name: Break Time
cards.text: Alliance. Max 1 per deck. Alter-Ego Action: Take a group break. Leave the table. Read a comic book. When you come back to the game, heal 1 damage from each identity for every minute you were away from the game.

cards.name: Get in Front of Me!
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Interrupt: When a treachery card is revealed from the encounter deck, cancel its "When Revealed" effects. The villain attacks you instead. If an ally or another hero defends this attack, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Mulligan
cards.text: You cannot play this card if you have played another card this phase. Action: Discard your hand. Draw a new hand. (Draw up to your hand size.)
cards.flavor: "This hand could be so much better!" —Deadpool

cards.name: Deadpool Corps Ship
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Deadpool Corps Ship and deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card → put a 'Pool ally into play from your hand.
cards.flavor: This spaceship serves as the Deadpool Corps' mobile base of operations.

cards.name: Plot Convenience
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Plot Convenience → choose: • Attach 1 aspect card from your hand facedown here (to a maximum of 3). • Add 1 card attached facedown here to your hand. Any player may trigger this ability.

cards.name: Ambush
cards.text: Attach to a side scheme. Max 1 per side scheme. Interrupt: When attached side scheme is defeated, discard a non-[[ELITE]] minion.

cards.name: Bazooka
cards.text: Restricted. Max 2 per deck. Hero Action (attack): Discard Bazooka → deal 1 damage to an enemy for each [crisis], [acceleration], [amplify], and [hazard] in play. This attack gains ranged.

cards.name: Blackout
cards.text: Hero Action: Spend 1 resource of any type → move 1 threat from a scheme to an empty space above that matches the spent resource. If all spaces above are filled, discard this card and confuse the villain.

cards.name: Distraction
cards.text:
Attach to a non-[[ELITE]] minion. Max 1 per minion.
Attached minion cannot activate.

cards.name: Laser Swords
cards.text:
Counts as 2 restricted cards. Max 1 per deck.
Your hero gets +1 ATK for each [crisis], [acceleration], [amplify], and [hazard] in play (to a maximum of +4 ATK).
cards.flavor: "Fwoom, Ksh! Fwoom, Kssssh!" —Kidpool

cards.name: Rock, Paper, Scissors
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust this card, choose 1 card in your hand, and discard the top card of your deck → using the diagram above, if a printed resource on the chosen card beats (points to) a printed resource on the discarded card, add the discarded card to your hand.

cards.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
cards.text: Hero Action: Spend 1 resource of any type → move 1 damage from a character to an empty space above matching the spent resource. If there are 3 damage tokens in a line, deal all damage on this card to an enemy and discard this card.

cards.name: War
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust War → discard the top card of the encounter deck. Take 1 damage for each icon ([star] and [boost]) in the boost area of that card. Discard the top card of your deck. Deal damage to an enemy equal to that card's cost.

cards.name: Bishop
cards.text: Energy Absorption — Response: After Bishop takes any amount of damage from an attack, discard an equal number of cards from the top of your deck. Add each resource card discarded this way to your hand.

cards.name: Lucas Bishop
cards.text: Temporally Displaced — Response: After you change to this form, add a TEMPORAL card in your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor: "When I journeyed to the past to save my future, this was not what I had in mind."

cards.name: Malcolm
cards.text: Action: Discard a resource card from your hand → ready Malcolm. If that card has a printed [physical] icon, heal 1 damage from Malcolm. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "Multiple contacts. Engaging."

cards.name: Randall
cards.text: Action: Discard a resource card from your hand → ready Randall. If that card has a printed [energy] icon, heal 1 damage from Randall. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "We're with you, boss. All the way."

cards.name: Bishop's Rifle
cards.text: Restricted. Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Bishop's Rifle and choose an enemy → deal 1 damage to that enemy for each resource card in your hand. This attack gains ranged.

cards.name: Bishop's Uniform
cards.text: Response: After you resolve Bishop's "Energy Absorption" ability, exhaust Bishop's Uniform → heal 1 damage from Bishop for each resource card in your hand.

cards.name: Super-Charged
cards.text: Action: Discard a resource card from your hand → place 1 charge counter here for each resource icon on that card. Hero Interrupt: When you make a basic attack, discard Super-Charged → you get +2 ATK for this attack for each charge counter here (to a maximum of +8 ATK).

cards.name: Concussive Blast
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this event with a resource card, ready Bishop.
cards.flavor: Bishop's power allows him to absorb energy and rechannel it into powerful blasts.

cards.name: Command Authority
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If you paid for this event with a resource card, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "Everyone, on me!" —Bishop

cards.name: Energy Conversion
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy attacks, shuffle each resource card in your discard pile into your deck. You cannot take more than 3 damage from this attack.

cards.name: Stored Energy
cards.flavor: "The more you hit me, the harder I hit back!" —Bishop

cards.name: Cable
cards.text: Response: After Cable thwarts and defeats a side scheme, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "I know too much about what the future holds."

cards.name: X-23
cards.text: Response: After X-23 attacks and defeats an enemy, ready her.
cards.flavor: "Call me 'Lady-Wolverine' one more time - I dare you!"

cards.name: Team Training
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Each ally you control gets +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: "We mostly just wait for Cap to yell 'Avengers Assemble' and attack in the same direction as him" —Clint Barton

cards.name: Advanced Suit
cards.text: Attach to an [[X-FORCE]] or [[X-MEN]] ally. Max 1 per ally. Response: After attached ally defeats a minion or side scheme, discard 1 card from your hand → heal 1 damage from attached ally for each resource on that card.

cards.name: Sidekick
cards.text: Attach to an identity-specific ally you control. Max 1 per deck. Attached ally gets +2 hit points and is your "sidekick." Response: After you make a basic recovery, heal 2 damage from attached ally.

cards.name: Side-by-Side
cards.text: Hero Action: Ready your sidekick → ready your hero and choose one: • Heal 1 damage from both characters. • Both characters get +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Suit Up
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Search your deck and discard pile for an ally and an upgrade that can be attached to that ally. Add them to your hand. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Lead from the Front
cards.text: Hero Action: Choose a player. Each character that player controls gets +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: "Let's go everyone!" —Carol Danvers

cards.name: The Power of Leadership
cards.text: Max 2 per deck. Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Leadership (blue) card.

cards.name: Legion
cards.text: [star] Response: After Legion uses a basic power, discard the top card of your deck. If that card's printed resource has: [energy] — Deal 2 damage to an enemy. [mental] — Remove 2 threat from a scheme. [physical] — Heal 2 damage from Legion.

cards.name: Marrow
cards.text: Play only if you have the [[X-FORCE]] or [[X-MEN]] trait. Response: After Marrow enters play, deal 2 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "You won't look so pretty once I get you!"

cards.name: Energy
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Genius
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Strength
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Fear the Future
cards.text: Give to the Lucas Bishop player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Exhaust Lucas Bishop → remove Fear the Future from the game. • Discard this card and each resource card from your hand. If no resource cards are discarded this way, this card gains surge.

cards.name: Trevor Fitzroy
cards.text: Quickstrike. Forced Response: After Trevor Fitzroy attacks and defeats an ally, if Portal Through Time is in play, place 2 threat on it. Otherwise, find it and reveal it. (Bishop's nemesis minion.)

cards.name: Portal Through Time
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When a [[Temporal]] card is revealed, it gains surge. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: Trevor Fitzroy uses his time portals to commit crimes and escape justice.

cards.name: Bantam
cards.text: When Revealed: If Portal Through Time is in play, place 2 threat on it. Otherwise, find Portal Through Time and reveal it.
cards.flavor: "Time to go, Trevor."

cards.name: Temporal Trickery
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard a card in your hand with the most printed resource icons. Place 1 threat on each scheme for each resource icon on that card.
cards.flavor: "That's why I love time travel no matter how many times I rob this bank, they're always surprised." —Trevor Fitzroy

cards.name: Magik
cards.text:
Play with the top card of your deck faceup.
Once per phase, you may play the top card of your deck as if it was in your hand, reducing its resource cost by 1.
cards.flavor: "There are no snowflakes in Limbo."

cards.name: Illyana Rasputin
cards.text: Interrupt: When you change to hero form, choose a SPELL in your discard pile and put it on top of your deck. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "I would sell the last piece of my soul for an egg roll right now!"

cards.name: Colossus
cards.text: Toughness. Interrupt: When an enemy attacks you, play Colossus from your hand (paying his resource cost) and declare him the defender without exhausting him.
cards.flavor: "I will always protect you, little Snowflake."

cards.name: Limbo
cards.text: Response: After the villain phase begins, exhaust Limbo → swap a card in your hand with the top card of your deck. Action: Exhaust Limbo → swap a card in your hand with the top card of your deck.

cards.name: Magik's Crown
cards.text:
Magik gains steady.
While the top card of your deck has a [mental] or [wild] resource icon, Magik gets +1 THW.
cards.flavor: Raised in Limbo, Magik is destined to usurp its rule from the man who brought her there.

cards.name: Soulsword
cards.text:
Restricted.
Magik's basic attacks gain piercing.
While the top card of your deck has a [physical] or [wild] resource icon, Magik gets +1 ATK.

cards.name: Mystical Armor
cards.text:
Magik gains retaliate 1.
While the top card of your deck has a [energy] or [wild] resource icon, Magik gets +1 DEF.
cards.flavor: It's very fashionable in Limbo.

cards.name: Scrying
cards.text: Action: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Draw one, discard one, and put one back on top of your deck.
cards.flavor: "Yes, I've seen your future. No, I will not tell you."—Magik

cards.name: Stepping Disc
cards.text: Hero Action: Ready your hero. Choose a Magik card in your discard pile not named Stepping Disc and put it on top of your deck.
cards.flavor: Magik's teleportation discs can take her anywhere by opening a portal through Limbo.

cards.name: Exorcism
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 4 threat from a scheme. If the top card of your deck has a [mental] or [wild] resource icon, confuse the villain.
cards.flavor: "I have purged the evil from within you." —Magik

cards.name: Soul Strike
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. If the top card of your deck has a [physical] or [wild] resource icon, stun that enemy.
cards.flavor: "Very well. Feel the bite of my Soulsword!" —Magik

cards.name: Magic Barrier
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy initiates an attack, prevent 3 damage from this attack. If the top card of your deck has a [energy] or [wild] resource icon, deal 3 damage to the attacking enemy.

cards.name: Goldballs
cards.text: [star] Interrupt: When Goldballs attacks, discard up to 3 cards from the top of your deck → Goldballs gets +X ATK for this attack, where X is the number of cards discarded this way.
cards.flavor: "I didn't choose the name."

cards.name: Tempus
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[X-MEN]] trait. Interrupt: When the villain would scheme, discard Tempus → cancel that activation. Deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card.

cards.name: Blood Rage
cards.text: Max 1 per player. Response: After you defeat an enemy with a basic attack, exhaust Blood Rage and take 1 damage → draw 1 card.

cards.name: Test the Defense
cards.text: Max 1 per player. Response: After you play an [[ATTACK]] event, place 1 test counter here. If there are 5 test counters here, discard this card to deal 5 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Full-Body Charge
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 8 damage to an enemy. If your hero's remaining hit points are less than half your hero's starting hit points, this attack gains overkill.
cards.flavor: "Coming through, tovarisch!"—Colossus

cards.name: Clobber
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. If this is the first card you have played this round, return this card to your hand.
cards.flavor: "It feels good to hit ninjas again." —Psylocke

cards.name: The Power of Aggression
cards.text: Max 2 per deck. Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Aggression (red) card.

cards.name: Triage
cards.text: Response: After Triage enters play, heal 2 damage from an [[X-Men]] character.
cards.flavor: "Let me have a look at that."

cards.name: Stepford Cuckoos
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[X-Men]] trait. Uses (3 psi counters). Interrupt: When a player reveals a treachery, exhaust Stepford Cuckoos and remove 1 psi counter here → cancel the effects of that card and discard it. That player reveals another encounter card.

cards.name: Bloodgem
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[MYSTIC]] trait. Max 1 per deck. Resource: Exhaust Bloodgem and take 2 damage → generate a [wild] resource.

cards.name: Basic Spell
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[MYSTIC]] trait. Hero Action: Choose one: • Heal 3 damage from an identity. • Remove 3 threat from a scheme. • Deal 3 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Spiritual Meditation
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Mystic]] trait. Action: Draw 2 cards. Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
cards.flavor: "Every spell, every sigil, every manipulation... you must keep a close eye on everything so it doesn't backfire."
cards.illustrator: Morry Hollowell, Steve McNiven, & Dexter Vines

cards.name: Darkchilde
cards.text: Give to the Illyana Rasputin player. You may flip to alter-ego form. Choose: • Exhaust Illyana Rasputin → remove Darkchilde from the game. • Deal 1 damage to each character you control. Discard this obligation.

cards.name: Belasco
cards.text: Villainous. [star] Forced Response: After Belasco activates against you, discard the top 3 cards of your deck. If Ruler of Limbo is in play, attach those cards to it facedown. (Magik's nemesis minion.)

cards.name: Ruler of Limbo
cards.text: Threat cannot be removed from this scheme while Belasco is in play. When Revealed: The Illyana Rasputin player finds Limbo and attaches it facedown here. When this scheme is defeated, put Limbo into play under its owner's control.

cards.name: S'ym
cards.text: Guard. When Revealed: If Ruler of Limbo is in play, place 2 threat on it. Otherwise, place 2 threat on the main scheme.
cards.flavor: "The boss says he's had enough of your constant meddling."

cards.name: Witchfire
cards.text: Quickstrike. Forced Response: After Witchfire attacks and defeats an ally, place 1 threat on Ruler of Limbo. Otherwise, place 1 threat on the main scheme.
cards.flavor: "Limbo is my birthright!"

cards.name: Battle for Limbo
cards.text:
When Revealed: Each [[Limbo]] minion in play activates against the player it is engaged with. If no [[Limbo]] minion activated this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: If Ruler of Limbo is in play, place 2 threat on it.

cards.flavor: Prelate Unus and his squad of Infinites scour the ruins of the X-Mansion for the enemies of Apocalypse.

cards.name: Prelate Sidearm
cards.text: Attach to Unus. [star] Forced Response: After Unus attacks and defeats an ally, place 1 threat on Gene Pool. Hero Response: After you make a basic attack against Unus, spend [energy] [physical] resources → discard this card.

cards.name: Prelate Armor
cards.text: Attach to Unus. [star] Forced Response: After Unus schemes, give him a tough status card. Hero Response: After you make a basic attack against Unus, spend [mental] [physical] resources → discard this card.

cards.name: Infinite Hunter
cards.text:
When Revealed: Deal 3 damage to an ally you control.
[star] Boost: Choose to either place 2 threat on Gene Pool, or the activating enemy gets +2 SCH and +2 ATK for this activation.

cards.name: Genetic Experiments
cards.text:
Attach to an [[Infinite]] minion. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Attached minion gets +2 hit points. Forced Interrupt: When attached minion is defeated, place 2 threat on Gene Pool.
[star] Boost: Attach this card to an [[Infinite]] minion.

cards.name: Infinite Prelate
cards.text: When Revealed: Unus activates against you. If the amount of threat on Gene Pool is at least: • 3 — Give Unus a tough status card. • 6 — Heal 3 damage from Unus as well. • 9 — Give Unus an additional boost card for this activation as well.

cards.name: Endless Ranks
cards.text: When Defeated: Place 3 threat on Gene Pool.
cards.flavor: The Infinites live up to their name: no matter how many you defeat, they keep making more.

cards.name: Infinite Soldier
cards.text:
Guard.
If the amount of threat on Gene Pool is at least:
• 3 — This minion gains quickstrike.
• 6 — This minion also gains surge.
• 9 — This minion also gets +3 hit points.

cards.name: Culling the Weak
cards.text:
When Revealed: Place 4 threat on Gene Pool.
[star] Boost: Place 2 threat on Gene Pool.
cards.flavor: The Infinites were created to enforce the mandate of Apocalypse: the weak must perish.

cards.name: Gene Pool
cards.text: Permanent. Setup. Forced Response: After an ally is defeated by anything other than consequential damage, place 3 threat here.
cards.flavor: Apocalypse uses the raw genetic material of his victims to create the Infinites.

cards.name: Hunted
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Discard a card from your hand → discard this card.

cards.name: War-Weary
cards.text:
When Revealed: You are stunned. If you were already stunned, take 2 damage instead.
[star] Boost: You are stunned. If you were already stunned, take 2 damage instead.

cards.name: Targeted for Extermination
cards.text: When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme confuses their identity.
cards.flavor: The Infinites hunt down those whom their master deems unworthy.

cards.name: Pursued by the Past
cards.text: Permanent. Setup. Forced Response: After you place a pursuit counter here, if the number of counters here is at least 3 more than the number of players, remove each counter here → if your nemesis minion is in play, it activates against you. Otherwise, flip this card over.

cards.name: Pursued by the Past
cards.text: Permanent. Forced Response: After you flip to this side, find your nemesis minion and reveal it. Search the set-aside area for your nemesis side scheme and reveal it. Shuffle your remaining set-aside nemesis set into the encounter deck. Flip this card over.

cards.name: Dark Designs
cards.text: When Revealed: Place 1 pursuit counter on Pursued by the Past. Then, if it has any counters on it, the villain schemes. [star] Boost: After this activation resolves, place 1 pursuit counter on Pursued by the Past.

cards.name: Sinister Strike
cards.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Place 1 pursuit counter on Pursued by the Past. Then, if it has any counters on it, this card gains surge. When Revealed (Hero): Place 1 pursuit counter on Pursued by the Past. Then, if it has any counters on it, the villain attacks you.

cards.name: Evil Alliance
cards.text: When Revealed: Each nemesis minion in play activates against you. If no minions activated this way, place 3 pursuit counters on Pursued by the Past. [star] Boost: After this activation resolves, place 1 pursuit counter on Pursued by the Past.

cards.name: Nowhere is Safe
cards.text:
When Revealed: Place 1 pursuit counter on Pursued by the Past. Then, if it has any counters on it, discard an upgrade or support you control.
[star] Boost: After this activation resolves, place 1 pursuit counter on Pursued by the Past.

cards.name: Drawing Near
cards.text: Forced Response: After your turn begins, discard the top card of your deck. Place 1 pursuit counter on Pursued by the Past for each printed resource icon on that card. Alter-Ego Action: Discard an identity-specific card from your hand → discard this card.

cards.name: War
cards.text: [star] Forced Response: After War attacks you, if he has at least 1 hit point, discard an upgrade or support you control. War cannot be defeated while another villain has at least 1 hit point.

cards.name: War
cards.text: [star] Forced Response: After War attacks you, if he has at least 1 hit point, discard an upgrade or support you control. War cannot be defeated while another villain has at least 1 hit point.

cards.text: [star] Forced Response: After Famine attacks you, if she has at least 1 hit point, discard the top 10 cards of your deck. Famine cannot be defeated while another villain has at least 1 hit point.

cards.name: Pestilence
cards.text: [star] Forced Response: After Pestilence attacks you, if she has at least 1 hit point, treat your identity's text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]) until the next villain phase begins. Pestilence cannot be defeated while another villain has at least 1 hit point.

cards.name: Pestilence

cards.name: Death
cards.text: [star] Forced Response: After Death attacks you, if he has at least 1 hit point, deal 1 damage to each character you control. Death cannot be defeated while another villain has at least 1 hit point.

cards.name: Death
cards.text: [star] Forced Response: After Death attacks you, if he has at least 1 hit point, deal 1 damage to each character you control. Death cannot be defeated while another villain has at least 1 hit point.

cards.name: The Horsemen of Apocalypse
cards.text: Forced Response: After a villain activates, move the active counter to the next villain. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.
cards.flavor: The Four Horsemen are the most brutal servants of Apocalypse. They strike in turn, using their powers as a team.
cards.backText: Contents: War (A), Famine (A), Pestilence (A), Death (A), Four Horsemen, Standard, and two modular sets (Dystopian Nightmare and Hounds). Setup: Shuffle the four [[Horsemen]] villains, then reveal them in a row from left to right. Place the active counter on the leftmost villain (see rulebook). Each player reveals a random side scheme from the Four Horsemen encounter set.

cards.name: The Horsemen of Apocalypse
cards.text: Forced Response: After a villain activates, move the active counter to the next villain. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.
cards.flavor: The Four Horsemen are the most brutal servants of Apocalypse. They strike in turn, using their powers as a team.

cards.name: The Ravages of War
cards.text: When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme discards an upgrade or support they control.
cards.flavor: War uses the shockwaves created by his arms to keep his opponents off balance.

cards.name: A Time of Famine
cards.text: When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme discards the top 10 cards of their deck.
cards.flavor: The mere touch of Famine leaves even the strongest mutant enfeebled.

cards.name: Plague and Pestilence
cards.text: When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme treats their identity's text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]) until the next villain phase begins.
cards.flavor: Pestilence uses her power to make her enemies sick and helpless.

cards.name: The Specter of Death
cards.text: When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme deals 1 damage to each character they control.
cards.flavor: The shadow of Death drives fear into the hearts of those he hunts.

cards.name: Golden Horse
cards.text: Attach to the villain with the fewest hit points without the [[Aerial]] trait. Attached villain gains the [[Aerial]] trait and is considered to have at least 1 hit point. Hero Response: After you attack attached villain, resolve its "Forced Response" as if it just attacked you → discard this card.

cards.name: Metal Wings
cards.text: Attach to Death and move the active counter to him. Death gains retaliate 1 and is considered to have at least 1 hit point remaining. Hero Response: After you attack Death, resolve his "Forced Response" as if he just attacked you → discard this card.

cards.name: Horseman of War
cards.text:
When Revealed: Heal 2 damage from War and give him a tough status card. He activates against you.
[star] Boost: After this activation, War activates against you. Do not give War a boost card for that activation.

cards.name: Horseman of Famine
cards.text:
When Revealed: Heal 2 damage from Famine and give her a tough status card. She activates against you.
[star] Boost: After this activation, Famine activates against you. Do not give Famine a boost card for that activation.

cards.name: Horseman of Pestilence
cards.text:
When Revealed: Heal 2 damage from Pestilence and give her a tough status card. She activates against you.
[star] Boost: After this activation, Pestilence activates against you. Do not give Pestilence a boost card for that activation.

cards.name: Horseman of Death
cards.text:
When Revealed: Heal 2 damage from Death and give him a tough status card. He activates against you.
[star] Boost: After this activation, Death activates against you. Do not give Death a boost card for that activation.

cards.name: Rough Riders
cards.text: When Revealed: Resolve the "Forced Response" on the active villain as if it has at least 1 hit point and attacked you. Move the active counter to the next villain and resolve its "Forced Response" the same way.

cards.name: Ahab
cards.text: Toughness. When Revealed: If Release the Hounds is in play, place 3 threat on it. Otherwise, find the Release the Hounds side scheme and reveal it.
cards.flavor: "You cannot hide from me, mutant."

cards.name: Hound
cards.text: Guard. When Revealed: If you are in hero form, Hound attacks you. Otherwise, change your identity to hero form.
cards.flavor: Ahab's hounds are mutants stripped of free will and forced to hunt their own kind.

cards.name: Ahab's Energy Spear
cards.text: Attach to Ahab. Otherwise, attach to the villain. [star] Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy attacks you, this attack gains overkill and piercing. At the end of this attack, discard Ahab's Energy Spear.

cards.name: Release the Hounds
cards.text: The first copy of Hound revealed each phase gains surge. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Hound and deals it to themself as a facedown encounter card.
cards.flavor: Ahab takes pleasure in hunting mutants with the help of his hounds.

cards.name: Apocalypse
cards.text: Toughness. Forced Interrupt: When the main scheme is completed, remove all threat from it (ignoring any crisis ([crisis]) icons). Flip this card and reveal Apocalypse (II).
cards.flavor: "Challenge me and be reminded why Apocalypse reigns supreme."

cards.name: Apocalypse
cards.text: Steady. Toughness. Forced Interrupt: When the main scheme is completed, remove all threat from it (ignoring any crisis ([crisis]) icons). Remove this card from the game and reveal Apocalypse (III).
cards.flavor: "You are foolish to oppose me."

cards.name: Apocalypse
cards.text: Steady. Toughness. Forced Interrupt: When the main scheme is completed, remove all threat from it (ignoring any crisis ([crisis]) icons). Flip this card and reveal Apocalypse (IV).
cards.flavor: "This world belongs to me and those I deem worthy."

cards.name: Apocalypse
cards.text: Stalwart. Toughness. [star] Apocalypse's attacks gain overkill. Forced Interrupt: When the main scheme is completed, the players lose the game.
cards.flavor: "I will cleanse this world with fire. Only the strong will survive."

cards.name: The Age of Apocalypse
cards.text: X is the numeral in Apocalypse's printed hit point value. Forced Interrupt: When Apocalypse would be defeated, discard each attachment from him and heal all damage from him instead. Remove X threat from this scheme (ignoring any crisis ([crisis]) icons).
cards.flavor: The time has come for a direct assault on Apocalypse in his towering citadel.
cards.backText: Contents: Apocalypse (II) and Apocalypse (III). (Apocalypse (III) only for expert mode.) Apocalypse, Prelates, and Standard sets. Two modular sets (Dark Riders and Infinites). Setup: Set aside each unused villain card, each [[Prelate]] minion, and The Tyrant's Throne side scheme. Reveal the Heart of the Empire side scheme. The first player reveals a random, set-aside [[Prelate]] minion.

cards.name: Heart of the Empire
cards.text: Threat cannot be removed from this scheme while a [[Prelate]] minion is in play. When Defeated: The first player reveals a random set-aside [[Prelate]] minion. Deal each other player an encounter card. Flip this card over.
cards.flavor: Before you can challenge Apocalypse, you must fight your way through his tower.

cards.name: The Towering Citadel
cards.text: Threat cannot be removed from this scheme while a [[Prelate]] minion is in play. When Defeated: The first player reveals a random set-aside [[Prelate]] minion. Deal each other player an encounter card. Reveal The Tyrant's Throne side scheme and remove this card from the game.

cards.name: The Tyrant's Throne
cards.text: Threat cannot be removed from this scheme while a [[Prelate]] minion is in play. When Defeated: The first player reveals a random set-aside [[Prelate]] minion. Deal each other player an encounter card. Flip this card over and reveal No Longer Worthy.

cards.name: No Longer Worthy
cards.text: Attach to Apocalypse and heal 5[per_hero] hit points from him. He cannot take damage while a Prelate minion is in play. Ignore the "Forced Interrupt" on the main scheme. Forced Interrupt: When Apocalypse is defeated, the players win the game.

cards.name: Cyberpathy
cards.text:
Attach to Apocalypse. [star] Forced Response: After Apocalypse schemes, place 1 threat on each side scheme.
[star] Boost: Attach this card to Apocalypse.

cards.name: Biomorphing
cards.text:
Attach to Apocalypse. [star] Apocalypse's attacks gain overkill.
[star] Boost: Attach this card to Apocalypse.

cards.name: Molecular Control
cards.text:
Attach to Apocalypse. Apocalypse gains retaliate 1 and stalwart.
[star] Boost: Attach this card to Apocalypse.
cards.flavor: Apocalypse's power to control every molecule in his body makes him an unpredictable foe.

cards.name: The Fittest
cards.text:
Attach to the minion with the highest printed hit points and give it a tough status card. Otherwise, this card gains surge.
Attached enemy gets +5 hit points.
cards.flavor: Apocalypse promotes only the strongest and most ruthless mutants to the rank of Prelate.

cards.name: Wolf Among Sheep
cards.text:
When Revealed: The [[Prelate]] minion activates against you. Otherwise, Apocalypse activates against you.
[star] Boost: Give the [[Prelate]] minion a tough status card. Otherwise, give Apocalypse a tough status card.

cards.name: The Apocalypse Solution
cards.text: When Defeated: Discard the top X cards of the encounter deck, where X is the numeral in Apocalypse's printed hit point value.
cards.flavor: Apocalypse would rather burn his kingdom to the ground than surrender his rule.

cards.name: Gauntlet
cards.text: Teamwork ([[Dark Riders]]). [star] Forced Response: After Gauntlet attacks you, discard an upgrade you control.
cards.flavor: "You want someone gone? You hire the Dark Riders."

cards.name: Barrage
cards.text: Teamwork ([[Dark Riders]]). [star] Forced Response: After Barrage attacks you, deal 1 damage to each character you control.
cards.flavor: "Don't expect someone named 'Barrage' to be picky with their targets." —Cyclops

cards.name: Hard-Drive
cards.text: Teamwork ([[Dark Riders]]). [star] Forced Response: After Hard-Drive attacks you, place 1 threat on each scheme.
cards.flavor: "I've finished my scan. Ready to jump."

cards.name: Tusk
cards.text:
Teamwork ([[Dark Riders]]). [star] Forced Response: After Tusk attacks you, you are stunned.
[star] Boost: You are stunned.

cards.name: Psynapse
cards.text:
Teamwork ([[Dark Riders]]). [star] Forced Response: After Psynapse attacks you, you are confused.
[star] Boost: You are confused.

cards.name: The Dark Riders
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. Each [[Dark Riders]] minion gains toughness. When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until a [[Dark Riders]] minion is discarded and reveal it.
cards.flavor: Dark Riders live by the axiom: The weak must perish.

cards.name: Dark Beast
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Dark Beast attacks you, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[Setting]] environment. When Revealed: Reveal a random set-aside environment and shuffle the rest of its encounter set into the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: "A villain's work is never done!"

cards.name: Dark Beast
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Dark Beast attacks you, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[Setting]] environment. When Revealed: Reveal a random set-aside environment and shuffle the rest of its encounter set into the encounter deck. Deal each player an encounter card.

cards.name: Dark Beast
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Dark Beast attacks you, resolve the "Special" ability on the [[Setting]] environment. When Revealed: Reveal a random set-aside environment and shuffle the rest of its encounter set into the encounter deck. Deal each player an encounter card.

cards.name: Dark Beast's Bogus Journey
cards.text: If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.
cards.flavor: Dark Beast activates his time machine to ensure the rise of Apocalypse, but your quick action ruins his calculations. You wrestle for control of the device as it transports you through time and space!

cards.flavor: "The name's 'Patch.' Just 'Patch.'" —Wolverine

cards.flavor: "You hurt self-friends! No you will pay!" —Warlock

cards.name: Three Steps Ahead
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): For each different resource type ([energy], [mental], [physical], and [wild]) you used to pay for this card, choose a scheme and remove 2 threat from it.
cards.flavor: "You should be proud, Rogue—me and Glob worked this out ahead of time!" —Anole

cards.name: Generation X
cards.text: Victory 0. Each [[X-Men]] character gets +1 THW while making a basic thwart against this scheme. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for an identity-specific event and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: The Power of Justice
cards.text: Max 2 per deck. Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Justice (yellow) card.

cards.name: Synch
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[X-Men]] trait. Interrupt: When you use a basic power, exhaust Synch → you get +1 to that power for this use.

cards.name: Cell Phone
cards.text: Uses (3 charge counters). Action: Exhaust Cell Phone, remove 1 charge counter from here, and choose a player → that player makes a basic attack or thwart with a character they control. That character gets +1 THW and +1 ATK for this use.

cards.name: X-Gene
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[MUTANT]] trait. Max 1 per player Resource: Exhaust X-Gene → generate a [wild] resource for an identity-specific event.

cards.name: Multitalented
cards.text: Hero Action (attack/thwart): If you paid for this event using at least 1: [physical] — Deal 2 damage to an enemy. [mental] — Remove 2 threat from a scheme. [energy] — Heal 2 damage from your identity.

cards.name: Unlikely Duo
cards.text: Team-Up (Jubilee and Wolverine). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (attack): Confuse an enemy. Deal 4 damage to a confused enemy.

cards.name: Grounded
cards.text: Give to the Jubilation Lee player. As an additional cost to change to hero form during your turn, you must spend 2 resources of the same type. When Revealed: Change to alter-ego form. Response: After you play a Jubilee event, remove this card from the game.

cards.name: Nanny
cards.text: Toughness. [star] Forced Response: After Nanny attacks you, if you control 1 or more allies, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and set-aside area for 1 copy of "Lost" Child and reveal it.

cards.name: Naughty Children
cards.text: When Revealed: Place 1 threat here for each different resource type ([energy], [mental], [physical], and [wild]) on cards in your hand.
cards.flavor: Nanny trods all over the line between "rescuing" and "kidnapping."

cards.name: Battle Suit
cards.text:
Attach to the minion with the fewest remaining hit points. Otherwise, this card gains surge.
Attached minion gets +3 hit points and gains the [[Aerial]] trait.
cards.flavor: Nanny's battle suit design belies its true capabilities.

cards.name: "Lost" Child
cards.text: Treat attached ally as a [[Regressed]] minion with a blank text box. Attached minion's SCH is equal to its printed THW and it does not take consequential damage. When Revealed: Attach to the ally with the highest cost without "Lost" Child attached. Attached ally engages its controller. Otherwise, this card gains surge.

cards.name: Mutant Mayhem
cards.text: Alliance. Hero Action: Choose an [[X-Force]] ally and an [[X-Men]] ally and return them to their owners' hands → those players play those allies, ignoring their resource costs.

cards.name: Serve and Protect
cards.text: Alliance. Hero Interrupt: When any amount of threat would be placed on the main scheme, exhaust an [[X-Force]] character and an [[X-Men]] character → prevent that threat and give each of those characters a tough status card.

cards.name: Arcade
cards.text: Arcade cannot take damage while a [[Trap!]] side scheme is in play. When Revealed: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Trap!]] side scheme is discarded and reveal it.
cards.flavor: "I'm so glad my mercenaries convinced you to come!"

cards.name: Welcome to Murderworld
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: The player who defeated this side scheme takes 2 damage.
cards.flavor: "These rides are killer!" —Arcade

cards.name: Arcade's Funhouse
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: The player who defeated this side scheme is stunned. If they were already stunned, they discard an ally or upgrade they control.

cards.name: Hall of Mirrors
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: The player who defeated this side scheme is confused. If they were already confused, place 2 threat on the main scheme.

cards.name: Elaborate Trap
cards.text: When Revealed: Resolve the "When Defeated" ability on each [[Trap!]] side scheme as if you defeated it. If no abilities were resolved this way, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Trap!]] side scheme is discarded and reveal it.
cards.flavor: "Because overkill is underrated." —Arcade

cards.name: Nightcrawler
cards.text: Rapid Teleportation — Action: Spend 1 resource of any type → return a copy of Bamf! from your discard pile to your hand. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "Verzeihung! Mind if I cut in?"

cards.name: Kurt Wagner
cards.text: Action: Search your deck for a copy of Bamf! and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "Even in dark times, there is beauty and peace to be found."

cards.name: Daytripper
cards.text: Response: After Daytripper enters play, search your deck and discard pile for a copy of Bamf! and attach it to an enemy. Deal 1 damage to each enemy with a copy of Bamf! attached.

cards.name: Kurt's Chapel
cards.text: Kurt Wagner gets +1 REC. Alter-Ego Response: After you make a basic recovery, exhaust Kurt's Chapel and choose a player → that player draws 1 card.

cards.name: Kurt's Cutlasses
cards.text:
Counts as 2 restricted cards.
Nightcrawler gets +1 ATK, +1 DEF, and gains retaliate 1.
cards.flavor: "I've got two swords: one for each of you!"

cards.name: Prehensile Tail
cards.text: You can control 1 additional upgrade that has the restricted keyword. Resource: Exhaust Prehensile Tail → generate a [wild] resource for an event.
cards.flavor: Nightcrawler's tail allows him to perform attacks others cannot.

cards.name: Bamf!
cards.text: Attach to an enemy. Max 1 per enemy. Hero Interrupt (defense): When attached enemy attacks, discard this card → declare Nightcrawler as the defender without exhausting him.

cards.name: 'Port and Punch
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. Deal 3 damage to each enemy with Bamf! attached.
cards.flavor: Nightcrawler can engage several enemies at once by teleporting as fast as he can strike.

cards.name: Teleport Drop
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Discard a copy of Bamf! from an enemy → deal 8 damage to that enemy and stun it.
cards.flavor: "When you look like a demon, it can be tempting to play the part." —Nightcrawler

cards.name: Scout Ahead
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. You may discard a copy of Bamf! from your hand to remove 3 threat from another scheme.
cards.flavor: "One moment, liebchen — let me make sure it's safe." —Nightcrawler

cards.name: 'Port Away
cards.text: Action: Discard a copy of Bamf! from your hand → change forms and ready your identity.
cards.flavor: "I'll be back!" —Nightcrawler

cards.name: Tally Ho!
cards.text: Hero Response (defense): After Bamf! makes Nightcrawler the defender of an attack, return that copy of Bamf! to your hand. Deal 3 damage to the attacking enemy.

cards.name: Rogue
cards.text: Action: Deal 1 damage to another friendly character → until the end of the round, Rogue gains each of that character's [[Traits]] and adds that character's printed THW and ATK to her matching powers. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Northstar
cards.text: Interrupt: When a boost card is turned faceup during an attack, deal 1 damage to Northstar → cancel all boost icons ([boost]) on that card.
cards.flavor: "Bad guys aren't so scary when you move faster than they blink."

cards.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Response: After you defeat an enemy during the villain phase, exhaust this card → draw 2 cards.

cards.text: Hero Action: Discard cards from the encounter deck until you discard a minion. Put that minion into play engaged with you → heal 3 damage from your identity and give your identity a tough status card.

cards.name: Powerful Punch
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (attack/defense): When an enemy initiates an attack, deal 4 damage to that enemy.

cards.text: Max 2 per deck. Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Protection (green) card.

cards.name: Azazel

Quickstrike. Azazel cannot have upgrades attached.
[star] Boost: Deal Azazel to the Kurt Wagner player as a facedown encounter card.

cards.name: Brimstone Dimension
cards.text: When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme finds Azazel and deals him to themself as a facedown encounter card.
cards.flavor: "All of this could be yours, if you'd only join me!"—Azazel

cards.name: Azazel's Sword
cards.text: Attach to Azazel. Otherwise, attach to the villain. [star] Attached enemy's attacks gain piercing. Hero Response: After attached enemy attacks you, discard 1 random card from your hand → discard this card.

cards.name: Brimstone Strike
cards.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Find Azazel and reveal him. He schemes. When Revealed (Hero): Find Azazel and reveal him.
cards.flavor: Azazel delights in frustrating his opponents by teleporting in and out of combat.

cards.name: Combine Forces
cards.text: Alliance. Hero Action: Exhaust an [[X-Force]] character and an [[X-Men]] character → defeat a non-[[Elite]] minion.

cards.name: Gunboat Diplomacy

cards.name: The Crazy Gang
cards.text: Forced Response: After a non-[[Elite]] minion schemes against a player, deal that minion to that player as a facedown encounter card. Then, if there is more than 1 player in the game, pass that facedown encounter card to the next player.

cards.name: Queen of Hearts
cards.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for The Crazy Gang side scheme and reveal it. If it is already in play, deal yourself a facedown encounter card. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: "Off with his head!"

cards.name: Jester
cards.text: When Revealed: You are confused. If you were already confused, discard a support you control.
cards.flavor: "I'll kick you in the face with fun!"

cards.name: Executioner
cards.text: When Revealed: Executioner attacks the friendly character with the fewest remaining hit points. If this attack defeats an ally, remove that ally from the game.
cards.flavor: The Queen of Hearts keeps him busy with her catchphrase.

cards.name: Tweedledope
cards.text: When Revealed: You are stunned. If you were already stunned, discard an upgrade you control.
cards.flavor: "Hyuk hyuk hyuk!"

cards.name: "Off with His Head!"
cards.text: When Revealed: Each minion activates against the player it is engaged with. If no minion activates this way, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a minion is discarded and reveal that minion.
cards.flavor: It's basically all she ever says.

cards.name: Magneto
cards.text: Magnetic Pull — Action: Discard cards from the top of your deck until a [[Magnetic]] card is discarded → add that card to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I do not need to defend my decisions."

cards.name: Erik Lehnsherr
cards.text: Survivor — Response: After you change to this form, shuffle the top 3 cards of your discard pile into your deck.
cards.flavor: "All that I've endured, and everything I've done, it was all to preserve mutantkind."

cards.name: Asteroid M
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Asteroid M → shuffle the topmost [[Magnetic]] card in your discard pile into your deck and heal 1 damage from your identity.
cards.flavor: "It took considerable effort to rebuild my home. Let's not destroy it again." —Magneto

cards.name: Magneto's Helmet
cards.text: Magneto gains steady. Resource: Exhaust Magneto's Helmet → generate a [wild] resource for a [[Magnetic]] card.
cards.flavor: Magneto's helmet protects him from telepathic attacks.

cards.name: Magneto's Armor
cards.text: Response: After you resolve your "Magnetic Pull" ability, if you discarded at least 1 of the following resource icons: [mental] — Magneto gets +1 THW this round. [physical] — Magneto gets +1 ATK this round. [energy] — Magneto gets +1 DEF this round.

cards.name: Magneto's Cape
cards.text: Magneto gains the [[Aerial]] trait. Response: After you resolve your "Magnetic Pull" ability, exhaust Magneto's Cape → ready Magneto.

cards.name: Magnetic Bubble
cards.text: Magneto gains retaliate 1. Forced Interrupt: When you would take any amount of damage, place it here. Then, if there is at least 6 damage here, discard Magnetic Bubble.

cards.name: Wrapped in Metal
cards.text:
Hero form only. Attach to a non-[[ELITE]] minion.
Attached minion cannot activate. Treat its printed text box as if it were blank.
cards.flavor: "Your power is no match for the Master of Magnetism!"—Magneto

cards.name: Electromagnetic Blast
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If this removes the last threat from that scheme, you may discard an attachment with the text "Hero Action" or "Hero Response."

cards.name: Metal Shards
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 7 damage to an enemy. If this attack defeats that enemy, gain a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "The way to defend mutants is to defeat our enemies." —Magneto

cards.name: Magnetic Missile
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard a minion with Wrapped in Metal attached → deal 5 damage to an enemy and stun it.
cards.flavor: "I have heard your threats, and here is my reply."—Magneto

cards.name: Master of Magnetism
cards.flavor: Magneto's power renders conventional firearms useless against him.

cards.name: M
cards.text: Response: After M enters play, defeat a minion with fewer remaining hit points than M.
cards.flavor: "I don't mind being a bull in a china shop."

cards.name: Kid Omega
cards.text: Response: After Kid Omega enters play, choose: • Spend a [energy] resource → deal 1 damage to each enemy. • Spend a [mental] resource → remove 1 threat from each scheme.

cards.name: Phoenix
cards.text: Response: After Phoenix enters play, choose an [[X-Men]] ally → ready that ally and heal 1 damage from it.
cards.flavor: "Joining the X-Men means joining a family. It means you're never truly alone."

cards.name: Cyclops
cards.text: Response: After Cyclops enters play, choose an enemy. Until the end of the phase, increase the amount of damage that enemy takes from each attack by 1.
cards.flavor: "To me, my X-Men!"

cards.name: Won't Stay Down
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[X-Force]] or [[X-Men]] trait. Max 1 per player. Alter-Ego Action: Discard this card → return an [[X-Force]] or [[X-Men]] ally from your discard pile to your hand.

cards.name: Squared Off
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard cards from the encounter deck until you discard a minion. Put that minion into play engaged with you → play an ally from your hand, reducing its cost by 3.
cards.flavor: "Let's do this." —M

cards.name: Noble Sacrifice
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard an ally you control → heal damage from your hero equal to that ally's printed hit points and give your hero a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "Don't wait for me. Go!" —X-23

cards.name: "You Got This!"
cards.text: Hero Response: After you exhaust your hero to make a basic thwart or attack, discard an ally you control → add that ally's matching power to your hero's power for this use. Ready your hero.

cards.name: New Recruits
cards.text: Victory 0. Play only if your identity has the [[X-Men]] trait. When Defeated: Each player chooses 1 set-aside [[New]] ally and adds it to their hand.
cards.flavor: The dream of every student at Xavier's school is to join the X-Men.

cards.name: White Queen
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[X-Force]] or [[X-Men]] trait. Response: After White Queen enters play, discard a status card from a character.
cards.flavor: "Oh darling, I hardly need psionic powers to manipulate you."

cards.name: Face the Past
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and set-aside area for your nemesis minion and reveal it → ready your hero and draw 3 cards. You cannot attack the villain this phase. Remove this card from the game.

cards.name: Deft Focus
cards.text: Max 1 per player. Hero Action: Exhaust Deft Focus → reduce the resource cost of the next [[superpower]] card you play this turn by 1.

cards.name: Energy
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Genius
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Exodus
cards.text: Steady. Toughness. Villainous. [star] Forced Response: After Exodus attacks you, discard cards from the top of your deck equal to his total ATK. (Magneto's nemesis minion.)

cards.name: Martyr for Mutants
cards.text: When Defeated: The defeating player discards the top 9 cards of their deck.
cards.flavor: Magneto's former Acolytes felt betrayed by their leader's change of heart about mutant and human coexistence.

cards.name: Fabian Cortez
cards.text:
Guard. When Defeated: The defeating player discards the top 4 cards of their deck.
[star] Boost: Discard the top 4 cards of your deck.

cards.name: Frenzy
cards.text:
Quickstrike. [star] Forced Response: After Frenzy attacks you, discard the top 2 cards of your deck.
[star] Boost: Discard the top 4 cards of your deck.

cards.name: Surge
cards.text:
Linked (New Recruits).
If you have the [[Mutant]] or [[X-Men]] trait, Surge gets +1 ATK and does not count against your ally limit.
cards.flavor: "Touch my friends and you get 10,000 volts!"

cards.name: Anole
cards.text:
Linked (New Recruits).
If you have the [[Mutant]] or [[X-Men]] trait, Anole gets +1 THW and does not count against your ally limit.
cards.flavor: "It's hard to be a kid when you look like a monster."

cards.name: Bling!
cards.text:
Linked (New Recruits).
If you have the [[Mutant]] or [[X-Men]] trait, Bling! gains toughness and does not count against your ally limit.
cards.flavor: "This school sucks!"

cards.name: Indra
cards.text:
Linked (New Recruits).
If you have the [[Mutant]] or [[X-Men]] trait, Indra gets +2 hit points and does not count against your ally limit.
cards.flavor: "I have seen atrocities done to mutants. No more!"

cards.name: Children of the Atom
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Each [[X-Factor]], [[X-Force]], and [[X-Men]] character you control gains the [[X-Factor]], [[X-Force]], and [[X-Men]] traits.

cards.name: Sebastian Shaw
cards.text: Toughness. Villainous. Forced Response: After Sebastian Shaw is attacked, give him a facedown boost card. He cannot be attacked again this phase.
cards.flavor: "Never raise a hand to your betters, serf!"

cards.name: Selene
cards.text:
Quickstrike. Villainous. Allies cannot attack Selene
[star] Boost: Discard an ally you control.
cards.flavor: "Foolish child! Countless thousands have gone to the fire in my name."

cards.name: Hellfire Pawn
cards.text:
Guard. Patrol. Surge. (While a minion with the patrol keyword is engaged with you, you cannot thwart the main scheme.)
[star] Boost: Put Hellfire Pawn into play engaged with you.

cards.name: The Inner Circle
cards.text: When Revealed: Place 2 additional threat here for each [[Hellfire]] card in play.
cards.flavor: The inner circle of the Hellfire Club uses its wealth and power to plot the course of mutant affairs in secret.

cards.name: Power and Decadence
cards.text:
When Revealed: Give the villain a tough status card. Give this card to that villain as a facedown boost card.
[star] Boost: After this activation, the activating enemy activates against you again. Do not give it a boost card for that activation.

cards.name: Maria Hill

cards.name: Maria Hill

cards.name: Nick Fury
cards.text: [star] Response: After Nick Fury uses a basic power, place 1 all-purpose counter on a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] support.
cards.flavor: "I put my best agent on the case." —Maria Hill

cards.name: On the Double

cards.flavor: "I want the suspect in custody yesterday!" —Maria Hill

cards.name: Reinforcements
cards.text: Action: Choose any number of [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] supports with a combined printed cost of 6 or less. Place 1 all-purpose counter on each of those supports.
cards.flavor: "We got orders straight from the Director. Move it!" —Dum Dum Dugan

cards.name: The Hard Call
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] support you control → deal X damage to each enemy, where X is the printed cost of the discarded support.
cards.flavor: "Sometimes it just comes down to numbers. More people die if I don't act than if I do." —Maria Hill

cards.name: Special Funding
cards.text: Response: After you spend this card to pay for a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] support, place 1 all-purpose counter on that support after it enters play.

cards.name: Support Staff
cards.text: Uses (3 staff counters). Resource: Exhaust Support Staff and remove 1 staff counter from it → generate a [wild] resource for a player whose identity has the [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] trait.

cards.name: The Iliad
cards.text: Uses (3 mission counters). Action: Exhaust The Iliad and remove 1 mission counter from it → choose: • Deal 5 damage to an enemy. • Remove 4 threat from a scheme. • Heal 3 damage from an identity.

cards.name: Life Model Decoy
cards.text: Interrupt: When an enemy attacks you, discard Life Model Decoy → prevent all damage from that attack.
cards.flavor: "When you've got job hazards like I do, it pays to take precautions." —Maria Hill

cards.name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Director
cards.text: Action: Exhaust S.H.I.E.L.D. Director → place 1 all-purpose counter on a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] support.
cards.flavor: "You don't have to agree with my orders. You just have to carry them out." —Maria Hill

cards.name: Victoria Hand
cards.text: Response: After Victoria Hand enters play, ready a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] support.
cards.flavor: "I better get hazard pay for this!"

cards.name: Slingshot
cards.text: Action: Spend a [energy] resource → put Slingshot into play from your hand under any player's control. At the end of the phase, if Slingshot is still in play, return her to your hand.

cards.name: Organizational Support
cards.text: Interrupt: When you spend this card, exhaust up to 3 allies and/or supports you control that share a [[Trait]] with your identity → generate the printed resources on each card exhausted this way.

cards.name: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
cards.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 [[Team]] card per player. If each of your characters has the [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] trait, this card gains: "Interrupt: When you reveal an encounter card, exhaust this card → cancel the effects of that card and discard it. Then, reveal another card from the encounter deck."

cards.name: Command Team
cards.text: Uses (3 command counters). Action: Exhaust Command Team and remove 1 command counter from it → ready an ally.

cards.name: The Circe
cards.text: Uses (2 deploy counters). Action: Exhaust The Circe, remove 1 deploy counter from it, and choose a player → that player puts an ally into play from their hand.

cards.name: The Bellerophon
cards.text: Uses (3 missile counters). Action: Exhaust The Bellerophon, remove 1 missile counter from it, and choose a player → deal 3 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with that player, discarding all tough status cards from those enemies first.

cards.name: The Douglass
cards.text: Uses (3 operation counters). Action: Exhaust The Douglass and remove 1 operational counter from it → remove 2 threat from each scheme, ignoring any crisis icons ([crisis]) in play.

cards.name: The Pericles
cards.text: Uses (2 supply counters). Action: Exhaust The Pericles and remove 1 supply counter from it → give a hero or villain a status card of your choice. Give an ally or minion a status card of your choice.

cards.name: Dum Dum Dugan
cards.text: Interrupt: When you use one of Dum Dum Dugan's basic powers, exhaust up to 3 [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] cards you control. For each card exhausted this way, Dum Dum Dugan gets +1 to that power for this use.

cards.name: Grant Ward
cards.text: Grant Ward cannot defend. Forced Response: After you reveal a treachery, you may spend a [mental] resource. If you do not, take damage equal to Grant Ward's ATK and remove Grant Ward from the game.

cards.name: Melinda May
cards.text: [star] Response: After Melinda May uses a basic power, look at the top card of the encounter deck. You may discard that card.
cards.flavor: "Don't call me the Cavalry."

cards.name: Super Spies
cards.text: Team-Up (Maria Hill and Nick Fury). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Place a total of 3 all-purpose counters and/or threat tokens on [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] supports and/or suit form upgrades.

cards.name: Energy
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Genius
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Strength
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Front Organization
cards.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Interrupt: When an encounter card effect would discard a card you control, discard Front Organization instead of discarding that card.

cards.name: Press Conference
cards.text: Give to the Maria Hill player. Forced Response: After the player phase ends, remove 1 all-purpose counter from each support you control. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust your identity → discard this card.

cards.name: Controller
cards.text: [star] Forced Response: After Controller activates against you, remove 1 all-purpose counter from a support. If Controlled Innocents is in play, put the top card of your deck into play facedown, engaged with you as a [[Controlled]] minion.

cards.name: Army of the Controlled
cards.text: When Revealed: Find the Controlled Innocents environment and put it into play. When Defeated: Discard each [[Controlled]] minion. Place 1 all-purpose counter on a support for each minion discarded this way.

cards.name: Controlled Innocents
cards.text: Each facedown [[Controlled]] minion engaged with a player has a base SCH of 1, a base ATK of 1, and a base hit points of 1. Forced Response: After a [[Controlled]] minion is defeated, place that card in its owner's discard pile and place 1 threat on the main scheme.

cards.name: Diabolical Discs
cards.text: Surge. When Revealed: Remove 1 all-purpose counter from a support. If Controlled Innocents is in play, put the top card of your deck into play facedown, engaged with you as a [[Controlled]] minion.
