cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this event using a [energy] resource, stun that enemy.
cards.flavor: "They'd be just as shocked if you showed them your high school photo." —Black Widow

cards.name: Safe House #30
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Safe House #30 → search the encounter deck for a minion and put it into play engaged with you. (Shuffle.) Then, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "You'll never guess who moved in next door." —Bucky Barnes

cards.name: Silent Infiltration
cards.text: Hero Response: After you attack and defeat an enemy, discard this card → ready your hero and confuse an enemy.
cards.flavor: "They'll never know what hit 'em." —Winter Soldier

cards.name: Winter Armor
cards.text: You get +3 hit points and gain steady.
cards.flavor: "The arm may be bulletproof, but the rest of me is still flesh and blood." —Winter Soldier

cards.name: Winter Mask
cards.text: You gain the [[Spy]] trait. Hero Response: After you attack and defeat an enemy, exhaust Winter Mask → draw 1 card.

cards.name: Winter Rifle
cards.text: Restricted. Hero Interrupt: When Winter Soldier makes a basic attack, exhaust Winter Rifle → Winter Soldier gets +2 ATK for this attack. This attack gains piercing and ranged.

cards.name: Captain America
cards.text: Toughness. Response: After Captain America enters play, ready a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] character.
cards.flavor: "On your feet, soldier!"

cards.name: Deathlok
cards.text: Response: After Deathlok enters play, search your deck and discard pile for a copy of S.H.I.E.L.D. Sidearm and attach it to him. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: "My body is infused with high-tech, mind-controlled weaponry."

cards.name: Firepower
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust up to 3 [[Weapon]] upgrades you control → for each weapon upgrade exhausted this way, choose an enemy and deal 3 damage to it. This attack gains ranged.

cards.name: One by One
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. If this attack defeats that enemy, deal 2 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Lots of tricks up these sleeves, ladies and gentlemen." —Moon Girl

cards.name: Spoiling for a Fight

cards.flavor: The government gave supercriminals two options: rot in prison or join the Thunderbolts.

cards.name: Taskmaster
cards.text: Retaliate 1. Toughness. Villainous. When Revealed: Taskmaster activates against you.
cards.flavor: "I'm going to charge S.H.I.E.L.D. extra for this!"

cards.name: Taskmaster's Sword
cards.text: Attach to Taskmaster. Otherwise, attach to the enemy leader. [star] Attached character's attacks gain piercing. Hero Action: Spend [mental] [physical] resources → discard this card.

cards.name: Taskmaster's Shield
cards.text: Attach to Taskmaster. Otherwise, attach to the enemy leader. Forced Interrupt: When attached character would take any amount of damage, reduce that amount by 1. Hero Action: Spend [mental] [physical] resources → discard this card.

cards.name: Mimicked Move
cards.text:
When Revealed: If Taskmaster is in play, he attacks your leader. Otherwise, give the enemy leader a tough status card and a facedown boost card.
[star] Boost: Give the activating enemy an additional boost card.

cards.name: Taskmaster's Academy
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: Give the enemy leader a tough status card and a facedown boost card.
cards.flavor: "You think I'm mean? Just wait 'til you're fighting Steve Rogers!" —Taskmaster

cards.name: Jester
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. Take 1 indirect damage for each different card type discarded this way.
cards.flavor: "Ha ha! This is too great! We're being ordered to attack heroes!"

cards.name: Jack O'Lantern
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. Place 1 threat on the main scheme for each different card type discarded this way.
cards.flavor: "I can't believe we're getting paid for this!"

cards.name: Mad Jack's Platform
cards.text:
Attach to a minion of the enemy team's choice. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Attached minion gets +4 hit points and gains stalwart.
[star] Boost: Attach this card to a minion engaged with you.

cards.name: Jester's Yo-Yo
cards.text:
When Revealed: Discard the highest-cost card you control. Otherwise, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: Discard an upgrade you control.

cards.name: Deadly Duo
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: Each player discards the top 8 cards of their deck.
cards.flavor: Ordered by S.H.I.E.L.D. to hunt down renegade heroes, Jester and Jack O'Lantern are only too happy to do their part.

cards.name: You're Out of Order!
cards.text: Interrupt: When any amount of threat would be placed on the main scheme, say "I object!" and prevent 3 of that threat.

cards.name: She-Hulk Smash
cards.text: Action: Your She-Hulk leader attacks the enemy leader. If you spent a [physical] resource to pay for this event, stun the enemy leader.
cards.flavor: "That does it! Now I'm mad!" —She-Hulk

cards.name: Make Me Angry
cards.text: Attach to your She-Hulk leader. Forced Response: After a hero or leader attacks attached She-Hulk, she attacks that character. Then, discard this card.

cards.name: Legal Counsel
cards.text: Hero Response: After you spend this resource, move 1 threat from the main scheme to your leader's main scheme.

cards.name: Righteous Cause
cards.text: When Revealed: The enemy leader schemes. If there is more than 1 player on your team, give the enemy leader an additional boost card for this activation.
cards.flavor: "I was a double agent for years. There's not much I won't do for a just cause." —Spider-Woman

cards.name: Whatever It Takes
cards.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): The enemy leader attacks your leader. When Revealed (Hero): The enemy leader attacks you.
cards.flavor: "I'm on target. Commence attack." —Captain Marvel

cards.name: Targeted Strike
cards.text:
When Revealed: The enemy team searches the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a card and deals it to you as a facedown encounter card.
[star] Boost: The card gains [boost] for each player on your team.

cards.name: Choosing Sides
cards.text: Permanent. The enemy leader cannot take more than 2 damage from each attack. Forced Response: After the last threat is removed from here, the enemy team searches the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for 1[per_hero] encounter cards and deals one to each player as a facedown encounter card. Flip this card.

cards.name: Now It's Personal
cards.text: Give to the first player. Action: Remove this card from the game → each player on your team chooses 2 of your leader's set-aside player cards and adds them to their hand.

cards.name: Vision
cards.text: Setup: The enemy team finds Vision's mass form attachment and attaches it to Vision, Dense side faceup. Forced Response: After resolving step 1 of the villain phase, flip Vision's mass form attachment.

cards.name: Vision
cards.text: Steady. When Revealed: Deal each player an encounter card. Vision cannot take damage this phase. Forced Response: After resolving step 1 of the villain phase, flip Vision's mass form attachment.

cards.name: Vision
cards.text: Setup: The enemy team finds Vision's mass form attachment and attaches it to Vision, Dense side faceup. Forced Response: After resolving step 1 of the villain phase, flip Vision's mass form attachment.

cards.name: Vision
cards.text: Steady. When Revealed: Deal each player an encounter card. Vision cannot take damage this phase. Forced Response: After resolving step 1 of the villain phase, flip Vision's mass form attachment.

cards.name: Superhero Resistance
cards.text: Contents: Chosen leader I and II (III and IV for expert mode). Chosen leader's set, Standard set, and 3–4 modular sets. Setup: In competitive mode, the enemy team finds the Choosing Sides side scheme and your team reveals it. In cooperative mode, find the chosen leader's side scheme and reveal it.

cards.name: Protect Secret Identities
cards.text: If there is more than 1 player on your team, this stage gains hinder 2[per_hero]. [star] Forced Response: After resolving step 1 of the villain phase, each player discards the top 3 cards of their deck.
cards.flavor: By giving up the masks, heroes put themselves and their loved ones at risk.

cards.name: Resistance Tactics
cards.flavor: Captain America and his Avengers are forced to go underground or face arrest for refusing to register with S.H.I.E.L.D. When Iron Man and Captain Marvel start rounding up their superpowered friends, the resistance decides to fight back.

cards.name: Expose Overreach
cards.text: Allies enter play exhausted. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.
cards.flavor: "If we expose S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secret prison to the world, they will lose public support." —Vision

cards.name: Dense
cards.text: Permanent. Mass form.
cards.flavor: Vision controls the molecules of his body to make himself intangible, or so dense that weapons shatter against him.

cards.name: Intangible
cards.text: Permanent. Mass form. Forced Interrupt: When Vision would take any amount of damage, reduce that amount by 1.
cards.flavor: "Innovation is the ultimate weapon." —Vision

cards.name: Solar Gem
cards.text:
Attach to Vision. Vision gains stalwart. Hero Response: After you make a basic attack against Vision, spend [energy] [physical] resources → discard this card and flip Vision's mass form attachment.
[star] Boost: Reveal this card.

cards.name: Vision's Cape
cards.text:
Attach to Vision. Vision gains retaliate 1. Hero Response: After you make a basic attack against Vision, spend [energy] [mental] resources → discard this card and flip Vision's mass form attachment.
[star] Boost: Reveal this card.

cards.name: Mass Increase
cards.text: Attach to Vision. Forced Interrupt: When a character attacks Vision while the Dense attachment is in play, prevent all damage from that attack and stun the attacking character. Discard this card.
cards.flavor: "Halt!" —Vision

cards.name: Density Control
cards.text: Surge. Attach to Vision. Forced Interrupt: When Vision activates, if this activation is: • A scheme, flip Vision's mass form attachment to Intangible. • An attack, flip Vision's mass form attachment to Dense. Then, if Vision's mass form attachment flipped, discard this card.

cards.name: Solar Beam
cards.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): Vision schemes. If the Intangible attachment is in play, Vision gets +1 SCH for this scheme. When Revealed (Hero): Vision attacks you. If the Dense attachment is in play, Vision gets +1 ATK for this attack.

cards.name: Superdense Strike
cards.text: When Revealed: Exhaust a character you control. If the Dense attachment is in play, deal 2 damage to that character. If the Intangible attachment is in play, flip that attachment.
cards.flavor: "Please do not resist or I will be required to apply even greater force." —Vision

cards.name: Phase Disruption
cards.text: When Revealed: The enemy team exhausts an upgrade you control. If the Intangible attachment is in play, discard that upgrade instead. If the Dense attachment is in play, flip that attachment.
cards.flavor: "Target neutralized." —Vision

cards.name: Just Passing Through
cards.text: When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme confuses their identity. Otherwise, they stun their identity.
cards.flavor: Vision's phasing power makes him a difficult and unpredictable foe.

cards.name: Patriot
cards.text: Toughness. When Revealed: Give the enemy leader a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "Don't they know that WE'RE the good guys?"

cards.name: Hawkeye
cards.text: [star] Hawkeye's attacks gain piercing and ranged. When Revealed: Discard an upgrade you control.
cards.flavor: "Eat your heart out, Clint!"

cards.name: Stature
cards.text: Guard. When Revealed: Discard a support you control.
cards.flavor: "You shouldn't talk down to a girl who can grow two stories tall!"

cards.name: Teenage Superheroes
cards.text: When Revealed: Resolve the "When Revealed" ability of each minion in play. If no "When Revealed" abilities were resolved this way, this card gains surge.
cards.flavor: "Young Avengers, assemble!" —Kate Bishop

cards.name: Young Avengers
cards.text:
Hinder 1[per_hero].
The first minion revealed each round gains surge.
cards.flavor: The next generation of superheroes hopes to carry on the legacy of their seniors.

cards.name: Speed
cards.text: Quickstrike. When Revealed: You are stunned. Otherwise, deal 2 damage to your identity.
cards.flavor: "Hey! Geriatrics! Let's get a move on."

cards.name: Wiccan
cards.text: Incite 1. When Revealed: You are confused. Otherwise, place 2 threat on the main scheme.
cards.flavor: "You picked the wrong kids to mess with."

cards.name: Superspeed
cards.text:
When Revealed: Discard 1 random card from your hand. Take indirect damage equal to its cost.
[star] Boost: Discard 1 card from your hand.
cards.flavor: "Didn't see that coming, did you?" Speed

cards.name: Spellcasting
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When you play a card, cancel its effects and discard it. Then, discard this card.
cards.flavor: "BLINDINGFLASHBLINDINGFLASH." —Wiccan

cards.name: Superpowered Siblings
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme discards 1 card from their hand.
cards.flavor: Wiccan and Speed are following in the footsteps of their superhero parents: Vision and Scarlet Witch.

cards.name: Moon Knight
cards.text: Retaliate 2. Toughness. When Revealed: Resolve the "When Revealed" ability of the topmost treachery in the encounter discard pile.
cards.flavor: "You're in a world of trouble now."

cards.name: Crescent Dart
cards.text: Attach to Moon Knight. Otherwise, attach to the enemy leader. [star] Forced Interrupt: When attached character attacks, this attack gains piercing and ranged. Discard this card after this attack.

cards.name: Fist of Khonshu
cards.text:
When Revealed: Exhaust your identity and deal 2 damage to it.
[star] Boost: Exhaust your identity.
cards.flavor: "I am the Fist of Khonshu! I am vengeance!" —Moon Knight

cards.name: Khonshu's Avatar
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a treachery is discarded. Resolve that card's "When Revealed" ability.

cards.name: Janus
cards.text: When Revealed: If you have the [[Hunted]] trait, Janus activates against you. Otherwise, discard the top 2 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor: "No one escapes the Atlantean royal guard!"

cards.name: Amir
cards.text: When Revealed: If you have the [[Hunted]] trait, Amir activates against you. Otherwise, discard the top 2 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor: "My lord, Namor, has ordered you brought before him."

cards.name: Atlanteans
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. If you are in: • Alter-ego form, place 1 threat on the main scheme for each different card type discarded this way. • Hero form, take 1 indirect damage for each different card type discarded this way.

cards.name: Blood Debt
cards.text: You gain the [[Hunted]] trait. Alter-Ego Action: Discard the top 8 cards of your deck → discard this card.

cards.name: The Royal Guard
cards.text: Hinder 1[per_hero]. When Defeated: The enemy team searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Blood Debt and deals it to the player who defeated this scheme as a facedown encounter card.

cards.name: Calculated Risk
cards.text: Action: Search the top 5 cards of your leader's encounter deck for an encounter card and deal it to the first player on the enemy team as a facedown encounter card.
cards.flavor: "There is no victory without risk." —Vision

cards.name: Synthezoid Strike
cards.text: Action: Your Vision leader attacks the enemy leader. If Vision's mass form attachment is: • Dense, Vision gets +1 ATK for this attack and this attack gains piercing. • Intangible, flip it to Dense before resolving this attack.

cards.name: Phased Out
cards.text: Action: Choose an attachment on the enemy leader with the text "Hero Response" or "Hero Interrupt" and discard it.
cards.flavor: "My ability to phase through electronics can disrupt Stark's technology." —Vision

cards.name: Android Assistance
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When you spend this resource, flip your Vision leader's mass form attachment.

cards.name: Righteous Cause
cards.text: When Revealed: The enemy leader schemes. If there is more than 1 player on your team, give the enemy leader an additional boost card for this activation.
cards.flavor: "I was a double agent for years. There's not much I won't do for a just cause." —Spider-Woman

cards.name: Whatever It Takes
cards.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): The enemy leader attacks your leader. When Revealed (Hero): The enemy leader attacks you.
cards.flavor: "I'm on target. Commence attack." —Captain Marvel

cards.name: Targeted Strike
cards.text:
When Revealed: The enemy team searches the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a card and deals it to you as a facedown encounter card.
[star] Boost: The card gains [boost] for each player on your team.

cards.name: Choosing Sides
cards.text: Permanent. The enemy leader cannot take more than 2 damage from each attack. Forced Response: After the last threat is removed from here, the enemy team searches the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for 1[per_hero] encounter cards and deals one to each player as a facedown encounter card. Flip this card.

cards.name: Now It's Personal
cards.text: Give to the first player. Action: Remove this card from the game → each player on your team chooses 2 of your leader's set-aside player cards and adds them to their hand.

cards.name: Wonder Man
cards.text: Power Recycling — Wonder Man gets +1 ATK for each card tucked under Ionic Physiology. [star] Forced Response: After Wonder Man makes a basic attack, discard each card tucked under Ionic Physiology.

cards.name: Simon Williams
cards.text: Ionic Energy Being — You may include events with a printed [energy] resource icon from any aspect in your deck. Setup: Put Ionic Physiology into play.

cards.name: Ionic Physiology
cards.text: Permanent. Max 3 cards tucked here. Response: After you play an event with a printed [energy] resource, tuck that event from your discard pile under this card → heal 1 damage from your identity.

cards.name: Active Altruism
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 1 threat from a scheme. Remove 2 additional threat from that scheme for each [energy] resource you overpaid for this card (to a maximum of [energy] [energy]).

cards.name: Ionic Blast
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. Deal 2 additional damage to that enemy for each [energy] resource you overpaid for this card (to a maximum of [energy] [energy] [energy]).

cards.name: Starstruck
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal damage to an enemy equal to your ATK. If you overpaid for this card with a [energy] resource, stun that enemy.

cards.name: Energy Siphon
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When you spend this card, take up to 3 damage → this card generates 1 additional [energy] resource for each damage taken this way.

cards.name: Wonder Fans
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Wonder Fans → choose: • Tuck 1 event with a printed [energy] resource from your discard pile under Ionic Physiology. • Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Jet Belt
cards.text: Hero Resource: Exhaust Jet Belt → generate a [energy] resource for an event. Hero Resource: Exhaust Jet Belt and discard a card tucked under Ionic Physiology → generate a [energy] resource.

cards.name: Mr. Hollywood
cards.text: Resource: Generate a [energy] resource to overpay for a card. (Limit once per card.)
cards.flavor: "Hey, aren't you one of those guys from Beach Volleyball Bros Part II?" —Kate Bishop

cards.name: Signature Sunglasses
cards.text: Response: After you change form, choose: • Tuck an event or resource card with a printed [energy] resource from your discard pile under Ionic Physiology. • Add a card tucked under Ionic Physiology to your hand.

cards.name: "What Are You?"
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When Wonder Man would be defeated, instead set his hit point dial to 4 and change him to alter-ego form. You may tuck events with a printed [energy] resource from your discard pile under Ionic Physiology until there are 3 cards tucked there. Remove this card from the game.

cards.name: Firebird
cards.text: If you overpaid for Firebird, put 1 rebirth counter on her. Interrupt: When Firebird would be defeated by consequential damage, remove 1 rebirth counter from her → heal all damage from her instead.

cards.name: Hawkeye
cards.text: Hawkeye enters play with 4 arrow counters on him. Response: After an ally makes a basic thwart, remove 1 arrow counter from Hawkeye → deal 2 damage to a minion.

cards.name: Scarlet Witch
cards.text: Forced Response: After you play Scarlet Witch, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If it is a treachery card, resolve its "When Revealed" ability.

cards.name: Sentry
cards.text: Forced Response: After Sentry enters play, search the encounter deck for a side scheme and reveal it. (Shuffle.) If no side scheme was revealed this way, place 6 threat on the main scheme.

cards.name: Battlefield Benevolence
cards.text: Hero Action: Heal 2 damage from an enemy → confuse that enemy.
cards.flavor: "Huh? What's the trick?" —Vulture

cards.name: Bombs Away
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust an [[AERIAL]] character you control and choose a player → deal 3 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with that player.

cards.name: Everywhere All at Once
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Aerial]] trait. Hero Action (thwart): Choose X schemes. Remove 2 threat from each chosen scheme (3 threat instead if you overpaid for this card).

cards.name: Stronger Together
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When a character other than your hero would take any amount of damage, if that character shares a [[Trait]] with your hero, reduce that damage by your DEF.

cards.name: Unified Strike
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When an ally uses a basic power, exhaust your hero → add your hero's matching power to that ally's power for this use. That ally does not take consequential damage for this use.

cards.name: Heroic Conditioning
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
You get +3 hit points and your hero gets +1 THW.

cards.name: Swordsman
cards.text: [star] Swordsman's basic attacks gain piercing. Hero Response: After a boost card is turned faceup during an undefended attack, declare Swordsman as the defender without exhausting him.

cards.name: Energy
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Jarvis
cards.text: Response: After an [[Avenger]] hero changes into alter-ego form, exhaust Jarvis → choose: • That identity gets +2 REC until the end of the phase. • Discard a status card from that identity.

cards.name: Pacifism
cards.text: Give to the Simon Williams player. Wonder Man cannot attack. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Simon Williams or discard 3 cards tucked under Ionic Physiology → discard this card.

cards.name: Grim Reaper
cards.text: Quickstrike. [star] Forced Response: After Grim Reaper attacks and defeats an ally, deal that ally's controller a facedown encounter card.

cards.name: Brother vs. Brother
cards.text: As an additional cost to attack Grim Reaper, you must discard 1 card from your hand.
cards.flavor: "If only you were my real brother...instead of this monstrosity you've become." —Grim Reaper

cards.name: Scythe Strike
cards.text: When Revealed: If Grim Reaper is in play, he activates against you. Otherwise, take 2 indirect damage.
cards.flavor: "Nothing will get in my way!" —Grim Reaper

cards.name: Death Cannot Die
cards.text:
When Revealed: Grim Reaper activates against you. If Grim Reaper is not in play, find him and reveal him.
[star] Boost: If Grim Reaper is in play, he activates against you (after this activation).

cards.name: Caught in the Crossfire
cards.text: Attach to a non-[[Elite]] minion. Max 1 per minion. Interrupt: When a friendly character attacks, deal 1 damage to attached minion.

cards.name: Cameo
cards.text: Setup. Max 1 per deck. Setup: Search your collection for an identity-specific ally for an identity not in this game. Shuffle that ally into your deck. Discard 2 cards from your hand and remove this card from the game.

cards.name: Coordinated Effort
cards.text:
Attach to an encounter card in play. Max 1 per encounter card.
While paying costs on attached card, any player may help pay those costs.

cards.name: Disarming Defense
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When your hero defends against an attack, it gets +2 DEF for that attack. If you take no damage from that attack, discard an attachment on the attacking enemy with the text "Hero Action" or "Hero Response".

cards.name: Avengers Compound
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait. Max 1 per deck. Action: Exhaust Avengers Compound → choose: tuck 1 ally from your hand here if there is no ally tucked here, or play the ally tucked here as if it were in your hand.

cards.name: Hercules
cards.text: Atonement — Response: After a [[labor]] card is added to the victory display, put the top card of the [[gift]] deck into play. Ready Hercules. You may flip to alter-ego form. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Hercules
cards.text: Hercules begins the game with a labor deck and a gift deck. (See insert.) New Labors of Hercules — Action: If there is no labor card in play, reveal the top card of the labor deck.

cards.name: Defeat the Hydra
cards.text: Victory 0. Attached minion gets +6 hit points and gains the [[Elite]] trait. Attached minion cannot take damage except from Hercules's attacks. When Revealed: Find a non-[[Elite]] minion with at least 6 printed hit points. Reveal it, heal all damage from it, and attach this card to it.

cards.name: Embody Pathos
cards.text: Victory 0. Attached side scheme gains assault. Threat cannot be removed from attached scheme except by Hercules's thwarts. When Revealed: Find an encounter side scheme that is not in play and reveal it, treating each [per_hero] on it as 1, and attach this card to it. Place 6 additional threat on it.

cards.name: Protect Humanity
cards.text: Uses (3 labor counters). Victory 0. When Revealed: Find Amadeus Cho and put him into play. Forced Interrupt: When the villain would attack Hercules, choose 1 of your allies. The villain attacks that ally instead. After that attack resolves, if Hercules defended, remove 1 labor counter from here.

cards.name: Nemean Lion Skin
cards.text: Permanent. Hercules gets +2 hit points and gains steady. Response: After this card enters play, draw 4 cards.

cards.name: Shield of Perseus
cards.text: Permanent. Hercules gets +1 hit point and gains retaliate 1. Response: After this card enters play, draw 4 cards.

cards.name: Sword of Peleus
cards.text: Permanent. Restricted. Hercules gets +1 hit point and his basic attacks gain piercing. Response: After this card enters play, draw 4 cards.

cards.name: Amadeus Cho
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When a minion would attack you, it attacks Amadeus Cho instead. Action: Exhaust Amadeus Cho → draw 1 card.

cards.name: The Gift of Battle
cards.text: Reduce the cost to play this card by 1 for each [[Gift]] card you control. Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "As Hercules has said countless times: have at thee!" —Hercules

cards.name: Son of Zeus
cards.text: Hero Action: Ready Hercules. If you control at least: • 1 [[Gift]] card, ready an identity-specific upgrade you control. • 2 [[Gift]] cards, gain a tough status card. • 3 [[Gift]] cards, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Wisdom of Athena
cards.text: Reduce the cost to play this card by 1 for each [[Gift]] card you control. Hero Action (thwart): Remove 4 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "Zounds! Is that you, oh sister of mine?" —Hercules

cards.name: Olympus
cards.text: Resource: Exhaust Olympus → generate a [wild] resource for each [[Gift]] card you control.
cards.flavor: Although Olympus's influence may have waned since the Hellenistic period, the celebrating has not.

cards.name: Gauntlets of Hercules
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When Hercules defends against an attack, exhaust Gauntlets of Hercules → Hercules gains retaliate 1 for that attack for each [[Gift]] card you control.

cards.name: Golden Mace
cards.text: Restricted. Hero Interrupt: When Hercules makes a basic attack, exhaust Golden Mace → Hercules gets +1 ATK for this attack for each [[Gift]] card you control. This attack gains overkill.

cards.name: Herc's Helm
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When the villain attacks, exhaust Herc's Helm → reduce the amount of damage this attack deals by 1.

cards.name: Lion of Olympus
cards.text: Temporary. (Discard this card at the end of the round.) Your hero gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, and +1 DEF.
cards.flavor: Like the mighty lions native to ancient Greece, the ferocity of Hercules is incredible.

cards.name: Prince of Power
cards.text: Hero Response: After Hercules attacks and defeats an enemy, exhaust Prince of Power → heal 1 damage from Hercules for each point of excess damage dealt to that enemy by that attack.

cards.name: Deathcry
cards.text: [star] Hero Interrupt: When Deathcry makes a basic attack, deal your hero 1 damage → Deathcry takes -1 consequential damage ([cost]) for this attack.

cards.name: Namora
cards.text: [star] Namora gets +1 hit point for each other ally you control.
cards.flavor: "I've heard she can beat Captain Marvel in an arm wrestling contest." —Gorilla-Man

cards.name: Thor
cards.text: [star] Forced Response: After Thor makes a basic thwart, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until you discard a minion. Put that minion into play engaged with you.

cards.name: Teamwork
cards.text: Hero Interrupt When you use your basic thwart power (THW) or basic attack power (ATK), exhaust an ally you control → add that ally's matching power to your hero's power for this use.

cards.name: Call for Backup
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for an ally and put it into play. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: "I already regret this." —Rocket Raccoon

cards.name: Recruitment Drive
cards.text: Alter-ego form only. Action: Discard Recruitment Drive and choose a player → reduce the resource cost of the next ally that player plays this phase to 0.

cards.name: "Avenge Me!"
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait. Attach to an ally. Max 1 per ally. Interrupt: When attached ally is defeated, draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Gilgamesh
cards.text: As an additional cost to play this card, if you do not have the [[Eternal]] trait, confuse your identity.
cards.flavor: Having lived for around a million years, even Gilgamesh had once forgotten who he was.

cards.name: Ancient Rivalry
cards.text: Team-Up (Hercules and Thor). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Search your discard pile for an identity-specific upgrade and add it to your hand. Ready Hercules and Thor.

cards.name: Limitless Stamina
cards.text: Play only if your identity has at least 14 printed hit points. Hero Action: Ready your hero.
cards.flavor: "What, you think this fight is almost over?! That was just warm-up practice." —Thor

cards.name: Evaluate Threat
cards.text: Victory 0. Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] or [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] trait. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for an [[Avenger]] or [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] card and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.) Reduce the cost to play each of those cards by 2 until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Energy
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Genius
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Strength
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Avengers Compound
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait. Max 1 per deck. Action: Exhaust Avengers Compound → choose: tuck 1 ally from your hand here if there is no ally tucked here, or play the ally tucked here as if it were in your hand.

cards.name: Helicarrier
cards.text: Max 1 per player. Action: Exhaust Helicarrier → choose a player. Reduce the resource cost of the next card that player plays this phase by 1.
cards.flavor: "A flying aircraft carrier? You're kidding, right?" —Jennifer Walters

cards.name: Quincarrier
cards.text: Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait. Resource: Exhaust Quincarrier → generate a [wild] resource.
cards.flavor: "Too bad we could only get one of these." —Hawkeye

cards.name: Appeal to Athena
cards.text: Give to the Hercules player. When counting [[Gift]] cards you control, you are considered to control none. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Hercules or spend [mental] [mental] → remove this obligation from the game.

cards.name: Ares
cards.text: Retaliate 1. [star] Forced Response: After Ares schemes, deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card. (Hercules's nemesis minion.)

cards.name: Lernean Hydra
cards.text: Forced Response: After a character you control attacks and damages Lernean Hydra, choose: • Spend a [physical] resource. • Lernean Hydra heals 2 damage.

cards.name: Olympic Feud
cards.text: When Revealed: Place 1 additional threat here for each [[Olympus]] card in play.
cards.flavor: Hercules has twice thwarted attempts to overthrow Olympus orchestrated by his uncle Pluto and half-brother Ares.

cards.name: Ares's Axe
cards.text: Attach to Ares. Otherwise, attach to the villain. [star] Forced Response: After attached enemy attacks, if no friendly character took damage from this attack, discard this card.
cards.flavor: From kukri to Shi'ar sniper rifles, Ares wields every weapon with equal malice toward all.

cards.name: God of War
cards.text: Each minion attacks the player it is engaged with (even if that player is in alter-ego form). If no minion activates this way, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a minion is discarded and reveal that minion.

cards.name: All Versus All
cards.text: Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Response: After a character is defeated, place 2 threat on this scheme. When Defeated: Set All Versus All aside.

cards.name: Hecate
cards.text: When Revealed/Defeated: Find the All Versus All side scheme and reveal it. [star] Forced Response: After Hecate activates, place 2 threat on the All Versus All side scheme.
cards.flavor: "Those who once adored you have turned on you."

cards.name: Kyknos
cards.text: Retaliate 1. Toughness. Victory 0. [star] Forced Response: After Kyknos activates, place 2 threat on the All Versus All side scheme. Otherwise, place 1 threat on the main scheme.
cards.flavor: "The penalty of death shall be meted out by Kyknos, the son of Ares."

cards.name: Bewitched Officer
cards.text:
Retaliate 1.
[star] Bewitched Officer's attacks gain piercing and ranged.
cards.flavor: "Hey, pull over!"

cards.name: Roving Mobs
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Find the All Versus All side scheme and reveal it.
cards.flavor: Nowhere is safe under the wargospel of All Versus All.

cards.name: Daredevil
cards.text: Superhuman Senses — Action: Play the top card of the [[Sense]] deck as if it were in your hand (paying its cost).

cards.name: Matt Murdock
cards.text: Matt Murdock begins the game with a Sense deck. (See rulebook p. 26.) Forced Interrupt: When a Sense upgrade would leave play, place it on the bottom of the Sense deck instead.

cards.name: Acute Tactility
cards.text: Attach to an enemy or scheme. Interrupt: When you defeat attached enemy or remove the last threat from attached scheme, discard this card → ready your identity.

cards.name: Enhanced Olfaction
cards.text: Attach to an enemy or scheme. Interrupt: When you defeat attached enemy or remove the last threat from attached scheme, discard this card → reduce the cost of the next card you play this phase by 2.

cards.name: Heightened Hearing
cards.text: Attach to an enemy. Hero Interrupt (defense): When attached enemy attacks, discard this card → that enemy gets -3 ATK for that attack. (You become the target of that attack.)

cards.name: Radar Sense
cards.text: Attach to an enemy. Response (attack): After you attack attached enemy, discard this card → deal 3 damage to that enemy.
cards.flavor: The accident that cost Matt his eyesight gave him a new, radar-like sense.

cards.name: Superior Taste
cards.text: Attach to a scheme. Response (thwart): After you thwart attached scheme, discard this card → remove 2 threat from that scheme.

cards.name: Elektra
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt (Hero): When Elektra would take consequential damage, Daredevil takes that damage instead.
cards.flavor: "I don't need your protection, Matt."

cards.name: Cross-Examination
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. For each upgrade attached to that enemy, you may deal 1 additional damage to it.
cards.flavor: "No further questions, punk." —Daredevil

cards.name: Deposition
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action (thwart): You may choose any upgrade from the [[Sense]] deck and play it, ignoring its resource cost. (Do not shuffle.) Remove 2 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "Tell us everything." —Matt Murdock

cards.name: Living Lie Detector
cards.text: Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. For each upgrade attached to that scheme, you may remove 1 additional threat from it.
cards.flavor: Thump-Thump     Thump-Thump    Thump-Thump   Thump-Thump  Thump-Thump Thump-Thump

cards.name: Raising Hell
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to each enemy for each upgrade attached to that enemy (3 damage instead if Daredevil has the [[Aerial]] trait).
cards.flavor: "I cannot see the light. So I will be the light. I am Daredevil, and I am not afraid." —Daredevil

cards.name: Focus the Senses
cards.text: Threat cannot be removed from this scheme except by Daredevil or Matt Murdock. When Defeated: You may move any number of [[Sense]] upgrades in play to other cards they can attach to. Choose any number of upgrades from the [[Sense]] deck and put them into play. (Do not shuffle.)

cards.name: Foggy Nelson
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Foggy Nelson → remove 2 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "Everything's okay now, Matt! Ol' Fog is on it!"

cards.name: Karen Page
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Karen Page → shuffle 1 Daredevil card from your discard pile into your deck. If you are in alter-ego form, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "What would you boys do without me?"

cards.name: Nelson and Murdock
cards.text: Response: After an [[Attorney]] character or support defeats a side scheme, confuse an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Let's see them pull off their heist with their vehicle impounded." —Matt Murdock

cards.name: Sister Maggie
cards.text: Matt Murdock gets +3 REC. Response: After you recover, discard a status card from your identity.
cards.flavor: As both a Catholic nun and Matt's mother, Sister Maggie often nurses her son back to health.

cards.name: Daredevil's Billy Club
cards.text: Restricted. Daredevil gets +1 ATK. Hero Action: Return this card to your hand (from play) → choose: • Deal 1 damage to an enemy. • Daredevil gains the [[Aerial]] trait until the end of the round.

cards.name: The Man Without Fear
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust this card and deal 1 damage to Daredevil → choose: • Choose any upgrade from the [[Sense]] deck and play it, ignoring its resource cost. (Do not shuffle.) • Ready Daredevil.

cards.name: Blindspot
cards.text: [star] Response: After Blindspot thwarts, confuse an enemy with an upgrade attached.
cards.flavor: "I'm invisible, but I'm still here. Chinatown is where I live and I'm going to protect it."

cards.name: Cloak
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Cloak and spend [energy] [energy] resources → find Dagger and put her into play.

cards.name: Dagger
cards.text:
Cloak loses each [acceleration] icon.
[star] If Cloak is in play, Dagger takes -1 consequential damage after she uses a basic power.
cards.flavor: "I'll be the light in your dark, Ty."

cards.name: Ghost Rider
cards.text: [star] Interrupt: When Ghost Rider attacks an enemy, spend a [energy] resource ([energy] [energy] resources instead if that enemy is the villain) → confuse that enemy.
cards.flavor: "My penance stare reveals all of your past sins!"

cards.name: Know Your Enemy
cards.text: [star] Discount 1 ([[Martial Artist]]). Hero Action (thwart): Remove 1 threat from a scheme. Remove 1 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "I don't need to see you to know your next move." —Iron Fist

cards.name: De-escalation
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Remove an acceleration token from play.
cards.flavor: "I can see my house from here!" —Civilian

cards.name: Chance Encounter
cards.text: Attach to a side scheme. Max 1 per scheme. Interrupt: When attached side scheme is defeated, search your deck and discard pile for an ally and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Legal Trouble
cards.text:
[star] Discount 1 ([[Attorney]] or [[Police]]).
Attach to a minion. Max 1 per minion.
Attached minion gets -2 SCH.
cards.flavor: "You got a permit for that?" —Police officer

cards.name: Move in Shadow
cards.text: [star] Discount 1 ([[Martial Artist]] or [[Spy]]). Temporary. Max 1 per player. Response (thwart): After you play a card (including this one), remove 1 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Stealth Training
cards.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Response: After you thwart and exactly defeat a side scheme, exhaust Stealth Training → stun an enemy.

cards.name: Stick
cards.text: Interrupt: When a friendly [[Martial Artist]] character uses a basic power, choose: • Exhaust Stick → that character gets +1 to that basic power for this use. • That character gets -1 to that basic power for this use. Ready Stick.

cards.name: Contingency Planning
cards.text: Max 1 per player. You may play the upgrade tucked here as if it were in your hand. Action: Choose 1 upgrade in your hand that can attach to a minion or side scheme. Tuck that upgrade under here (to a maximum of 1).

cards.name: Dance with the Devil
cards.text: Team-Up (Daredevil and Elektra). Max 1 per deck. Attach to an enemy. Hero Action (attack): Discard this card → deal 3 damage to attached enemy.

cards.name: Sensory Overload
cards.text: Give to the Matt Murdock player. Forced Response: After a [[Sense]] upgrade enters play, take 1 damage. Alter-Ego Response: After you recover, discard this card.
cards.flavor: Daredevil's heightened senses make him vulnerable to intense stimuli.

cards.name: Bullseye
cards.text: When Revealed: Choose: • Discard a [[Persona]] support you control. • Bullseye attacks you (even in alter-ego form).
cards.flavor: "In my hands, anything is a deadly weapon!"

cards.name: Deadliest Man Alive
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When Bullseye attacks, give him a facedown boost card.
cards.flavor: "C'mon, Hornhead, let's give the people a show!" —Bullseye

cards.name: Stolen Sai
cards.text:
Attach to the enemy with the highest ATK. [star] Attached character's attacks gain piercing. Hero Action: Spend [physical] [physical] resources → choose to either attach this card to Elektra or discard it.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains piercing.

cards.name: Eye on the Target
cards.text: When Revealed: Choose: • Remove an ally or [[Persona]] support you control from the game. • Bullseye attacks you (even in alter-ego form). If he is not in play, find him and reveal him.
cards.flavor: "Catch!" —Bullseye

cards.name: Echo
cards.text: Watch and Learn — Response: After a player plays an aspect or basic event, tuck that event under here from that player's discard pile. Then, if there are more than 3 tucked cards here, discard all but 3 of those cards.

cards.name: Maya Lopez
cards.text: Practice Makes Perfect — Interrupt: When you change to hero form, search your deck for an aspect or basic event and add it to your hand. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: Maya can recreate any physical movement she sees.

cards.name: Innate Reflexes
cards.text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Your hero gets +1 DEF.
cards.flavor: KTINK!

cards.name: Daredevil
cards.text: [star] Response: After Daredevil uses a basic power, reduce the cost of the next event you play this round by 1.
cards.flavor: "Follow my lead."

cards.name: Photographic Reflexes
cards.text: [star] If you are in hero form, you can discard Photographic Reflexes from your hand to play an event tucked under Echo as if it were in your hand. Reduce the cost to play that event by 2. You cannot trigger Echo's "Watch and Learn" ability for that event.

cards.name: Photographic Reflexes
cards.text: [star] If you are in hero form, you can discard Photographic Reflexes from your hand to play an event tucked under Echo as if it were in your hand. Reduce the cost to play that event by 2. You cannot trigger Echo's "Watch and Learn" ability for that event.

cards.name: Photographic Reflexes
cards.text: [star] If you are in hero form, you can discard Photographic Reflexes from your hand to play an event tucked under Echo as if it were in your hand. Reduce the cost to play that event by 2. You cannot trigger Echo's "Watch and Learn" ability for that event.

cards.name: Study the Tape
cards.text: Action: Search any player's discard pile for 1 aspect event, 1 basic event, or 1 copy of Photographic Reflexes and add that card to your hand.
cards.flavor: "I watch tape after tape to train for a fight." —Echo

cards.name: The Rez
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust The Rez → heal X damage from Maya Lopez, where X is the highest cost among cards tucked under her.
cards.flavor: The Rez is not a real reservation or Native nation, but a place for all tribes.

cards.name: American Sign Language
cards.text: Hero Resource: Exhaust this card → generate a [wild] resource for an event being played by any player.
cards.flavor:
<Need help?>* —Echo
*Translated from ASL.

cards.name: Choreography
cards.text: Action: Exhaust this card → shuffle 1 aspect or basic event from your discard pile into your deck. If you are in alter-ego form, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Maya uses her physical gifts to express herself in dance.

cards.name: Echo's Katana
cards.text: Restricted. Hero Response (attack): After you play an event, exhaust Echo's Katana → deal damage to an enemy equal to that event's printed cost. This attack gains piercing.

cards.name: Improvisation
cards.text: Hero Response: After you play an event, if it has the following traits: • [[Attack]] — heal 1 damage from Echo. • [[Defense]] — remove 1 threat from a scheme. • [[Thwart]] — deal 1 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Muscle Memory
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust this card → add an event tucked under Echo to your hand.
cards.flavor: "I absorb an arsenal of actions, so when I need to, I can perform them with the same precision." —Echo

cards.name: Army of One
cards.text: [star] Increase the cost to play this card by 1 for each ally you control. Hero Action: Ready your hero.
cards.flavor: "Two versus one is not a fair fight...for you." —Daredevil

cards.name: Get Their Attention
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense/thwart): When an enemy initiates an attack, remove 3 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor:
"I think we made 'em mad."
"What do you mean 'we'?"
—Rocket Raccoon and Gamora

cards.name: In Harm's Way
cards.text: [star] Increase the cost to play this card by 1 for each ally you control. Hero Action (attack/thwart): Deal X damage to an enemy and remove X threat from a scheme, where X is your DEF.

cards.name: Powerful Punch
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (attack/defense): When an enemy initiates an attack, deal 4 damage to that enemy.
cards.flavor: "That was my favorite shirt!" —Luke Cage

cards.name: The Best Offense...
cards.text: Temporary. Your hero gets +1 DEF. Use your DEF in place of your THW and ATK. (Ignore any modifiers to your THW and ATK.)

cards.name: Ronin
cards.text: While you do not control any allies, your hero gets +1 DEF and gains retaliate 1.
cards.flavor: "I am Ronin, the samurai with no master." —Ronin

cards.name: Stand Alone
cards.text: Max 1 per player. Hero Interrupt: When an enemy attacks you (before any defender is declared), if you do not control any allies, exhaust Stand Alone → ready your hero.

cards.name: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
cards.text: Team-Up (Daredevil and Echo). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (attack/thwart): Choose 2 of the following (you may choose the same option twice): • Deal 3 damage to an enemy. • Remove 3 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Superpower Training
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for an identity-specific upgrade and put it into play. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: "Eat light daggers, you purple punk!" —Dagger

cards.name: Energy
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Genius
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Strength
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Raised by the Kingpin
cards.text: Give to the Maya Lopez player. You cannot deal damage to Kingpin. When Revealed: Find Kingpin and put him into play engaged with you. Response: After you thwart, place that threat here. If there is 4 or more threat here, remove this card from the game.
cards.flavor: Allie Preswick

cards.name: Kingpin
cards.text: [star] Forced Interrupt: When Kingpin would attack the Maya Lopez player, he schemes instead. (Echo's nemesis minion.)
cards.flavor: "In my own way, I grew to care for you, Maya. I loved you like a daughter. I still do."

cards.name: Master Manipulator
cards.text:
Kingpin cannot take damage. When Revealed: Find Kingpin and put him into play engaged with you.
[star] Boost: If Kingpin is in play, reveal this scheme.
cards.flavor: "If you lay a hand on me, you will regret it." —Kingpin

cards.name: Kingpin's Henchman
cards.text:
Guard.
Kingpin cannot take damage.
cards.flavor: "Mr. Fisk would like a word wit' yous."

cards.name: Pawn of the Kingpin
cards.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): If Kingpin is in play, he schemes. Otherwise, this card gains surge. When Revealed (Hero): Deal damage to a hero equal to your hero's ATK.
cards.flavor: Kingpin convinced Echo that it was Daredevil, not Kingpin, who killed her father.

cards.name: Jessica Jones
cards.text: [star] Gather Evidence — Response: After you use a basic power, place 1 evidence counter on Alias Investigations.
cards.flavor: "These things rarely end well."

cards.name: Jessica Jones
cards.text: Incognito Mode — Action: Change to hero form. You cannot change back to alter-ego form this phase. Setup: Put the Alias Investigations support into play.

cards.name: Alias Investigations
cards.text: Permanent. Response: After a side scheme is defeated, exhaust this card → place 2 evidence counters here. Then, you may remove evidence counters from here equal to the villain's remaining hit points to defeat the villain's current stage.

cards.name: Luke Cage
cards.text: Toughness. Action: Exhaust Luke Cage and deal 1 damage to him → give him a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "He may have skin like steel, but he's got a heart of gold." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: "Big Mistake"
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. You may remove 1 evidence counter from Alias Investigations to deal 2 additional damage and for this attack to gain either overkill or piercing.
cards.flavor: "You messed with the wrong lady." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: Breakthrough
cards.text: Response: After an evidence counter is placed on Alias Investigations, ready your identity. Shuffle this card into your deck.
cards.flavor: "Tell me more." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: Snooping Around
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action (thwart): Remove 4 threat from a scheme and place 2 evidence counters on Alias Investigations. Discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is a minion or side scheme, reveal it.

cards.name: Piecing It All Together
cards.text: This scheme does not count against the player side scheme limit. When Defeated: The defeating player draws 3 cards.
cards.flavor: Sometimes, you take a step back to look at the big picture and it all falls into place.

cards.name: Calling in Favors
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Remove 2 evidence counters from Alias Investigations and exhaust Calling in Favors → search your deck for an ally and play it as if it were in your hand, reducing its resource cost by 2. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: 4K Digital Camcorder
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust this card and choose a non-[[Elite]] minion. Remove X evidence counters from Alias Investigations, where X is equal to 2 less than that minion's remaining hit points → discard that minion.
cards.flavor: "...gotcha." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: Circumstantial Evidence
cards.text: Response: After an enemy is defeated, exhaust Circumstantial Evidence → place 1 evidence counter on Alias Investigations.
cards.flavor: "Nice find! That'll come in handy." —Daredevil

cards.name: Leather Jacket
cards.text: Jessica Jones gets +2 DEF. Response: After you defend, place 1 evidence counter on Alias Investigations.
cards.flavor: "Luke, does she own any jackets that aren't black leather?" —Iron Fist

cards.name: "Now I'm Ticked Off!"
cards.text: Forced Response (attack): After the villain activates against a player, if you are in alter-ego form, change to hero form. Deal 5 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with that player. Discard this card.
cards.flavor: "What did you just say to her?" —Jessica Jones

cards.name: Reluctant Flier
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take at least 3 damage from an attack, discard this card → prevent all of that attack's damage. Take 1 damage.
cards.flavor: "I think I'm gonna puke." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: Stakeout
cards.text: Action: If this card is in your play area, attach it to a non-permanent encounter side scheme. Interrupt: When a character thwarts attached scheme, that thwart removes 2 additional threat. If that thwart defeats attached scheme, place 2 evidence counters on Alias Investigations.

cards.name: Captain Marvel
cards.text: Response: After Captain Marvel enters play, discard the top 4 cards of your deck. If you discard a printed [energy] resource, remove 2 threat from a scheme. If you discard more than one printed [energy] resource, also confuse an enemy.

cards.name: Spider-Woman
cards.text: Response: After a character you control thwarts, place 1 limb counter here (to a maximum of 8). You may discard Spider-Woman to deal 1 damage to an enemy for each limb counter here.

cards.name: Squirrel Girl
cards.text: Response: After you play Squirrel Girl from your hand, place 1 squirrel counter here for each card in your hand (to a maximum of 4). Action: Remove 1 squirrel counter from here → remove 1 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Lay Down the Law
cards.text: Hero Response (thwart): After you change form, remove 3 threat from a scheme (4 threat instead if you paid for this card using a [mental] resource).
cards.flavor: "Maybe this will teach you!" —Captain America

cards.name: Strategy Session
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Choose a player to search their deck for a player side scheme and add it to their hand. Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a player side scheme.
cards.flavor: "Okay, gang, I've got a plan." —Nova

cards.name: Run Them to Ground
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Resolve each of the following: • Skip the next villain phase. • Deal each player 1 facedown encounter card (immediately). • The villain cannot take damage until the start of the next (unskipped) villain phase.

cards.name: Lay the Trap
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme deals 5[per_hero] damage to the villain.
cards.flavor:
"You go right, I'll go left."
"I always go right."
"Fine, go left."
"I like going right."
—Daredevil and Iron Fist

cards.name: Determination
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Response: After you spend this card, remove 1 threat from the main scheme.

cards.name: Grapnel Launcher
cards.text: Restricted. Hero Action: Discard this card → make a basic thwart without exhausting (even if you are exhausted). For this thwart, your hero gets +1 THW and ignores the patrol keyword and any crisis icons ([crisis]) in play.

cards.name: Entrapment
cards.text: Max 1 per player. Alter-Ego Response (attack): After the villain schemes, change to hero form and discard this card → deal damage to the villain equal to the amount of threat placed by that activation.

cards.name: Hellcat
cards.text: If your identity has the [[Defender]] trait, this card gains: "Action: Put Hellcat into play from your hand. At the end of the phase, discard her."
cards.flavor: "Hi Fellas! Well, tootles."

cards.name: Joys of Life
cards.text: Alliance. Action: Choose: • Exhaust a [[Civilian]] alter-ego → ready a hero or ally. • Exhaust a hero or ally → ready a [[Civilian]] alter-ego.

cards.name: Unbreakable Bond
cards.text: Team-Up (Jessica Jones and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Heal a total of 3 damage from among Jessica Jones and Luke Cage.

cards.name: Second Chance
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may shuffle all of their identity-specific cards from their discard pile into their deck.
cards.flavor: "Let's do what heroes do best: save the day!" —Ms. Marvel

cards.name: Defend Our City
cards.text: [star] Hinder 1[per_hero]. Prerequisite ([[Defender]]). Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for a Team-Up card and add it to their hand. Until the end of the phase, reduce the cost to play each Team-Up card by 1.

cards.name: Work-Life Balance
cards.text: Give to the Jessica Jones player. As an additional cost to change forms, discard 1 card from your hand. Alter-Ego Action: Choose: • Remove an ally you control from the game → remove this card from the game. • Confuse your identity → discard this card.

cards.name: Purple Man
cards.text: [star] Purple Man's SCH is equal to the highest SCH or THW among characters in play. His ATK is equal to the highest ATK among characters in play.
cards.flavor: Zebediah Killgrave's chemically-modified pheromones influence everybody in close proximity.

cards.name: Indomitable Will
cards.text: [star] Hinder 3[per_hero]. When Revealed: Place 2 pheromone counters on each Suggestion obligation in play. Forced Response: After a Suggestion obligation enters play, place 2 (additional) pheromone counters on it.

cards.name: Suggestion ([energy])
cards.text: Uses (3 pheromone counters). Forced Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 pheromone counter from it → choose to either play a card that has a printed [energy] resource icon (paying its costs) or add 2 threat to the main scheme.
cards.flavor: "Do me a favor..." —Purple Man

cards.name: Suggestion ([mental])
cards.text: Uses (3 pheromone counters). Forced Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 pheromone counter from it → choose to either play a card that has a printed [mental] resource icon (paying its costs) or add 2 threat to the main scheme.
cards.flavor: "Simon didn't say so." —Purple Man

cards.name: Suggestion ([physical])
cards.text: Uses (3 pheromone counters). Forced Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 pheromone counter from it → choose to either play a card that has a printed [physical] resource icon (paying its costs) or add 2 threat to the main scheme.
cards.flavor: "Nuh-uh-uh." —Purple Man

cards.name: Innate Aggression
cards.text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Your hero gets +1 ATK.
cards.flavor: SMACK!

cards.name: Shakedown
cards.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Response: After you attack and exactly defeat a minion, exhaust this card → remove threat from a scheme equal to that minion's base SCH.
cards.flavor: "I'm not your bro." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: Innate Perception
cards.text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Your hero gets +1 THW.
cards.flavor: WHOOOSH!

cards.name: Innate Inspiration
cards.text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Each ally you control gets +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: PA-PA_POW!

cards.name: Echo
cards.text: Reduce the amount of damage Echo takes from each enemy attack by your hero's DEF.
cards.flavor: The facepaint Echo applies is in remembrance of her late father's last touch.

cards.name: Lay Low
cards.text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may change to alter-ego form. Heal damage from each alter-ego equal to its REC.
cards.flavor: "I'm sure the nice old Estonian couple that owns this place won't mind if we crash here for a bit." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: Mitigated Threat
cards.text: Attach to a card. Attached card loses each [acceleration], [amplify], [crisis], and [hazard] icon. Forced Response: At the end of the round, each player may spend 1 resource of any type. If any player does not, discard this card.

cards.name: Luke Cage
cards.text: Unbreakable Skin — Luke Cage can have any number of tough status cards. Attacks against Luke Cage lose piercing. Forced Response: After a tough status card is discarded from Luke Cage, he takes 1 unpreventable damage (ignoring tough).

cards.name: Luke Cage
cards.text: Unbreakable Skin — Luke Cage can have any number of tough status cards. Attacks against Luke Cage lose piercing. Action: Search your deck and discard pile for the Burstein Process upgrade and add it to your hand. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Jessica Jones
cards.text: [star] Jessica Jones gets +1 THW for each tough status card on your identity (to a maximum of +4 THW).
cards.flavor: "I'm here, and I'm not going anywhere."

cards.name: Harlem's Hero
cards.text: Hero Action: Give Luke Cage a tough status card. For each tough status card on Luke Cage, choose a character you control and ready it.
cards.flavor: "It ain't just me. I've got family to back me up." —Luke Cage

cards.name: Knuckle Sandwich
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. You may discard a tough status card from Luke Cage to return this event to your hand.

cards.name: "Stand with Me!"
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Give Luke Cage a tough status card. Remove 1 threat from a scheme for each tough status card on Luke Cage (to a maximum of 5).
cards.flavor: "This is the greatest city in the world. I will not allow it to fall into chaos." —Luke Cage

cards.name: "Sweet Christmas!"
cards.text: [star] Reduce the cost to play this card by 1 for each tough status card on Luke Cage. Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with you.

cards.name: Fogwell's Gym
cards.text: Response: After a tough status card is discarded from a [[Defender]] character, exhaust Fogwell's gym → ready that character.
cards.flavor: "Busted a lot of punching bags at this old place, and they never kicked me out." —Luke Cage

cards.name: Burstein Process
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Burstein Process → give Luke Cage a tough status card (2 tough status cards instead if he has none).
cards.flavor: "I got skin like steel and muscles to match." —Luke Cage

cards.name: Cruisin' for a Bruisin'
cards.text: Attach to a minion. Max 1 per minion. Attacks against attached minion deal 2 additional damage and gain overkill. Response: After you play this card, engage attached minion.

cards.name: Metal Bracer
cards.text: Luke Cage gets retaliate 1. Hero Interrupt: When any amount of damage would be dealt to Luke Cage, exhaust Metal Bracer → reduce that damage by 1.

cards.name: Power Man
cards.text: Hero Response: After a tough status card is discarded from Luke Cage, exhaust Power Man → draw a card.
cards.flavor: "Tremble before the power of Power Man! That sounded weird. Luke Cage. Tremble before Luke Cage." —Luke Cage

cards.name: Iron Fist
cards.text: Interrupt: When Iron Fist defends against an enemy attack, prevent damage from that attack equal to Iron Fist's ATK.
cards.flavor: "I've forgotten more about fighting than you'll ever know." —Iron Fist

cards.name: Misty Knight
cards.text:
Toughness.
[star] Misty Knight gets +2 ATK and +2 THW while she has a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "Come on, heroes. We've got to help save this city."

cards.name: Valkyrie
cards.text: Toughness. Interrupt: When another ally would be defeated, discard Valkyrie (from play) → instead heal that ally until they have 1 hit point remaining.

cards.name: Take a Stand
cards.text: Hero Response: After your hero defends, each ally you control gets +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the player phase.
cards.flavor: "It takes a lot more than that to keep me down." —Luke Cage

cards.name: Innovation
cards.text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Response: After you spend this card, heal 1 damage from an ally you control.

cards.name: The Power of Leadership
cards.text: Max 2 per deck. Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Leadership (blue) card.

cards.name: Defensive Formation
cards.text: Uses (3 block counters). Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 block counter from it → give a [[Defender]] ally a tough status card.

cards.name: Righteous Purpose
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Each character you control that has exactly 1 hit point remaining gets +2 THW and +2 ATK.
cards.flavor: "No more running." —Daredevil

cards.name: Hulk
cards.text: Hulk gets +1 ATK for each rage counter here. Response: After the villain attacks you, place 1 rage counter here.

cards.name: She-Hulk
cards.text: Toughness. Response: After She-Hulk enters play, give your identity a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "You interrupted my workout."

cards.name: Dynamic Duo
cards.text: Action: Search your deck and discard pile for a Team-Up card and an ally named by that card's Team-Up keyword. Add those cards to your hand. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Power Man and Iron Fist
cards.text: Team-Up (Iron Fist and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy and give a tough status card to a character.

cards.name: Unbreakable Bond
cards.text: Team-Up (Jessica Jones and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Heal a total of 3 damage from among Jessica Jones and Luke Cage.

cards.name: Energy
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Genius
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Strength
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Internal Injury
cards.text: Give to the Luke Cage player. Forced Response: After the player phase ends, take 3 unpreventable damage (ignoring tough status cards). Alter-Ego Response: After you recover, remove Internal Injury from the game.

cards.name: Cottonmouth
cards.text:
[star] Forced Response: After Cottonmouth attacks, he attacks the same character 2 additional times. (Limit once per phase.) (Luke Cage's nemesis minion.)
[star] Boost: Deal this card to the Luke Cage player as a facedown encounter card.

cards.name: Venomous Whispers
cards.text:
Each [[Serpent Society]] minion cannot be attacked. When Defeated: The defeating player discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Serpent Society]] minion is discarded and reveals that minion.
[star] Boost: You are confused.

cards.name: Augmented Jaws
cards.text: Attach to Cottonmouth. Otherwise, attach to the villain. [star] Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy attacks a character, discard each tough status card from that character. Hero Action: Spend [mental] [mental] resources → discard this card.

cards.name: Asp
cards.text:
[star] Forced Response: After Asp schemes against you, you are stunned.
[star] Boost: You are stunned.
cards.flavor: "You deserve a taste of venom!"

cards.name: Sidewinder
cards.text: Quickstrike. Forced Interrupt: When Sidewinder is attacked, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If the discarded card has a "Boost" ability, deal Sidewinder to the attacking player as a facedown encounter card.

cards.name: Size Advantage
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy (6 damage instead if you have the [[Giant]] trait or more remaining hit points than that enemy).
cards.flavor: "Puny runt!" —Hulk

cards.name: Observe
cards.text: Hero Action: The villain schemes. Give your hero a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "There are other ways to see." —Daredevil

cards.name: Toughen Up
cards.text: Response: After you recover, if your remaining hit points are equal to or greater than your base hit points, exhaust Toughen Up → give your identity a tough status card.

cards.name: Black Belt
cards.text:
Play only if any player controls a [[Martial Artist]] card.
Attach to a friendly character. Max 1 per character.
Attached character gets +1 hit point and gains the [[Martial Artist]] trait.

cards.name: Ronan the Accuser
cards.text:
Toughness. Ronan the Accuser cannot be stunned. Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase begins, Ronan the Accuser engages the hero with the fewest remaining hit points.
[star] Boost: Put Ronan the Accuser into play engaged with you.

cards.name: Judge, Jury, Executioner
cards.text:
Forced Response: After a friendly character is defeated by an enemy attack, place 2 threat on the main scheme.
[star] Boost: Put Judge, Jury, Executioner into play.

cards.name: The Accused
cards.text:
Attach to your identity. Forced Interrupt: When an enemy initiates an attack against the attached identity, that enemy gets +1 ATK for the attack. Forced Response: After Ronan the Accuser is defeated, discard this card.
[star] Boost: Attach to your identity.

cards.name: Bring the Hammer Down
cards.text:
When Revealed: Ronan the Accuser activates against the player he is engaged with. If Ronan the Accuser is not in play, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: If this activation defeats a character, deal the first player 1 facedown encounter card.

cards.name: You Dare Oppose Me?
cards.text:
When Revealed: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. Each time a card belonging to the Kree Fanatic set is discarded this way, deal that card to yourself as a facedown encounter card.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, that attack gains overkill.
